        setContentView(binding.getRoot());

        authRepository = new AuthRepository();
        repository = new PhotoRepository();

        setupRecyclerView();
        setupListeners();
        loadPhotos();
    }

    private void setupRecyclerView() {
        photoAdapter = new PhotoAdapter(this, this);
        binding.rvSearchResults.setLayoutManager(new GridLayoutManager(this, 2));
        binding.rvSearchResults.setAdapter(photoAdapter);
    }

    private void setupListeners() {
        binding.btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());

        binding.etSearchQuery.addTextChangedListener(new TextWatcher() {
            @Override
            public void beforeTextChanged(CharSequence s, int start, int count, int after) {}

            @Override
            public void onTextChanged(CharSequence s, int start, int before, int count) {
                filterPhotos(s.toString());
            }

            @Override
            public void afterTextChanged(Editable s) {}
        });
    }

    private void loadPhotos() {
        UserInfo user = authRepository.getCurrentUser();
        if (user == null) return;

        repository.getPhotosByUserAsync(user.getId(), new PhotoRepository.Callback<List<Photo>>() {
            @Override
            public void onSuccess(List<Photo> photos) {
                allPhotos = photos != null ? photos : new ArrayList<>();
                filterPhotos(binding.etSearchQuery.getText().toString());
            }

            @Override
            public void onError(String error) {
                Toast.makeText(SearchActivity.this, "Lỗi tải thư viện: " + error, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            }
        });
    }

    private void filterPhotos(String query) {
        searchResults.clear();
        String q = query != null ? query.trim().toLowerCase() : "";

        if (q.isEmpty()) {
            searchResults.addAll(allPhotos);
        } else {
            for (Photo p : allPhotos) {
                if (!p.isTrashed() && p.getName() != null && p.getName().toLowerCase().contains(q)) {
                    searchResults.add(p);
                }
            }
        }

        photoAdapter.setPhotos(searchResults);

        if (searchResults.isEmpty()) {
            binding.layoutEmpty.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            binding.rvSearchResults.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        } else {
            binding.layoutEmpty.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            binding.rvSearchResults.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onPhotoClick(Photo photo) {
        Intent intent = PhotoDetailActivity.createIntent(this, photo, searchResults);
        startActivity(intent);
    }

    @Override
    public void onPhotoLongClick(Photo photo, View view) {
        onPhotoClick(photo);
    }

    @Override
    public void onFavoriteToggle(Photo photo) {
        UserInfo user = authRepository.getCurrentUser();
        if (user == null) return;

        boolean newFav = !photo.isFavorite();
        repository.toggleFavoriteAsync(user.getId(), photo.getId(), newFav, new PhotoRepository.Callback<Void>() {
            @Override
            public void onSuccess(Void result) {
                photo.setFavorite(newFav);
                photoAdapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
            }

            @Override
            public void onError(String error) {
                Toast.makeText(SearchActivity.this, "Lỗi: " + error, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            }
        });
    }
}


SettingsActivity.java
package com.example.th6.activities;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Bundle;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;

import com.example.th6.R;
import com.example.th6.activities.SmartCleanupActivity;
import com.example.th6.data.AuthRepository;
import com.example.th6.databinding.ActivitySettingsBinding;
import com.example.th6.utils.PreferencesManager;

public class SettingsActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private ActivitySettingsBinding binding;
    private PreferencesManager prefsManager;
    private AuthRepository authRepository;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        binding = ActivitySettingsBinding.inflate(getLayoutInflater());
        setContentView(binding.getRoot());

        prefsManager = new PreferencesManager(this);
        authRepository = new AuthRepository();

        setupUI();
        setupListeners();
    }

    private void setupUI() {
        binding.switchDarkMode.setChecked(prefsManager.isDarkMode());
    }

    private void setupListeners() {
        binding.btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());

        binding.switchDarkMode.setOnCheckedChangeListener((buttonView, isChecked) -> {
            prefsManager.setDarkMode(isChecked);
        });

        binding.cardBackupCenter.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            startActivity(new Intent(SettingsActivity.this, BackupCenterActivity.class));
        });

        binding.cardSmartCleanup.setOnClickListener(v ->
                startActivity(new Intent(SettingsActivity.this, SmartCleanupActivity.class)));

        binding.btnLogout.setOnClickListener(v -> confirmLogout());
    }

    private void confirmLogout() {
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(R.string.menu_logout)
                .setMessage(R.string.confirm_logout)
                .setPositiveButton(R.string.btn_ok, (dialog, which) -> {
                    authRepository.signOutAsync(result -> {
                        if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                        if (!result.getLocalSessionCleared()) {
                            android.widget.Toast.makeText(this, "Không thể xóa phiên đăng nhập trên thiết bị. Thử lại.", android.widget.Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                            return;
                        }
                        if (!result.getServerSignOutConfirmed()) {
                            android.widget.Toast.makeText(this, "Đã đăng xuất khỏi thiết bị. Máy chủ chưa xác nhận thu hồi phiên.", android.widget.Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                        }
                        Intent intent = new Intent(this, LoginActivity.class);
                        intent.setFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK);
                        startActivity(intent);
                        finish();
                    });
                })
                .setNegativeButton(R.string.btn_cancel, null)
                .show();
    }
}


SlideshowActivity.java
package com.example.th6.activities;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;

import com.bumptech.glide.Glide;
import com.example.th6.R;
import com.example.th6.databinding.ActivitySlideshowBinding;
import com.example.th6.models.Photo;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class SlideshowActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private ActivitySlideshowBinding binding;
    private List<Photo> photos = new ArrayList<>();
    private int currentIndex = 0;
    private boolean isPlaying = true;
    private Handler handler;
    private Runnable runnable;
    private static final long SLIDE_DELAY = 3000;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        binding = ActivitySlideshowBinding.inflate(getLayoutInflater());
        setContentView(binding.getRoot());

        if (getIntent().hasExtra("photos")) {
            photos = (List<Photo>) getIntent().getSerializableExtra("photos");
        }

        if (photos == null || photos.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Không có ảnh nào để trình chiếu", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            finish();
            return;
        }

        handler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
        runnable = new Runnable() {
            @Override
            public void run() {
                if (isPlaying && photos.size() > 1) {
                    currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % photos.size();
                    displayPhoto(currentIndex);
                    handler.postDelayed(this, SLIDE_DELAY);
                }
            }
        };

        setupUI();
        setupListeners();
        displayPhoto(0);
        startSlideshow();
    }

    private void setupUI() {
        binding.btnPlayPause.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_dark_mode); // Icon toggle
    }

    private void setupListeners() {
        binding.btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());

        binding.btnPlayPause.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            isPlaying = !isPlaying;
            if (isPlaying) {
                startSlideshow();
                Toast.makeText(this, "Tiếp tục trình chiếu", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            } else {
                stopSlideshow();
                Toast.makeText(this, "Đã tạm dừng", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            }
        });

        binding.btnNext.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (!photos.isEmpty()) {
                currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % photos.size();
                displayPhoto(currentIndex);
            }
        });

        binding.btnPrev.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (!photos.isEmpty()) {
                currentIndex = (currentIndex - 1 + photos.size()) % photos.size();
                displayPhoto(currentIndex);
            }
        });
    }

    private void displayPhoto(int index) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= photos.size()) return;

        Photo p = photos.get(index);
        binding.tvCounter.setText((index + 1) + " / " + photos.size());

        Glide.with(this)
                .load(p.getImageUrl())
                .placeholder(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder)
                .into(binding.imgSlideshow);
    }

    private void startSlideshow() {
        handler.removeCallbacks(runnable);
        handler.postDelayed(runnable, SLIDE_DELAY);
    }

    private void stopSlideshow() {
        handler.removeCallbacks(runnable);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onPause() {
        super.onPause();
        stopSlideshow();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        if (isPlaying) {
            startSlideshow();
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        super.onDestroy();
        stopSlideshow();
    }
}


SmartCleanupActivity.java
package com.example.th6.activities;

import android.Manifest;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.provider.MediaStore;
import android.text.format.Formatter;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.activity.result.ActivityResultLauncher;
import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager;

import com.example.th6.R;
import com.example.th6.adapters.SmartCleanupAdapter;
import com.example.th6.data.AuthRepository;
import com.example.th6.data.PhotoRepository;
import com.example.th6.databinding.ActivitySmartCleanupBinding;
import com.example.th6.models.LocalMediaPhoto;
import com.example.th6.models.Photo;
import com.example.th6.models.SmartCleanupMedia;
import com.example.th6.services.SmartCleanupScanner;
import com.example.th6.utils.PhotoTrashManager;
import io.github.jan.supabase.auth.user.UserInfo;

import java.io.InputStream;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.List;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.UUID;

public class SmartCleanupActivity extends AppCompatActivity implements SmartCleanupAdapter.Listener {
    private ActivitySmartCleanupBinding binding;
    private SmartCleanupAdapter adapter;
    private AuthRepository authRepository;
    private PhotoRepository repository;
    private SmartCleanupScanner.Session scanSession;
    private SmartCleanupScanner.Result currentResult;
    private final List<SmartCleanupMedia> currentMedia = new ArrayList<>();
    private ActivityResultLauncher<String[]> permissionLauncher;
    private String scanUid;
    private boolean scanRunning;
    private boolean trashRunning;
    private int scanGeneration;

    @Override protected void onCreate(@Nullable Bundle state) {
        super.onCreate(state);
        binding = ActivitySmartCleanupBinding.inflate(getLayoutInflater());
        setContentView(binding.getRoot());
        authRepository = new AuthRepository(); repository = new PhotoRepository();
        adapter = new SmartCleanupAdapter(this, this);
        binding.rvCleanupResults.setLayoutManager(new LinearLayoutManager(this));
        binding.rvCleanupResults.setAdapter(adapter);
        binding.toolbarSmartCleanup.setNavigationOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        binding.btnCleanupScan.setOnClickListener(v -> requestOrStartScan());
        binding.btnCleanupCancel.setOnClickListener(v -> cancelScan());
        binding.btnCleanupTrash.setOnClickListener(v -> confirmTrashSelected());
        binding.tvCleanupEmpty.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        permissionLauncher = registerForActivityResult(new ActivityResultContracts.RequestMultiplePermissions(), result -> {
            if (hasAnyMediaReadPermission()) startScan();
            else setStatus("Chưa được cấp quyền đọc thư viện. Chỉ có thể quét media được cấp quyền truy cập.");
        });
        UserInfo signedIn = authRepository.getCurrentUser();
        if (signedIn != null) {
            SmartCleanupScanner.Result latest = SmartCleanupScanner.getLatest(signedIn.getId());
            if (latest != null) {
                for (SmartCleanupMedia media : latest.allMedia) media.selected = false;
                scanUid = signedIn.getId(); scanRunning = true;
                showScanResult(latest);
            }
        }
    }

    @Override protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        if (scanUid != null && !sameActiveUid()) {
            SmartCleanupScanner.clearLatestForUid(scanUid);
            scanGeneration++;
            if (scanSession != null) scanSession.cancel();
            scanSession = null; scanRunning = false; currentResult = null; currentMedia.clear();
            if (adapter != null) adapter.setResults(null);
            if (binding != null) {
                binding.progressCleanup.setVisibility(View.GONE); binding.btnCleanupCancel.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                binding.btnCleanupScan.setEnabled(true); binding.tvCleanupStats.setText(R.string.smart_cleanup_not_scanned);
                binding.tvCleanupEmpty.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE); updateSelectionUi();
                setStatus("Tài khoản đã đổi; kết quả cũ đã được loại bỏ. Hãy quét lại.");
            }
        }
    }

    private void requestOrStartScan() {
        if (scanRunning || trashRunning) return;
        if (hasAnyMediaReadPermission()) { startScan(); return; }
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33) {
            List<String> permissions = new ArrayList<>();
            permissions.add(Manifest.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES);
            permissions.add(Manifest.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO);
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 34) permissions.add(Manifest.permission.READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USER_SELECTED);
            permissionLauncher.launch(permissions.toArray(new String[0]));
        } else permissionLauncher.launch(new String[]{Manifest.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE});
    }

    private boolean hasAnyMediaReadPermission() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33) {
            boolean images = ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED;
            boolean videos = ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED;
            boolean selected = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 34 && ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USER_SELECTED) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED;
            return images || videos || selected;
        }
        return ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED;
    }

    private void startScan() {
        UserInfo user = authRepository.getCurrentUser();
        if (user == null || user.getId() == null || user.getId().isEmpty()) {
            setStatus("Đăng nhập để quét thư viện cloud của tài khoản."); return;
        }
        // A new scan replaces the previous session and clears its selectable results immediately.
        if (scanSession != null) scanSession.cancel();
        currentResult = null; currentMedia.clear(); adapter.setResults(null); updateSelectionUi();
        scanUid = user.getId(); scanRunning = true;
        final int generation = ++scanGeneration;
        binding.progressCleanup.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE); binding.btnCleanupCancel.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        binding.btnCleanupScan.setEnabled(false); binding.tvCleanupEmpty.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        binding.tvCleanupStats.setText("Đang quét media trên thiết bị và cloud…");
        setStatus("Đang bắt đầu quét");
        scanSession = SmartCleanupScanner.scan(getApplicationContext(), scanUid, new SmartCleanupScanner.Listener() {
            @Override public void onProgress(String stage, int processed, int total) {
                if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                runOnUiThread(() -> { if (scanRunning && generation == scanGeneration) setStatus(stage + " • " + processed + "/" + total); });
            }
            @Override public void onComplete(SmartCleanupScanner.Result result) {
                if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                runOnUiThread(() -> { if (generation == scanGeneration) showScanResult(result); });
            }
            @Override public void onCancelled() {
                if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                runOnUiThread(() -> { if (generation == scanGeneration) finishCancelledScan(); });
            }
        });
    }

    private void showScanResult(SmartCleanupScanner.Result result) {
        if (!scanRunning) return;
        UserInfo active = authRepository.getCurrentUser();
        if (active == null || !scanUid.equals(active.getId())) { finishCancelledScan(); setStatus("Phiên đăng nhập đã đổi; bỏ kết quả quét cũ."); return; }
        currentResult = result; currentMedia.clear(); currentMedia.addAll(result.allMedia);
        scanRunning = false; scanSession = null;
        binding.progressCleanup.setVisibility(View.GONE); binding.btnCleanupCancel.setVisibility(View.GONE); binding.btnCleanupScan.setEnabled(true);
        adapter.setResults(result);
        String summary = result.allMedia.size() + " media • dung lượng đã xác định " + Formatter.formatFileSize(this, result.analyzedBytes)
                + " • quét lúc " + android.text.format.DateFormat.format("dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm", new Date(result.completedAt));
        binding.tvCleanupStats.setText(summary);
        String warning = result.warning == null ? "" : result.warning;
        if (!result.localScanned) warning = append(warning, "MediaStore chưa được quét đầy đủ.");
        if (!result.cloudScanned) warning = append(warning, "Kết quả chỉ gồm local; cloud chưa được quét.");
        if (!hasFullImageAndVideoPermission()) warning = append(warning, "Quyền media bị giới hạn; một số ảnh/video có thể không xuất hiện.");
        if (result.partialComparison) warning = append(warning, "Một phần ảnh không thể so sánh nội dung.");
        setStatus(warning.isEmpty() ? "Hoàn tất quét local và cloud." : "Quét một phần: " + warning);
        boolean empty = result.duplicates.isEmpty() && result.similar.isEmpty() && result.largeVideos.isEmpty() && result.unknownSizeVideos.isEmpty();
        binding.tvCleanupEmpty.setVisibility(empty ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        updateSelectionUi();
    }

    private boolean hasFullImageAndVideoPermission() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33) return ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
                && ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED;
        return ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED;
    }

    private String append(String original, String extra) { return original == null || original.isEmpty() ? extra : original + " " + extra; }
    private void setStatus(String text) { binding.tvCleanupStatus.setText(text); }

    private void cancelScan() {
        if (!scanRunning) return;
        scanGeneration++;
        if (scanSession != null) scanSession.cancel();
        SmartCleanupScanner.clearLatestForUid(scanUid);
        finishCancelledScan();
    }
    private void finishCancelledScan() {
        scanRunning = false; scanSession = null; currentResult = null; currentMedia.clear(); adapter.setResults(null);
        binding.progressCleanup.setVisibility(View.GONE); binding.btnCleanupCancel.setVisibility(View.GONE); binding.btnCleanupScan.setEnabled(true);
        binding.tvCleanupStats.setText("Phiên quét đã hủy; chưa có kết quả hiện hành."); binding.tvCleanupEmpty.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE); updateSelectionUi();
        if (!isFinishing()) setStatus("Đã hủy quét");
    }

    @Override public void onToggle(SmartCleanupMedia item) {
        if (trashRunning || scanRunning) return;
        item.selected = !item.selected; updateSelectionUi(); adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
    }
    @Override public void onOpen(SmartCleanupMedia item) {
        if (item.video) {
            LocalMediaPhoto video = item.local;
            if (video == null) {
                video = new LocalMediaPhoto(); video.setContentUri(""); video.setDisplayName(item.getName()); video.setVideo(true);
                video.setCloudUrl(item.cloud == null ? "" : item.cloud.getImageUrl()); video.setCloudPhoto(item.cloud);
            }
            startActivity(new Intent(this, VideoPlayerActivity.class).putExtra("video", video));
            return;
        }
        Photo photo = item.cloud;
        if (photo == null) {
            photo = new Photo(); photo.setOwnerUid("local"); photo.setId(localTrashId(item.local));
            photo.setName(item.getName()); photo.setMediaType("image"); photo.setCreatedAt(item.local == null ? System.currentTimeMillis() : item.local.getTimelineTimestamp());
            photo.setImageUrl(item.local == null ? "" : item.local.getContentUri());
        }
        if (item.local != null) { photo.setLocalMediaUri(item.local.getContentUri()); photo.setLocalMediaId(item.local.getMediaId()); photo.setLocalDateModified(item.local.getDateModified()); }
        List<Photo> collection = new ArrayList<>();
        for (SmartCleanupMedia media : currentMedia) if (!media.video) collection.add(photoFor(media));
        startActivity(PhotoDetailActivity.createIntent(this, photo, collection));
    }

    private Photo photoFor(SmartCleanupMedia item) {
        if (item.cloud != null) return item.cloud;
        Photo photo = new Photo(); photo.setOwnerUid("local"); photo.setId(localTrashId(item.local)); photo.setName(item.getName());
        photo.setImageUrl(item.local.getContentUri()); photo.setLocalMediaUri(item.local.getContentUri()); photo.setLocalMediaId(item.local.getMediaId()); photo.setMediaType("image");
        photo.setLocalDateModified(item.local.getDateModified()); photo.setCreatedAt(item.local.getTimelineTimestamp()); return photo;
    }

    private void updateSelectionUi() {
        if (binding == null) return;
        int selected = 0; for (SmartCleanupMedia item : currentMedia) if (item.selected) selected++;
        if (adapter != null) adapter.setInteractionEnabled(!scanRunning && !trashRunning);
        binding.btnCleanupTrash.setEnabled(selected > 0 && !scanRunning && !trashRunning);
        binding.btnCleanupTrash.setText(selected == 0 ? getString(R.string.smart_cleanup_trash_selected)
                : getString(R.string.smart_cleanup_trash_count, selected));
    }

    private void confirmTrashSelected() {
        List<SmartCleanupMedia> chosen = new ArrayList<>(); for (SmartCleanupMedia item : currentMedia) if (item.selected) chosen.add(item);
        if (chosen.isEmpty() || currentResult == null || scanUid == null) return;
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this).setTitle(R.string.smart_cleanup_trash_title)
                .setMessage(getString(R.string.smart_cleanup_confirm_trash, chosen.size()))
                .setNegativeButton(R.string.btn_cancel, null)
                .setPositiveButton(R.string.smart_cleanup_trash_confirm, (d, w) -> revalidateAndTrash(chosen))
                .show();
    }

    private void revalidateAndTrash(List<SmartCleanupMedia> chosen) {
        UserInfo active = authRepository.getCurrentUser();
        if (active == null || !scanUid.equals(active.getId())) { setStatus("Tài khoản đã đổi. Hãy quét lại trước khi dọn."); return; }
        trashRunning = true; updateSelectionUi(); setStatus("Đang xác minh kết quả và chuyển mục đã chọn vào Thùng rác…");
        processTrashItem(chosen, 0, 0, new ArrayList<>());
    }

    private void processTrashItem(List<SmartCleanupMedia> chosen, int index, int successes, List<String> errors) {
        if (index >= chosen.size()) { finishTrash(successes, chosen.size() - successes, errors.isEmpty() ? "" : errors.get(0)); return; }
        if (!sameActiveUid()) { errors.add("Tài khoản đã đổi."); finishTrash(successes, chosen.size() - successes, errors.get(0)); return; }
        SmartCleanupMedia item = chosen.get(index);
        if (item.local != null && !verifyLocalStillSame(item.local)) {
            errors.add(item.getName() + ": file local đã biến mất, đổi hoặc không còn quyền truy cập.");
            processTrashItem(chosen, index + 1, successes, errors); return;
        }
        if (item.cloud != null) {
            repository.getPhotoByUserAsync(scanUid, item.cloud.getId(), new PhotoRepository.Callback<Photo>() {
                @Override public void onSuccess(Photo latest) {
                    if (!sameActiveUid()) { errors.add("Tài khoản đã đổi."); processTrashItem(chosen, index + 1, successes, errors); return; }
                    if (latest == null || !scanUid.equals(latest.getOwnerUid()) || latest.isTrashed() || !sameCloudRevision(item.cloud, latest)
                            || (item.local != null && !isStillLinked(item, latest))) {
                        errors.add(item.getName() + ": cloud đã mất, vào Trash, thay đổi hoặc không còn liên kết sau lần quét.");
                        processTrashItem(chosen, index + 1, successes, errors); return;
                    }
                    moveVerifiedItem(chosen, index, successes, errors, item, latest);
                }
                @Override public void onError(String error) {
                    errors.add(item.getName() + ": không thể xác minh cloud; không thay đổi mục này. " + error);
                    processTrashItem(chosen, index + 1, successes, errors);
                }
            });
            return;
        }
        Photo target = null;
        if (item.local != null) {
            target = new Photo(); target.setId(localTrashId(item.local)); target.setOwnerUid("local"); target.setName(item.getName());
            target.setImageUrl(item.local.getContentUri()); target.setMediaType(item.video ? "video" : "image");
            target.setCreatedAt(item.local.getTimelineTimestamp()); target.setLocalMediaUri(item.local.getContentUri());
            target.setLocalMediaId(item.local.getMediaId()); target.setLocalDateModified(item.local.getDateModified());
        }
        if (target == null) {
            errors.add(item.getName() + ": không có tham chiếu hợp lệ.");
            processTrashItem(chosen, index + 1, successes, errors); return;
        }
        moveVerifiedItem(chosen, index, successes, errors, item, target);
    }

    private void moveVerifiedItem(List<SmartCleanupMedia> chosen, int index, int successes, List<String> errors,
                                  SmartCleanupMedia item, Photo target) {
        PhotoTrashManager.moveToTrash(this, scanUid, target, new PhotoTrashManager.Callback() {
            @Override public void onSuccess(Photo moved) {
                item.selected = false;
                processTrashItem(chosen, index + 1, successes + 1, errors);
            }
            @Override public void onError(String error) {
                errors.add(item.getName() + ": " + error);
                processTrashItem(chosen, index + 1, successes, errors);
            }
        });
    }

    private boolean verifyLocalStillSame(LocalMediaPhoto local) {
        Uri uri = Uri.parse(local.getContentUri());
        try (CursorHolder ignored = queryLocal(uri); InputStream input = getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri)) {
            if (ignored.cursor == null || input == null) return false;
            if (!ignored.cursor.moveToFirst()) return false;
            long id = value(ignored.cursor, MediaStore.MediaColumns._ID, -1);
            long size = value(ignored.cursor, MediaStore.MediaColumns.SIZE, -1);
            long modified = value(ignored.cursor, MediaStore.MediaColumns.DATE_MODIFIED, -1);
            if (id != local.getMediaId() || (local.getSizeBytes() > 0 && size != local.getSizeBytes())) return false;
            return local.getDateModified() <= 0 || modified <= 0 || modified * 1000L == local.getDateModified();
        } catch (Exception e) { return false; }
    }

    private CursorHolder queryLocal(Uri uri) { return new CursorHolder(getContentResolver().query(uri, new String[]{MediaStore.MediaColumns._ID, MediaStore.MediaColumns.SIZE, MediaStore.MediaColumns.DATE_MODIFIED}, null, null, null)); }
    private long value(android.database.Cursor cursor, String column, long fallback) { int i = cursor.getColumnIndex(column); return i >= 0 && !cursor.isNull(i) ? cursor.getLong(i) : fallback; }
    private static final class CursorHolder implements AutoCloseable {
        final android.database.Cursor cursor; CursorHolder(android.database.Cursor cursor) { this.cursor = cursor; }
        @Override public void close() { if (cursor != null) cursor.close(); }
    }

    private boolean sameCloudRevision(Photo scanned, Photo latest) {
        if ((scanned.getContentHash() != null || latest.getContentHash() != null)
                && (scanned.getContentHash() == null || latest.getContentHash() == null
                || !scanned.getContentHash().equalsIgnoreCase(latest.getContentHash()))) return false;
        if (!java.util.Objects.equals(scanned.getLocalMediaUri(), latest.getLocalMediaUri())) return false;
        if (scanned.getLocalMediaId() != latest.getLocalMediaId()) return false;
        return scanned.getLocalDateModified() == latest.getLocalDateModified()
                && java.util.Objects.equals(scanned.getImageUrl(), latest.getImageUrl())
                && java.util.Objects.equals(scanned.getStoragePath(), latest.getStoragePath())
                && java.util.Objects.equals(scanned.getMediaType(), latest.getMediaType())
                && java.util.Objects.equals(scanned.getName(), latest.getName());
    }
    private boolean isStillLinked(SmartCleanupMedia item, Photo latest) {
        LocalMediaPhoto local = item.local;
        return java.util.Objects.equals(latest.getLocalMediaUri(), local.getContentUri())
                || (latest.getLocalMediaId() == local.getMediaId() && latest.getLocalDateModified() == local.getDateModified())
                || (item.contentHash != null && latest.getContentHash() != null && item.contentHash.equalsIgnoreCase(latest.getContentHash()));
    }
    private boolean sameActiveUid() { UserInfo active = authRepository.getCurrentUser(); return active != null && scanUid != null && scanUid.equals(active.getId()); }

    private String localTrashId(LocalMediaPhoto local) {
        String uri = local == null || local.getContentUri() == null ? "missing" : local.getContentUri();
        return "local:" + UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(uri.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
    }

    private void finishTrash(int success, int failure, String firstError) {
        trashRunning = false; updateSelectionUi();
        if (adapter != null) adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
        String message = "Đã chuyển " + success + " mục vào Thùng rác" + (failure > 0 ? "; " + failure + " mục chưa xử lý được." : ".");
        if (firstError != null && !firstError.isEmpty()) message += " " + firstError;
        setStatus(message); Toast.makeText(this, message, failure > 0 ? Toast.LENGTH_LONG : Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
    }

    @Override protected void onDestroy() {
        if (scanSession != null) scanSession.cancel();
        if (scanUid != null && !sameActiveUid()) SmartCleanupScanner.clearLatestForUid(scanUid);
        scanGeneration++;
        binding = null;
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}


SplashActivity.java
package com.example.th6.activities;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.text.TextUtils;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;

import com.example.th6.MainActivity;
import com.example.th6.R;
import com.example.th6.data.AuthRepository;
import com.example.th6.utils.PreferencesManager;
import com.example.th6.utils.VideoSaveUtils;

public class SplashActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private final Handler handler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private Runnable sessionCheck;
    private boolean navigated;
    private String interruptedVideoRecoveryError;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        PreferencesManager prefs = new PreferencesManager(this);
        PreferencesManager.applyTheme(prefs.isDarkMode());

        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_splash);

        AuthRepository authRepository = new AuthRepository();
        sessionCheck = () -> {
            if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed() || navigated) return;
            authRepository.checkIsLoggedInAsync(new AuthRepository.SessionCallback() {
                @Override
                public void onResult(boolean isLoggedIn, String userId, String errorMessage) {
                    if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed() || navigated) return;
                    Intent intent;
                    if (isLoggedIn) {
                        intent = new Intent(SplashActivity.this, MainActivity.class);
                    } else {
                        intent = new Intent(SplashActivity.this, LoginActivity.class);
                    }
                    if (!TextUtils.isEmpty(errorMessage)) {
                        intent.putExtra("auth_session_error", errorMessage);
                    }
                    navigated = true;
                    startActivity(intent);
                    if (interruptedVideoRecoveryError != null) {
                        android.widget.Toast.makeText(SplashActivity.this, interruptedVideoRecoveryError,
                                android.widget.Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                    }
                    finish();
                }
            });
        };
        new Thread(() -> {
            interruptedVideoRecoveryError = VideoSaveUtils.recoverInterruptedOverwrite(getApplicationContext());
            handler.postDelayed(sessionCheck, 1200);
        }, "video-overwrite-recovery").start();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        if (sessionCheck != null) handler.removeCallbacks(sessionCheck);
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}


TrashDetailActivity.java
package com.example.th6.activities;

import android.Manifest;
import android.app.Activity;
import android.app.PendingIntent;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.provider.MediaStore;
import android.text.format.Formatter;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.activity.result.ActivityResultLauncher;
import androidx.activity.result.IntentSenderRequest;
import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat;

import com.bumptech.glide.Glide;
import com.bumptech.glide.load.DataSource;
import com.bumptech.glide.load.engine.GlideException;
import com.bumptech.glide.request.RequestListener;
import com.bumptech.glide.request.target.Target;
import com.example.th6.data.AuthRepository;
import com.example.th6.data.PhotoRepository;
import com.example.th6.data.StorageRepository;
import com.example.th6.databinding.ActivityTrashDetailBinding;
import com.example.th6.models.Photo;
import com.example.th6.utils.PhotoVaultTrashCache;
import io.github.jan.supabase.auth.user.UserInfo;
import androidx.media3.common.MediaItem;
import androidx.media3.common.PlaybackException;
import androidx.media3.common.Player;
import androidx.media3.exoplayer.ExoPlayer;

import java.text.DateFormat;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Date;

public class TrashDetailActivity extends AppCompatActivity {
    public static final String EXTRA_PHOTO = "trash_photo";

    private enum LocalState { EXISTS, MISSING, UNKNOWN }

    private ActivityTrashDetailBinding binding;
    private Photo photo;
    private PhotoRepository photoRepository;
    private StorageRepository storageRepository;
    private AuthRepository authRepository;
    private ActivityResultLauncher<IntentSenderRequest> deleteMediaLauncher;
    private ActivityResultLauncher<String> writePermissionLauncher;
    private ExoPlayer player;
    private boolean operationRunning;
    private boolean cloudObjectDeleted;
    private boolean usingLocalVideo;
    private boolean waitingForQDeleteConsent;

    public static Intent createIntent(android.content.Context context, Photo photo) {
        Intent intent = new Intent(context, TrashDetailActivity.class);
        intent.putExtra(EXTRA_PHOTO, photo);
        return intent;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(@Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        binding = ActivityTrashDetailBinding.inflate(getLayoutInflater());
        setContentView(binding.getRoot());
        photoRepository = new PhotoRepository();
        storageRepository = new StorageRepository();
        authRepository = new AuthRepository();

        deleteMediaLauncher = registerForActivityResult(new ActivityResultContracts.StartIntentSenderForResult(), result -> {
            if (result.getResultCode() == Activity.RESULT_OK) {
                if (waitingForQDeleteConsent) {
                    waitingForQDeleteConsent = false;
                    deleteLocalOnQ(false);
                } else if (isLocalOnly()) {
                    completeLocalOnlyPermanentDelete();
                } else {
                    cloudObjectDeleted = false;
                    binding.tvSourceStatus.setText("Đã xóa bản local; đang xóa bản cloud…");
                    deleteCloudSource();
                }
            } else {
                finishOperation("Đã hủy xác nhận. Các bản còn lại vẫn được giữ.");
            }
        });
        writePermissionLauncher = registerForActivityResult(new ActivityResultContracts.RequestPermission(), granted -> {
            if (granted) deleteLocalOnLegacy();
            else finishOperation("Chưa được cấp quyền xóa local. Bản cloud và metadata vẫn được giữ.");
        });

        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33) photo = getIntent().getSerializableExtra(EXTRA_PHOTO, Photo.class);
        else {
            //noinspection deprecation
            photo = (Photo) getIntent().getSerializableExtra(EXTRA_PHOTO);
        }
        if (photo == null) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Không tìm thấy mục trong thùng rác", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            finish();
            return;
        }
        bindMetadata();
        binding.btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        binding.btnInfo.setOnClickListener(v -> showInfo());
        binding.btnRestore.setOnClickListener(v -> restore());
        binding.btnDeletePermanently.setOnClickListener(v -> confirmPermanentDelete());
        showMedia();
    }

    private void bindMetadata() {
        binding.tvItemName.setText(photo.getName() == null || photo.getName().isBlank() ? "Không có tên" : photo.getName());
        LocalState state = localState();
        String local = state == LocalState.EXISTS ? "Local: có thể truy cập"
                : state == LocalState.MISSING ? "Local: không còn trong MediaStore" : "Local: chưa xác minh được";
        binding.tvSourceStatus.setText(local + "  •  Cloud: " + (hasCloudUrl() ? "có metadata" : "không có URL"));
    }

    private boolean isVideo() { return "video".equalsIgnoreCase(photo.getMediaType()); }
    private boolean isLocalOnly() { return photo != null && "local".equals(photo.getOwnerUid()); }
    private boolean hasCloudUrl() { return photo.getImageUrl() != null && photo.getImageUrl().startsWith("http"); }

    private LocalState localState() {
        String localUri = photo.getLocalMediaUri();
        if (localUri == null || localUri.isBlank()) return LocalState.MISSING;
        Uri uri;
        try { uri = Uri.parse(localUri); }
        catch (Exception e) { return LocalState.UNKNOWN; }
        if (!"content".equalsIgnoreCase(uri.getScheme()) || uri.getAuthority() == null
                || !uri.getAuthority().contains("media")) return LocalState.UNKNOWN;
        try (Cursor cursor = getContentResolver().query(uri, new String[]{MediaStore.MediaColumns._ID}, null, null, null)) {
            return cursor != null && cursor.moveToFirst() ? LocalState.EXISTS : LocalState.MISSING;
        } catch (Exception e) { return LocalState.UNKNOWN; }
    }

    private void showMedia() {
        LocalState state = localState();
        Uri localUri = photo.getLocalMediaUri() == null || photo.getLocalMediaUri().isBlank()
                ? null : Uri.parse(photo.getLocalMediaUri());
        Uri cloudUri = hasCloudUrl() ? Uri.parse(photo.getImageUrl()) : null;
        Uri source = state == LocalState.EXISTS || state == LocalState.UNKNOWN ? localUri : null;
        if (source == null) source = cloudUri;
        if (source == null) {
            showPreviewError("Không thể truy cập bản local hoặc cloud. Thông tin và thao tác thùng rác vẫn khả dụng.");
            return;
        }
        if (isVideo()) showVideo(source, localUri, cloudUri);
        else showImage(source, localUri, cloudUri);
    }

    private void showImage(Uri source, Uri localUri, Uri cloudUri) {
        binding.playerView.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        binding.imgPreview.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        binding.tvPreviewStatus.setText("Đang tải ảnh…");
        Glide.with(this).load(source).listener(new RequestListener<android.graphics.drawable.Drawable>() {
            @Override public boolean onLoadFailed(@Nullable GlideException e, Object model, Target<android.graphics.drawable.Drawable> target, boolean isFirstResource) {
                if (localUri != null && source.equals(localUri) && cloudUri != null && !cloudUri.equals(localUri)) {
                    loadCloudImage(cloudUri);
                } else showPreviewError("Không thể tải ảnh từ các nguồn còn lại.");
                return true;
            }
            @Override public boolean onResourceReady(android.graphics.drawable.Drawable resource, Object model, Target<android.graphics.drawable.Drawable> target, DataSource dataSource, boolean isFirstResource) {
                binding.tvPreviewStatus.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                return false;
            }
        }).into(binding.imgPreview);
    }

    private void loadCloudImage(Uri cloudUri) {
        binding.tvPreviewStatus.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        binding.tvPreviewStatus.setText("Bản local không mở được; đang thử bản cloud…");
        Glide.with(this).load(cloudUri).listener(new RequestListener<android.graphics.drawable.Drawable>() {
            @Override public boolean onLoadFailed(@Nullable GlideException e, Object model, Target<android.graphics.drawable.Drawable> target, boolean isFirstResource) {
                showPreviewError("Không thể tải ảnh local hoặc cloud.");
                return true;
            }
            @Override public boolean onResourceReady(android.graphics.drawable.Drawable resource, Object model, Target<android.graphics.drawable.Drawable> target, DataSource dataSource, boolean isFirstResource) {
                binding.tvPreviewStatus.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                return false;
            }
        }).into(binding.imgPreview);
    }

    private void showVideo(Uri source, Uri localUri, Uri cloudUri) {
        binding.imgPreview.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        binding.playerView.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        binding.tvPreviewStatus.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        binding.tvPreviewStatus.setText("Đang mở video…");
        usingLocalVideo = localUri != null && source.equals(localUri);
        player = new ExoPlayer.Builder(this).build();
        binding.playerView.setPlayer(player);
        player.addListener(new Player.Listener() {
            @Override public void onRenderedFirstFrame() { binding.tvPreviewStatus.setVisibility(View.GONE); }
            @Override public void onPlayerError(PlaybackException error) {
                if (usingLocalVideo && cloudUri != null && !cloudUri.equals(source)) {
                    usingLocalVideo = false;
                    binding.tvPreviewStatus.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                    binding.tvPreviewStatus.setText("Bản local không phát được; đang thử bản cloud…");
                    player.setMediaItem(MediaItem.fromUri(cloudUri));
                    player.prepare();
                    player.play();
                } else showPreviewError("Không thể phát video từ các nguồn còn lại.");
            }
        });
        player.setMediaItem(MediaItem.fromUri(source));
        player.prepare();
        player.play();
    }

    private void showPreviewError(String message) {
        binding.imgPreview.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        binding.playerView.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        binding.tvPreviewStatus.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        binding.tvPreviewStatus.setText(message);
    }

    private void restore() {
        if (operationRunning) return;
        if (isLocalOnly()) {
            PhotoVaultTrashCache.remove(getApplicationContext(), "local", photo.getId());
            Toast.makeText(this, "Đã khôi phục mục local; file gốc vẫn ở trên thiết bị.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            setResult(Activity.RESULT_OK);
            finish();
            return;
        }
        UserInfo user = authRepository.getCurrentUser();
        if (user == null) { showMessage("Đăng nhập lại để khôi phục bản cloud."); return; }
        LocalState local = localState();
        setBusy(true);
        binding.tvSourceStatus.setText("Đang khôi phục trạng thái cloud…");
        photoRepository.moveToTrashAsync(user.getId(), photo.getId(), false, new PhotoRepository.Callback<Void>() {
            @Override public void onSuccess(Void result) {
                PhotoVaultTrashCache.remove(getApplicationContext(), user.getId(), photo.getId());
                String message = local == LocalState.EXISTS
                        ? "Đã khôi phục bản cloud; file local vẫn còn trên thiết bị."
                        : local == LocalState.MISSING
                        ? "Đã khôi phục bản cloud. File local đã bị xóa và không được khôi phục về thiết bị."
                        : "Đã khôi phục bản cloud. Không xác minh được trạng thái file local.";
                Toast.makeText(TrashDetailActivity.this, message, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                setResult(Activity.RESULT_OK);
                finish();
            }
            @Override public void onError(String error) {
                setBusy(false);
                binding.tvSourceStatus.setText("Khôi phục thất bại. Mục vẫn ở trong thùng rác.");
                showMessage("Không khôi phục được bản cloud: " + error);
            }
        });
    }
    private void confirmPermanentDelete() {
        if (operationRunning) return;
        LocalState local = localState();
        String scope = isLocalOnly()
                ? (local == LocalState.EXISTS ? "File local sẽ bị xóa vĩnh viễn khỏi thiết bị; không có bản cloud."
                : local == LocalState.MISSING ? "File local không còn tồn tại; metadata Trash sẽ bị xóa."
                : "Không xác minh được file local; mục sẽ được giữ nếu không thể xóa an toàn.")
                : local == LocalState.EXISTS ? "Bản local và bản cloud sẽ bị xóa vĩnh viễn."
                : local == LocalState.MISSING ? "Bản cloud sẽ bị xóa vĩnh viễn. Không tìm thấy bản local trên thiết bị."
                : "Không xác minh được bản local. Xác nhận sẽ không bỏ qua lỗi xóa local; bản cloud chỉ được xử lý sau khi kiểm tra nguồn.";
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle("Xóa vĩnh viễn?")
                .setMessage(scope + " Thao tác này không thể hoàn tác.")
                .setNegativeButton("Hủy", null)
                .setPositiveButton("Xóa vĩnh viễn", (dialog, which) -> beginPermanentDelete(local))
                .show();
    }
    private void beginPermanentDelete(LocalState local) {
        if (operationRunning) return;
        if (local == LocalState.UNKNOWN) {
            binding.tvSourceStatus.setText("Không xác minh được URI local; chưa xóa nguồn nào. Kiểm tra quyền truy cập rồi thử lại.");
            return;
        }
        setBusy(true);
        if (local == LocalState.MISSING) {
            if (isLocalOnly()) {
                PhotoVaultTrashCache.remove(getApplicationContext(), "local", photo.getId());
                Toast.makeText(this, "Đã xóa metadata thùng rác; file local không còn tồn tại.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                setResult(Activity.RESULT_OK);
                finish();
                return;
            }
            binding.tvSourceStatus.setText("Không còn bản local; đang xóa bản cloud…");
            deleteCloudSource();
            return;
        }
        Uri uri = Uri.parse(photo.getLocalMediaUri());
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
            try {
                PendingIntent request = MediaStore.createDeleteRequest(getContentResolver(), Collections.singletonList(uri));
                binding.tvSourceStatus.setText("Chờ xác nhận xóa bản local của Android…");
                deleteMediaLauncher.launch(new IntentSenderRequest.Builder(request.getIntentSender()).build());
            } catch (Exception e) {
                setBusy(false);
                binding.tvSourceStatus.setText("Không thể yêu cầu quyền xóa local. Bản cloud chưa bị xóa.");
            }
        } else if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT == Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) deleteLocalOnQ(true);
        else if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            binding.tvSourceStatus.setText("Cần quyền Android để xóa bản local…");
            writePermissionLauncher.launch(Manifest.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE);
        } else deleteLocalOnLegacy();
    }

    private void deleteLocalOnQ(boolean allowConsent) {
        Uri uri = Uri.parse(photo.getLocalMediaUri());
        try {
            int rows = getContentResolver().delete(uri, null, null);
            if (rows > 0 || localState() == LocalState.MISSING) {
                if (isLocalOnly()) { completeLocalOnlyPermanentDelete(); return; }
                binding.tvSourceStatus.setText("Đã xóa bản local; đang xóa bản cloud…");
                deleteCloudSource();
            } else localDeleteFailed("MediaStore không xóa được bản local.");
        } catch (android.app.RecoverableSecurityException recoverable) {
            if (!allowConsent) { localDeleteFailed("Android chưa cấp quyền xóa bản local."); return; }
            try {
                waitingForQDeleteConsent = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT == Build.VERSION_CODES.Q;
                deleteMediaLauncher.launch(new IntentSenderRequest.Builder(recoverable.getUserAction().getActionIntent().getIntentSender()).build());
            } catch (Exception e) { localDeleteFailed("Không thể mở xác nhận xóa của Android."); }
        } catch (Exception e) { localDeleteFailed("Lỗi MediaStore; bản cloud chưa bị xóa."); }
    }

    private void deleteLocalOnLegacy() {
        Uri uri = Uri.parse(photo.getLocalMediaUri());
        try {
            int rows = getContentResolver().delete(uri, null, null);
            if (rows > 0 || localState() == LocalState.MISSING) {
                if (isLocalOnly()) { completeLocalOnlyPermanentDelete(); return; }
                binding.tvSourceStatus.setText("Đã xóa bản local; đang xóa bản cloud…");
                deleteCloudSource();
            } else localDeleteFailed("MediaStore không xóa được bản local.");
        } catch (Exception e) { localDeleteFailed("Lỗi MediaStore; bản cloud chưa bị xóa."); }
    }

    private void localDeleteFailed(String message) {
        setBusy(false);
        binding.tvSourceStatus.setText(message + " Bản cloud và metadata vẫn được giữ; có thể thử lại.");
        showMessage(message);
    }

    private void completeLocalOnlyPermanentDelete() {
        LocalState state = localState();
        if (state != LocalState.MISSING) {
            finishOperation(state == LocalState.EXISTS
                    ? "MediaStore vẫn báo file tồn tại sau thao tác xóa; mục vẫn nằm trong thùng rác."
                    : "Không xác minh được file đã xóa; mục vẫn nằm trong thùng rác.");
            return;
        }
        PhotoVaultTrashCache.remove(getApplicationContext(), "local", photo.getId());
        Toast.makeText(this, "Đã xóa vĩnh viễn file local.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        setResult(Activity.RESULT_OK);
        finish();
    }
    private void deleteCloudSource() {
        UserInfo user = authRepository.getCurrentUser();
        if (user == null) { cloudDeleteFailed("Đăng nhập lại để xóa bản cloud."); return; }
        String provider = photo.getStorageProvider();
        String path = photo.getStoragePath();
        if (path == null || path.isBlank()) path = storageRepository.objectPathFromPublicUrl(photo.getImageUrl());
        if (!"supabase".equalsIgnoreCase(provider) || path == null || path.isBlank()) {
            cloudDeleteFailed("Không có đường dẫn Supabase có thể xóa an toàn. Bản local đã xử lý nếu có; metadata vẫn được giữ.");
            return;
        }
        if (cloudObjectDeleted) { deleteMetadata(user.getId()); return; }
        binding.tvSourceStatus.setText("Đang xóa bản cloud…");
        storageRepository.deleteImageAsync(path, new StorageRepository.DeleteCallback() {
            @Override public void onSuccess() {
                cloudObjectDeleted = true;
                deleteMetadata(user.getId());
            }
            @Override public void onError(String error) { cloudDeleteFailed("Không xóa được bản cloud: " + error); }
        });
    }

    private void deleteMetadata(String uid) {
        binding.tvSourceStatus.setText("Đã xóa bản cloud; đang xóa metadata…");
        photoRepository.deletePhotoAsync(uid, photo.getId(), new PhotoRepository.Callback<Void>() {
            @Override public void onSuccess(Void result) {
                PhotoVaultTrashCache.remove(getApplicationContext(), uid, photo.getId());
                Toast.makeText(TrashDetailActivity.this, "Đã xóa vĩnh viễn các nguồn có thể truy cập.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                setResult(Activity.RESULT_OK);
                finish();
            }
            @Override public void onError(String error) {
                setBusy(false);
                binding.tvSourceStatus.setText("Bản cloud đã xóa; metadata còn lại. Nhấn xóa lại để thử đồng bộ metadata.");
                showMessage("Không xóa được metadata: " + error);
            }
        });
    }

    private void cloudDeleteFailed(String message) {
        setBusy(false);
        binding.tvSourceStatus.setText(message + " Metadata vẫn được giữ để thử lại.");
        showMessage(message);
    }

    private void showInfo() {
        LocalState local = localState();
        String unknown = "Không có dữ liệu";
        String date = photo.getCreatedAt() > 0 ? DateFormat.getDateTimeInstance().format(new Date(photo.getCreatedAt())) : unknown;
        String size = getLocalSize();
        String type = photo.getMediaType() == null || photo.getMediaType().isBlank() ? unknown : photo.getMediaType();
        String sources = "Local: " + (local == LocalState.EXISTS ? "có thể truy cập" : local == LocalState.MISSING ? "không còn" : "chưa xác minh")
                + "\nCloud: " + (hasCloudUrl() ? "có URL trong metadata" : "không có URL");
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle("Thông tin mục trong thùng rác")
                .setMessage("Tên: " + (photo.getName() == null ? unknown : photo.getName())
                        + "\nLoại: " + type
                        + "\nNgày ghi nhận: " + date
                        + "\nDung lượng local: " + size
                        + "\n" + sources)
                .setPositiveButton("Đóng", null)
                .show();
    }

    private String getLocalSize() {
        if (localState() != LocalState.EXISTS) return "Không có dữ liệu đáng tin cậy";
        Uri uri = Uri.parse(photo.getLocalMediaUri());
        try (Cursor cursor = getContentResolver().query(uri, new String[]{MediaStore.MediaColumns.SIZE}, null, null, null)) {
            if (cursor != null && cursor.moveToFirst() && !cursor.isNull(0)) {
                long bytes = cursor.getLong(0);
                if (bytes > 0) return Formatter.formatFileSize(this, bytes);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        return "Không có dữ liệu đáng tin cậy";
    }

    private void setBusy(boolean busy) {
        operationRunning = busy;
        binding.btnRestore.setEnabled(!busy);
        binding.btnDeletePermanently.setEnabled(!busy);
        binding.btnInfo.setEnabled(!busy);
    }

    private void finishOperation(String message) {
        setBusy(false);
        binding.tvSourceStatus.setText(message);
    }

    private void showMessage(String message) { Toast.makeText(this, message, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show(); }

    @Override protected void onStop() {
        super.onStop();
        if (player != null) player.pause();
    }

    @Override protected void onDestroy() {
        super.onDestroy();
        if (player != null) { player.release(); player = null; }
        if (binding != null) binding.playerView.setPlayer(null);
        binding = null;
    }
}


VideoEditorActivity.java
package com.example.th6.activities;

import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.drawable.BitmapDrawable;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.Manifest;
import android.content.IntentSender;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.media.MediaMetadataRetriever;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.SeekBar;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.activity.result.ActivityResultLauncher;
import androidx.activity.result.IntentSenderRequest;
import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts;
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat;
import androidx.media3.common.MediaItem;
import androidx.media3.common.PlaybackException;
import androidx.media3.common.Player;

import com.example.th6.R;
import com.example.th6.databinding.ActivityVideoEditorBinding;
import com.example.th6.models.LocalMediaPhoto;

import com.example.th6.utils.MutablePreviewRgbMatrix;

import com.google.android.material.chip.Chip;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class VideoEditorActivity extends AppCompatActivity {
    private static final String STATE_TRIM_START = "video_editor_trim_start";
    private static final String STATE_TRIM_END = "video_editor_trim_end";
    private static final String STATE_ADJUSTMENTS = "video_editor_adjustments";
    private static final String STATE_FILTER = "video_editor_filter";
    private static final String STATE_MUTE = "video_editor_mute";
    private static final String STATE_POSITION = "video_editor_position";
    private static final String STATE_MODE = "video_editor_mode";
    private static final String STATE_PLAYING = "video_editor_playing";

    private static final int[] ADJUSTMENT_DEFAULTS = {100, 50, 100, 30, 100, 100, 100};
    private static final int[] ADJUSTMENT_MAXIMUMS = {200, 150, 200, 60, 200, 200, 200};
    private static final int[] ADJUSTMENT_LABELS = {
            R.string.video_editor_adjustment_brightness,
            R.string.video_editor_adjustment_contrast,
            R.string.video_editor_adjustment_saturation,
            R.string.video_editor_adjustment_exposure,
            R.string.video_editor_adjustment_highlights,
            R.string.video_editor_adjustment_shadows,
            R.string.video_editor_adjustment_temperature
    };
    private static final int[] FILTER_LABELS = {
            R.string.video_editor_filter_original,
            R.string.video_editor_filter_vivid,
            R.string.video_editor_filter_warm,
            R.string.video_editor_filter_cool,
            R.string.video_editor_filter_mono,
            R.string.video_editor_filter_contrast,
            R.string.video_editor_filter_blur
    };

    private final Handler mainHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private final ExecutorService thumbnailExecutor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
    private final int[] adjustmentValues = ADJUSTMENT_DEFAULTS.clone();
    private final List<MaterialCardView> filterCards = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<Bitmap> timelineBitmaps = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<Bitmap> filterBitmaps = new ArrayList<>();
    private final Runnable playbackTicker = new Runnable() {
        @Override public void run() {
            if (player != null && binding != null && player.getPlaybackState() == Player.STATE_READY) {
                long position = player.getCurrentPosition();
                if (player.isPlaying() && trimEndMs > trimStartMs
                        && (position < trimStartMs || position >= trimEndMs)) {
                    player.seekTo(trimStartMs);
                    position = trimStartMs;
                }
                binding.trimTimeline.setPlayhead(position);
                mainHandler.postDelayed(this, 100L);
            }
        }
    };

    private ActivityVideoEditorBinding binding;
    private ExoPlayer player;
    private final MutablePreviewRgbMatrix previewColorMatrix = new MutablePreviewRgbMatrix();
    private LocalMediaPhoto videoItem;
    private Uri videoUri;
    private Bitmap filterSourceBitmap;
    private long totalDurationMs;
    private long trimStartMs;
    private long trimEndMs;
    private long restoredPositionMs;
    private int selectedFilter;
    private int activeAdjustment;
    private int restoredMode = R.id.btnTabTrim;
    private boolean timelineInitialized;
    private boolean restoringState;
    private boolean exporting;
    private boolean resumePlaybackOnStart;
    private boolean shouldResumeAfterRestore;
    private boolean restoredMuteAudio;
    private boolean overwritePermissionGranted;
    private boolean resumeAfterOverwriteError;
    private boolean restorePlayerAfterOverwriteError;
    private ActivityResultLauncher<IntentSenderRequest> overwriteConsentLauncher;
    private ActivityResultLauncher<String> legacyWritePermissionLauncher;

    @Override protected void onCreate(Bundle state) {
        super.onCreate(state);
        overwriteConsentLauncher = registerForActivityResult(new ActivityResultContracts.StartIntentSenderForResult(), result -> {
            if (result.getResultCode() == RESULT_OK) {
                overwritePermissionGranted = true;
                beginOverwrite();
            }
            else Toast.makeText(this, "Chưa cấp quyền ghi đè; video gốc chưa bị thay đổi.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        });
        legacyWritePermissionLauncher = registerForActivityResult(new ActivityResultContracts.RequestPermission(), granted -> {
            if (granted) beginOverwrite();
            else Toast.makeText(this, "Cần quyền ghi bộ nhớ để lưu đè video local.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        });
        binding = ActivityVideoEditorBinding.inflate(getLayoutInflater());
        setContentView(binding.getRoot());

        if (getIntent().hasExtra("video")) {
            videoItem = (LocalMediaPhoto) getIntent().getSerializableExtra("video");
            if (videoItem != null) {
                totalDurationMs = Math.max(0L, videoItem.getDurationMs());
                trimEndMs = totalDurationMs;
            }
        }
        String source = getIntent().getStringExtra("video_uri");
        if (source != null && !source.isEmpty()) videoUri = Uri.parse(source);
        else if (videoItem != null && videoItem.getContentUri() != null && !videoItem.getContentUri().isEmpty()) {
            videoUri = Uri.parse(videoItem.getContentUri());
        }
        if (videoUri == null) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Không tìm thấy video để chỉnh sửa", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            finish();
            return;
        }

        if (state != null) restoreState(state);
        setupControls();
        binding.btnOverwrite.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        binding.btnOverwrite.setEnabled(canOverwriteLocal());
        binding.btnOverwrite.setAlpha(canOverwriteLocal() ? 1f : 0.55f);
        if (!canOverwriteLocal()) binding.btnOverwrite.setContentDescription(getString(R.string.video_editor_overwrite_local_only));
        binding.btnOverwrite.setOnClickListener(v -> confirmOverwrite());
        if (VideoSaveUtils.hasPendingOverwriteRecovery(this)) {
            binding.btnSaveCopy.setEnabled(false);
            binding.btnOverwrite.setEnabled(false);
            binding.progressBar.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            binding.tvExportProgress.setText("Đang khôi phục video gốc…");
            VideoSaveUtils.recoverInterruptedOverwriteAsync(this, error -> {
                if (binding == null || isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                binding.progressBar.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                if (error != null) {
                    binding.tvExportProgress.setText("Khôi phục video cần xử lý");
                    Toast.makeText(this, error, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                } else {
                    binding.btnSaveCopy.setEnabled(true);
                    restoreOverwriteButtonState();
                    setupPlayer();
                }
            });
        } else {
            setupPlayer();
        }
    }

    private void restoreState(Bundle state) {
        restoringState = true;
        trimStartMs = Math.max(0L, state.getLong(STATE_TRIM_START, trimStartMs));
        long savedEnd = state.getLong(STATE_TRIM_END, trimEndMs);
        if (savedEnd > 0L) trimEndMs = savedEnd;
        int[] savedAdjustments = state.getIntArray(STATE_ADJUSTMENTS);
        if (savedAdjustments != null && savedAdjustments.length == adjustmentValues.length) {
            System.arraycopy(savedAdjustments, 0, adjustmentValues, 0, adjustmentValues.length);
        }
        selectedFilter = Math.max(0, Math.min(FILTER_LABELS.length - 1, state.getInt(STATE_FILTER, 0)));
        restoredPositionMs = Math.max(0L, state.getLong(STATE_POSITION, 0L));
        shouldResumeAfterRestore = state.getBoolean(STATE_PLAYING, false);
        restoredMode = state.getInt(STATE_MODE, R.id.btnTabTrim);
        activeAdjustment = Math.max(0, Math.min(ADJUSTMENT_LABELS.length - 1, state.getInt("video_editor_active_adjustment", 0)));
        restoredMuteAudio = state.getBoolean(STATE_MUTE, false);
    }

    private void setupControls() {
        binding.btnCancel.setOnClickListener(v -> confirmCancel());
        binding.btnSaveCopy.setOnClickListener(v -> export());
        binding.modeTabs.addOnButtonCheckedListener((group, checkedId, isChecked) -> {
            if (!isChecked) return;
            if (checkedId == R.id.btnTabTrim) showMode(0);
            else if (checkedId == R.id.btnTabAdjust) showMode(1);
            else if (checkedId == R.id.btnTabFilters) showMode(2);
        });

        binding.trimTimeline.setListener(new com.example.th6.views.VideoTrimTimelineView.Listener() {
            @Override public void onRangeChanged(long startMs, long endMs) {
                trimStartMs = startMs;
                trimEndMs = endMs;
                updateTrimLabels();
                if (player != null && (player.getCurrentPosition() < trimStartMs || player.getCurrentPosition() > trimEndMs)) {
                    player.seekTo(trimStartMs);
                }
            }

            @Override public void onPlayheadChanged(long positionMs) {
                if (player != null) player.seekTo(Math.max(trimStartMs, Math.min(trimEndMs, positionMs)));
            }
        });

        setupAdjustmentChips();
        binding.sbActiveAdjustment.setOnSeekBarChangeListener(new SeekBar.OnSeekBarChangeListener() {
            @Override public void onProgressChanged(SeekBar seekBar, int progress, boolean fromUser) {
                adjustmentValues[activeAdjustment] = progress;
                updateAdjustmentValue();
            }
            @Override public void onStartTrackingTouch(SeekBar seekBar) { }
            @Override public void onStopTrackingTouch(SeekBar seekBar) { schedulePreviewEffects(); }
        });
        binding.btnResetAdjustments.setOnClickListener(v -> resetAdjustments());
        binding.switchMuteAudio.setOnCheckedChangeListener((button, checked) -> {
            if (player != null) player.setVolume(checked ? 0f : 1f);
        });

        setupFilterCards();
        binding.switchMuteAudio.setChecked(restoredMuteAudio);
        if (restoringState) binding.modeTabs.check(restoredMode);
        updateTrimLabels();
        showMode(restoredMode == R.id.btnTabAdjust ? 1 : restoredMode == R.id.btnTabFilters ? 2 : 0);
        restoringState = false;
    }

    private void setupAdjustmentChips() {
        for (int i = 0; i < ADJUSTMENT_LABELS.length; i++) {
            final int index = i;
            Chip chip = new Chip(this);
            chip.setId(View.generateViewId());
            chip.setText(ADJUSTMENT_LABELS[i]);
            chip.setCheckable(true);
            chip.setClickable(true);
            chip.setEnsureMinTouchTargetSize(true);
            chip.setOnClickListener(v -> selectAdjustment(index));
            binding.adjustmentChooser.addView(chip);
        }
        selectAdjustment(activeAdjustment);
    }

    private void selectAdjustment(int index) {
        activeAdjustment = Math.max(0, Math.min(ADJUSTMENT_LABELS.length - 1, index));
        for (int i = 0; i < binding.adjustmentChooser.getChildCount(); i++) {
            View child = binding.adjustmentChooser.getChildAt(i);
            if (child instanceof Chip) ((Chip) child).setChecked(i == activeAdjustment);
        }
        binding.sbActiveAdjustment.setMax(ADJUSTMENT_MAXIMUMS[activeAdjustment]);
        binding.sbActiveAdjustment.setProgress(adjustmentValues[activeAdjustment]);
        updateAdjustmentValue();
    }

    private void updateAdjustmentValue() {
        if (binding == null) return;
        binding.tvActiveAdjustment.setText(ADJUSTMENT_LABELS[activeAdjustment]);
        int value = adjustmentValues[activeAdjustment];
        String label;
        switch (activeAdjustment) {
            case 0: label = Integer.toString(value - 100); break;
            case 1: label = String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%.2f", .5f + value / 100f); break;
            case 2: label = String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%.2f", value / 100f); break;
            case 3: label = String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%.1f EV", (value - 30) / 10f); break;
            default: label = Integer.toString(value - 100); break;
        }
        binding.tvActiveAdjustmentValue.setText(label);
    }

    private void resetAdjustments() {
        System.arraycopy(ADJUSTMENT_DEFAULTS, 0, adjustmentValues, 0, adjustmentValues.length);
        selectAdjustment(activeAdjustment);
        schedulePreviewEffects();
    }

    private void setupFilterCards() {
        int horizontalMargin = dp(4);
        for (int i = 0; i < FILTER_LABELS.length; i++) {
            final int index = i;
            MaterialCardView card = new MaterialCardView(this);
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams cardParams = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dp(92), dp(100));
            cardParams.setMarginEnd(horizontalMargin);
            card.setLayoutParams(cardParams);
            card.setRadius(dp(12));
            card.setCardElevation(dp(1));
            card.setClickable(true);
            card.setFocusable(true);
            card.setContentDescription(getString(FILTER_LABELS[i]));

            android.widget.LinearLayout content = new android.widget.LinearLayout(this);
            content.setOrientation(android.widget.LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
            android.widget.ImageView thumbnail = new android.widget.ImageView(this);
            thumbnail.setId(View.generateViewId());
            thumbnail.setTag("filter_thumbnail_" + i);
            thumbnail.setScaleType(android.widget.ImageView.ScaleType.CENTER_CROP);
            content.addView(thumbnail, new android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, dp(68)));
            android.widget.TextView title = new android.widget.TextView(this);
            title.setText(FILTER_LABELS[i]);
            title.setTextColor(resolveThemeColor(com.google.android.material.R.attr.colorOnSurface));
            title.setTextSize(11f);
            title.setGravity(android.view.Gravity.CENTER);
            title.setMaxLines(1);
            content.addView(title, new android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, 0, 1f));
            card.addView(content);
            card.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                selectedFilter = index;
                updateFilterCardSelection();
                schedulePreviewEffects();
            });
            filterCards.add(card);
            binding.filterOptions.addView(card);
        }
        updateFilterCardSelection();
    }

    private void updateFilterCardSelection() {
        if (binding == null) return;
        int selectedColor = resolveThemeColor(androidx.appcompat.R.attr.colorPrimary);
        int surfaceColor = resolveThemeColor(com.google.android.material.R.attr.colorSurface);
        int outlineColor = resolveThemeColor(com.google.android.material.R.attr.colorOutline);
        for (int i = 0; i < filterCards.size(); i++) {
            MaterialCardView card = filterCards.get(i);
            boolean selected = i == selectedFilter;
            card.setStrokeWidth(dp(selected ? 2 : 1));
            card.setStrokeColor(selected ? selectedColor : outlineColor);
            card.setCardBackgroundColor(selected
                    ? resolveThemeColor(com.google.android.material.R.attr.colorPrimaryContainer) : surfaceColor);
        }
    }

    private void showMode(int mode) {
        if (binding == null) return;
        binding.panelTrim.setVisibility(mode == 0 ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        binding.panelAdjust.setVisibility(mode == 1 ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        binding.panelFilters.setVisibility(mode == 2 ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
    }

    private void setupPlayer() {
        player = new ExoPlayer.Builder(this).build();
        binding.editorPlayerView.setPlayer(player);
        player.addListener(new Player.Listener() {
            @Override public void onPlaybackStateChanged(int playbackState) {
                if (playbackState == Player.STATE_READY && !timelineInitialized) initializeTimeline();
                else if (playbackState == Player.STATE_READY && restorePlayerAfterOverwriteError) {
                    player.seekTo(Math.min(restoredPositionMs, totalDurationMs));
                    if (resumeAfterOverwriteError) player.play();
                    resumeAfterOverwriteError = false;
                    restorePlayerAfterOverwriteError = false;
                }
            }

            @Override public void onPlayerError(PlaybackException error) {
                if (binding != null) binding.tvExportProgress.setText("Không thể phát video này.");
                Toast.makeText(VideoEditorActivity.this, "Không thể tải hoặc phát video: " + error.getErrorCodeName(), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            }
        });
        player.setMediaItem(MediaItem.fromUri(videoUri));
        player.setVolume(binding.switchMuteAudio.isChecked() ? 0f : 1f);
        // Install one mutable shader before prepare. Updating its matrix does not tear down the
        // decoder or rebuild Media3's GL graph while the user adjusts color controls.
        applyPreviewEffects();
        player.setVideoEffects(Collections.singletonList(previewColorMatrix));
        player.prepare();
        mainHandler.post(playbackTicker);
    }

    private void initializeTimeline() {
        timelineInitialized = true;
        if (totalDurationMs <= 0L) {
            long duration = player.getDuration();
            totalDurationMs = duration > 0L ? duration : 1L;
            trimEndMs = totalDurationMs;
        }
        trimStartMs = Math.max(0L, Math.min(trimStartMs, Math.max(0L, totalDurationMs - 500L)));
        trimEndMs = Math.max(trimStartMs, Math.min(trimEndMs, totalDurationMs));
        if (trimEndMs - trimStartMs < 500L && totalDurationMs >= 500L) {
            trimEndMs = Math.min(totalDurationMs, trimStartMs + 500L);
        }
        binding.trimTimeline.setDuration(totalDurationMs);
        binding.trimTimeline.setRange(trimStartMs, trimEndMs);
        updateTrimLabels();
        long requestedPosition = restoredPositionMs >= trimStartMs && restoredPositionMs <= trimEndMs
                ? restoredPositionMs : trimStartMs;
        player.seekTo(Math.min(requestedPosition, totalDurationMs));
        if (shouldResumeAfterRestore) player.play();
        loadThumbnails();
    }

    private void loadThumbnails() {
        final Uri source = videoUri;
        final long duration = totalDurationMs;
        thumbnailExecutor.execute(() -> {
            MediaMetadataRetriever retriever = new MediaMetadataRetriever();
            List<Drawable> frames = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Bitmap> ownedTimelineFrames = new ArrayList<>();
            Bitmap baseFrame = null;
            List<Bitmap> filterFrames = new ArrayList<>();
            try {
                retriever.setDataSource(this, source);
