                int count = (int) Math.max(4L, Math.min(12L, duration / 4000L));
                for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                    long timeUs = (long) ((i + .5d) * duration / count) * 1000L;
                    Bitmap frame = retriever.getFrameAtTime(timeUs, MediaMetadataRetriever.OPTION_CLOSEST_SYNC);
                    if (frame == null) continue;
                    Bitmap scaled = centerCrop(frame, 160, 90);
                    if (scaled != frame) frame.recycle();
                    ownedTimelineFrames.add(scaled);
                    frames.add(new BitmapDrawable(getResources(), scaled));
                    if (baseFrame == null) baseFrame = scaled.copy(Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888, false);
                }
                if (baseFrame != null) {
                    for (int i = 0; i < FILTER_LABELS.length; i++) filterFrames.add(makeFilterThumbnail(baseFrame, i));
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            } finally {
                try { retriever.release(); } catch (Exception ignored) { }
            }
            final Bitmap finalBaseFrame = baseFrame;
            final List<Bitmap> finalTimelineFrames = ownedTimelineFrames;
            final List<Bitmap> finalFilterFrames = filterFrames;
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                if (binding == null || isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                    recycleBitmaps(finalTimelineFrames);
                    recycleBitmaps(finalFilterFrames);
                    if (finalBaseFrame != null && !finalBaseFrame.isRecycled()) finalBaseFrame.recycle();
                    return;
                }
                timelineBitmaps.addAll(finalTimelineFrames);
                filterBitmaps.addAll(finalFilterFrames);
                filterSourceBitmap = finalBaseFrame;
                binding.trimTimeline.setFrames(frames);
                for (int i = 0; i < filterCards.size() && i < finalFilterFrames.size(); i++) {
                    android.widget.ImageView image = binding.filterOptions.findViewWithTag("filter_thumbnail_" + i);
                    if (image != null) image.setImageBitmap(finalFilterFrames.get(i));
                }
            });
        });
    }

    private Bitmap centerCrop(Bitmap source, int width, int height) {
        float scale = Math.max(width / (float) source.getWidth(), height / (float) source.getHeight());
        int scaledWidth = Math.max(width, Math.round(source.getWidth() * scale));
        int scaledHeight = Math.max(height, Math.round(source.getHeight() * scale));
        Bitmap scaled = Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(source, scaledWidth, scaledHeight, true);
        int x = Math.max(0, (scaledWidth - width) / 2);
        int y = Math.max(0, (scaledHeight - height) / 2);
        Bitmap result = Bitmap.createBitmap(scaled, x, y, width, height);
        if (scaled != source && scaled != result) scaled.recycle();
        return result;
    }

    private Bitmap makeFilterThumbnail(Bitmap source, int filter) {
        int width = source.getWidth(), height = source.getHeight();
        int[] pixels = new int[width * height];
        int[] output = new int[pixels.length];
        source.getPixels(pixels, 0, width, 0, 0, width, height);
        if (filter == 6) {
            for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
                int red = 0, green = 0, blue = 0, count = 0;
                for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
                    int sx = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - 1, x + dx));
                    int sy = Math.max(0, Math.min(height - 1, y + dy));
                    int pixel = pixels[sy * width + sx];
                    red += (pixel >> 16) & 255; green += (pixel >> 8) & 255; blue += pixel & 255; count++;
                }
                output[y * width + x] = 0xff000000 | ((red / count) << 16) | ((green / count) << 8) | (blue / count);
            }
        } else {
            for (int i = 0; i < pixels.length; i++) {
                int pixel = pixels[i];
                float r = (pixel >> 16) & 255, g = (pixel >> 8) & 255, b = pixel & 255;
                if (filter == 1) {
                    float luma = .2126f * r + .7152f * g + .0722f * b;
                    r = luma + (r - luma) * 1.25f; g = luma + (g - luma) * 1.25f; b = luma + (b - luma) * 1.25f;
                } else if (filter == 2) { r *= 1.08f; g *= 1.01f; b *= .94f; }
                else if (filter == 3) { r *= .94f; g *= 1.01f; b *= 1.08f; }
                else if (filter == 4) { float gray = .2126f * r + .7152f * g + .0722f * b; r = gray; g = gray; b = gray; }
                else if (filter == 5) {
                    r = 128f + (r - 128f) * 1.35f;
                    g = 128f + (g - 128f) * 1.35f;
                    b = 128f + (b - 128f) * 1.35f;
                }
                output[i] = 0xff000000 | (clampChannel(r) << 16) | (clampChannel(g) << 8) | clampChannel(b);
            }
        }
        Bitmap bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);
        bitmap.setPixels(output, 0, width, 0, 0, width, height);
        return bitmap;
    }

    private int clampChannel(float value) { return Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(value))); }

    private List<androidx.media3.common.Effect> effects() {
        return VideoSaveUtils.createEffects(
                adjustmentValues[0] - 100,
                adjustmentValues[1],
                adjustmentValues[2],
                adjustmentValues[3] - 30,
                adjustmentValues[4] - 100,
                adjustmentValues[5] - 100,
                adjustmentValues[6] - 100,
                selectedFilter);
    }

    private void applyPreviewEffects() {
        if (binding == null) return;
        previewColorMatrix.update(
                adjustmentValues[0] - 100,
                adjustmentValues[1],
                adjustmentValues[2],
                adjustmentValues[3] - 30,
                adjustmentValues[4] - 100,
                adjustmentValues[5] - 100,
                adjustmentValues[6] - 100,
                selectedFilter);
    }

    private void schedulePreviewEffects() {
        mainHandler.removeCallbacks(previewEffectsUpdate);
        mainHandler.postDelayed(previewEffectsUpdate, 55L);
    }

    private final Runnable previewEffectsUpdate = this::applyPreviewEffects;

    private boolean canOverwriteLocal() {
        if (videoItem == null || !videoItem.isVideo() || videoItem.getContentUri() == null
                || videoItem.getMimeType() == null || !"video/mp4".equalsIgnoreCase(videoItem.getMimeType())
                || !videoUri.toString().equals(videoItem.getContentUri())) return false;
        return "content".equalsIgnoreCase(videoUri.getScheme())
                && "media".equalsIgnoreCase(videoUri.getAuthority())
                && videoUri.getPath() != null && videoUri.getPath().contains("/video/media/");
    }

    private void confirmOverwrite() {
        if (!canOverwriteLocal()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Lưu đè chỉ hỗ trợ video local trong MediaStore. Video cloud có thể xuất thành bản mới.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            return;
        }
        if (trimEndMs - trimStartMs < 500L) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Đoạn video phải dài ít nhất nửa giây", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return;
        }
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle("Lưu đè video gốc?")
                .setMessage("Nội dung video local hiện tại sẽ bị thay bằng đoạn đã chỉnh sửa. Ứng dụng sẽ giữ bản khôi phục tạm trong lúc ghi.")
                .setNegativeButton("Hủy", null)
                .setPositiveButton("Tiếp tục", (dialog, which) -> requestOverwriteAccess())
                .show();
    }

    private void requestOverwriteAccess() {
        if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT <= android.os.Build.VERSION_CODES.P
                && ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE)
                != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            legacyWritePermissionLauncher.launch(Manifest.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE);
            return;
        }
        try {
            IntentSender sender = overwritePermissionGranted ? null : VideoSaveUtils.getWriteConsentRequest(this, videoUri);
            if (sender != null) overwriteConsentLauncher.launch(new IntentSenderRequest.Builder(sender).build());
            else beginOverwrite();
        } catch (Exception error) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Android không cấp quyền ghi an toàn cho video này. Video gốc chưa bị thay đổi; hãy xuất video mới.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        }
    }

    private void beginOverwrite() {
        if (exporting || binding == null) return;
        exporting = true;
        binding.btnSaveCopy.setEnabled(false);
        binding.btnOverwrite.setEnabled(false);
        binding.progressBar.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        binding.tvExportProgress.setText("Đang xử lý và kiểm tra video…");
        if (player != null) {
            restoredPositionMs = Math.max(trimStartMs, Math.min(trimEndMs, player.getCurrentPosition()));
            resumeAfterOverwriteError = player.isPlaying();
            restorePlayerAfterOverwriteError = true;
            binding.editorPlayerView.setPlayer(null);
            player.release();
            player = null;
        }
        VideoSaveUtils.overwriteVideo(this, videoUri, videoItem.getDateModified(), trimStartMs, trimEndMs,
                binding.switchMuteAudio.isChecked(), effects(), new VideoSaveUtils.SaveVideoCallback() {
                    @Override public void onSuccess(Uri uri, String name) {
                        finishSave("Đã lưu đè video local.");
                    }
                    @Override public void onError(String message) {
                        exporting = false;
                        if (binding == null) return;
                        binding.progressBar.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                        binding.btnSaveCopy.setEnabled(true);
                        restoreOverwriteButtonState();
                        binding.tvExportProgress.setText("Lưu đè thất bại");
                        if (!VideoSaveUtils.hasPendingOverwriteRecovery(VideoEditorActivity.this)) setupPlayer();
                        else {
                            binding.btnSaveCopy.setEnabled(false);
                            binding.btnOverwrite.setEnabled(false);
                        }
                        Toast.makeText(VideoEditorActivity.this, message, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                    }
                    @Override public void onPermissionRequired(IntentSender sender) {
                        exporting = false;
                        if (binding != null) {
                            binding.progressBar.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                            binding.btnSaveCopy.setEnabled(true);
                            restoreOverwriteButtonState();
                        }
                        try { overwriteConsentLauncher.launch(new IntentSenderRequest.Builder(sender).build()); }
                        catch (Exception error) { Toast.makeText(VideoEditorActivity.this, "Không mở được yêu cầu quyền ghi. Video gốc chưa bị thay đổi.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show(); }
                    }
                });
    }

    private void finishSave(String message) {
        exporting = false;
        if (binding == null) return;
        binding.progressBar.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        binding.tvExportProgress.setText("Hoàn tất");
        setResult(RESULT_OK);
        Toast.makeText(this, message, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        finish();
    }

    private void restoreOverwriteButtonState() {
        if (binding == null) return;
        boolean available = canOverwriteLocal();
        binding.btnOverwrite.setEnabled(available);
        binding.btnOverwrite.setAlpha(available ? 1f : 0.55f);
        if (!available) binding.btnOverwrite.setContentDescription(getString(R.string.video_editor_overwrite_local_only));
    }

    private void updateTrimLabels() {
        if (binding == null) return;
        binding.tvTrimStart.setText(getString(R.string.video_editor_trim_start, VideoDurationFormatter.formatDuration(trimStartMs)));
        binding.tvTrimEnd.setText(getString(R.string.video_editor_trim_end, VideoDurationFormatter.formatDuration(trimEndMs)));
        binding.tvTrimDuration.setText(getString(R.string.video_editor_trim_duration,
                VideoDurationFormatter.formatDuration(Math.max(0L, trimEndMs - trimStartMs))));
        binding.trimTimeline.setRange(trimStartMs, trimEndMs);
    }

    private void export() {
        if (exporting) return;
        if (trimEndMs - trimStartMs < 500L) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Đoạn video phải dài ít nhất nửa giây", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return;
        }
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle("Xuất video mới?")
                .setMessage("Video gốc sẽ được giữ nguyên.")
                .setNegativeButton("Hủy", null)
                .setPositiveButton("Xuất", (dialog, which) -> {
                    exporting = true;
                    binding.btnSaveCopy.setEnabled(false);
                    binding.btnOverwrite.setEnabled(false);
                    binding.progressBar.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                    binding.tvExportProgress.setText("Đang xuất…");
                    VideoSaveUtils.trimAndExportVideo(this, videoUri, trimStartMs, trimEndMs,
                            binding.switchMuteAudio.isChecked(), effects(), new VideoSaveUtils.SaveVideoCallback() {
                                @Override public void onSuccess(Uri uri, String name) {
                                    exporting = false;
                                    if (binding == null) return;
                                    binding.progressBar.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                                    binding.btnSaveCopy.setEnabled(true);
                                    restoreOverwriteButtonState();
                                    binding.tvExportProgress.setText("Hoàn tất");
                                    setResult(RESULT_OK);
                                    Toast.makeText(VideoEditorActivity.this, "Đã xuất video: " + name, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                                    finish();
                                }

                                @Override public void onError(String message) {
                                    exporting = false;
                                    if (binding == null) return;
                                    binding.progressBar.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                                    binding.btnSaveCopy.setEnabled(true);
                                    restoreOverwriteButtonState();
                                    binding.tvExportProgress.setText("Xuất thất bại");
                                    Toast.makeText(VideoEditorActivity.this, message, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                                }
                            });
                }).show();
    }

    private void confirmCancel() {
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle("Hủy chỉnh sửa?")
                .setMessage("Các thay đổi chưa xuất sẽ bị mất.")
                .setNegativeButton("Tiếp tục chỉnh sửa", null)
                .setPositiveButton("Thoát", (dialog, which) -> finish())
                .show();
    }

    private int dp(int value) { return Math.round(value * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density); }

    private int resolveThemeColor(int attribute) {
        android.util.TypedValue value = new android.util.TypedValue();
        getTheme().resolveAttribute(attribute, value, true);
        if (value.resourceId != 0) return ContextCompat.getColor(this, value.resourceId);
        return value.data;
    }

    private void recycleBitmaps(List<Bitmap> bitmaps) {
        for (Bitmap bitmap : bitmaps) if (bitmap != null && !bitmap.isRecycled()) bitmap.recycle();
        bitmaps.clear();
    }

    @Override protected void onStart() {
        super.onStart();
        if (resumePlaybackOnStart && player != null) player.play();
        resumePlaybackOnStart = false;
    }

    @Override protected void onStop() {
        if (player != null) {
            resumePlaybackOnStart = player.isPlaying();
            player.pause();
        }
        super.onStop();
    }

    @Override protected void onSaveInstanceState(Bundle outState) {
        super.onSaveInstanceState(outState);
        outState.putLong(STATE_TRIM_START, trimStartMs);
        outState.putLong(STATE_TRIM_END, trimEndMs);
        outState.putIntArray(STATE_ADJUSTMENTS, adjustmentValues.clone());
        outState.putInt(STATE_FILTER, selectedFilter);
        outState.putInt("video_editor_active_adjustment", activeAdjustment);
        outState.putBoolean(STATE_MUTE, binding != null && binding.switchMuteAudio.isChecked());
        outState.putLong(STATE_POSITION, player == null ? restoredPositionMs : player.getCurrentPosition());
        outState.putInt(STATE_MODE, binding == null ? R.id.btnTabTrim : binding.modeTabs.getCheckedButtonId());
        outState.putBoolean(STATE_PLAYING, player != null && player.isPlaying());
    }

    @Override protected void onDestroy() {
        mainHandler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null);
        thumbnailExecutor.shutdownNow();
        if (binding != null) {
            binding.editorPlayerView.setPlayer(null);
            binding.trimTimeline.setFrames(Collections.emptyList());
            for (MaterialCardView card : filterCards) {
                android.widget.ImageView image = card.findViewWithTag("filter_thumbnail_" + filterCards.indexOf(card));
                if (image != null) image.setImageDrawable(null);
            }
        }
        if (player != null) {
            player.release();
            player = null;
        }
        recycleBitmaps(timelineBitmaps);
        recycleBitmaps(filterBitmaps);
        if (filterSourceBitmap != null && !filterSourceBitmap.isRecycled()) filterSourceBitmap.recycle();
        binding = null;
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}


VideoPlayerActivity.java
package com.example.th6.activities;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.util.Log;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.annotation.OptIn;
import androidx.activity.result.ActivityResultLauncher;
import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.media3.common.MediaItem;
import androidx.media3.common.PlaybackException;
import androidx.media3.common.Player;
import androidx.media3.common.util.UnstableApi;
import androidx.media3.exoplayer.ExoPlayer;

import com.example.th6.databinding.ActivityVideoPlayerBinding;
import com.example.th6.models.LocalMediaPhoto;
import com.example.th6.models.Photo;
import com.example.th6.data.AuthRepository;
import com.example.th6.data.PhotoRepository;
import com.example.th6.utils.PhotoTrashManager;
import com.example.th6.utils.LocalVideoFavorites;
import io.github.jan.supabase.auth.user.UserInfo;

public class VideoPlayerActivity extends AppCompatActivity {
    private static final String TAG = "VideoPlayerActivity";

    private ActivityVideoPlayerBinding binding;
    private ExoPlayer player;
    private LocalMediaPhoto videoItem;
    private Uri videoUri;
    private boolean cloudFallbackAttempted;
    private PhotoRepository photoRepository;
    private boolean favoriteUpdating;
    private ActivityResultLauncher<Intent> videoEditorLauncher;
    private boolean resumeAfterEditor;
    private long playerPositionBeforeEditor;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        videoEditorLauncher = registerForActivityResult(new ActivityResultContracts.StartActivityForResult(), result -> {
            if (player == null) return;
            player.setMediaItem(MediaItem.fromUri(videoUri), playerPositionBeforeEditor);
            player.prepare();
            player.setPlayWhenReady(resumeAfterEditor);
        });
        binding = ActivityVideoPlayerBinding.inflate(getLayoutInflater());
        setContentView(binding.getRoot());

        if (getIntent().hasExtra("video")) {
            videoItem = (LocalMediaPhoto) getIntent().getSerializableExtra("video");
            if (videoItem != null) {
                String source = videoItem.getContentUri();
                if (source == null || source.isEmpty()) source = videoItem.getCloudUrl();
                if (source != null && !source.isEmpty()) videoUri = Uri.parse(source);
            }
        } else if (getIntent().hasExtra("video_uri")) {
            videoUri = Uri.parse(getIntent().getStringExtra("video_uri"));
        }

        if (videoUri == null || videoUri.toString().isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Không tìm thấy dữ liệu video", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            finish();
            return;
        }

        setupUI();
        photoRepository = new PhotoRepository();
        setupListeners();
        initPlayer();
    }

    private void setupUI() {
        if (videoItem != null && videoItem.getDisplayName() != null) {
            binding.tvVideoTitle.setText(videoItem.getDisplayName());
        } else {
            binding.tvVideoTitle.setText("Xem Video");
        }
    }

    private void setupListeners() {
        binding.btnBack.setOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        binding.btnVideoInfo.setOnClickListener(v -> showVideoInfo());
        binding.btnFavorite.setOnClickListener(v -> toggleFavorite());

        binding.btnEditVideo.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            Intent intent = new Intent(VideoPlayerActivity.this, VideoEditorActivity.class);
            if (videoItem != null) {
                intent.putExtra("video", videoItem);
            }
            intent.putExtra("video_uri", videoUri.toString());
            resumeAfterEditor = player != null && player.isPlaying();
            playerPositionBeforeEditor = player == null ? 0L : player.getCurrentPosition();
            if (player != null) {
                player.pause();
                player.clearMediaItems();
            }
            videoEditorLauncher.launch(intent);
        });

        binding.btnShare.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            Intent shareIntent = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND);
            shareIntent.setType("video/*");
            shareIntent.putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_STREAM, videoUri);
            shareIntent.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION);
            startActivity(Intent.createChooser(shareIntent, "Chia sẻ video qua"));
        });

        binding.btnDelete.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (videoItem == null) {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Không xác định được media để chuyển vào thùng rác", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                return;
            }
            new androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                    .setTitle("Chuyển video vào thùng rác?")
                    .setMessage("File gốc trên thiết bị sẽ được giữ nguyên.")
                    .setNegativeButton("Hủy", null)
                    .setPositiveButton("Chuyển vào thùng rác", (dialog, which) -> moveVideoToTrash())
                    .show();
        });
    }

    private boolean isFavorite() {
        if (videoItem == null) return false;
        Photo cloud = videoItem.getCloudPhoto();
        if (cloud != null) return cloud.isFavorite();
        UserInfo user = new AuthRepository().getCurrentUser();
        return user != null && LocalVideoFavorites.contains(this, user.getId(), videoItem.getContentUri());
    }

    private void updateFavoriteButton() {
        if (binding == null) return;
        boolean favorite = isFavorite();
        binding.btnFavorite.setImageResource(favorite ? com.example.th6.R.drawable.ic_favorite : com.example.th6.R.drawable.ic_favorite_border);
        binding.btnFavorite.setColorFilter(androidx.core.content.ContextCompat.getColor(this,
                favorite ? com.example.th6.R.color.favorite_red : android.R.color.white));
        binding.btnFavorite.setContentDescription(favorite ? "Bỏ yêu thích video" : "Yêu thích video");
    }

    private void toggleFavorite() {
        UserInfo user = new AuthRepository().getCurrentUser();
        if (user == null || videoItem == null || favoriteUpdating) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Không thể cập nhật yêu thích lúc này", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return;
        }
        boolean value = !isFavorite();
        Photo cloud = videoItem.getCloudPhoto();
        if (cloud == null) {
            LocalVideoFavorites.set(this, user.getId(), videoItem.getContentUri(), value);
            updateFavoriteButton();
            Toast.makeText(this, value ? "Đã thêm vào yêu thích" : "Đã bỏ khỏi yêu thích", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return;
        }
        favoriteUpdating = true;
        binding.btnFavorite.setEnabled(false);
        photoRepository.toggleFavoriteAsync(user.getId(), cloud.getId(), value, new PhotoRepository.Callback<Void>() {
            @Override public void onSuccess(Void result) {
                cloud.setFavorite(value);
                LocalVideoFavorites.set(VideoPlayerActivity.this, user.getId(), videoItem.getContentUri(), false);
                favoriteUpdating = false;
                if (binding != null) { binding.btnFavorite.setEnabled(true); updateFavoriteButton(); }
                Toast.makeText(VideoPlayerActivity.this, value ? "Đã thêm vào yêu thích" : "Đã bỏ khỏi yêu thích", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            }
            @Override public void onError(String error) {
                favoriteUpdating = false;
                if (binding != null) binding.btnFavorite.setEnabled(true);
                Toast.makeText(VideoPlayerActivity.this, "Không cập nhật được yêu thích: " + error, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            }
        });
    }

    private void moveVideoToTrash() {
        Photo photo = videoItem.getCloudPhoto() == null ? new Photo() : videoItem.getCloudPhoto();
        if (videoItem.getCloudPhoto() == null) {
            photo.setId("local:" + videoItem.getMediaId());
            photo.setOwnerUid("local");
            photo.setName(videoItem.getDisplayName());
            photo.setMediaType("video");
            photo.setImageUrl(videoItem.getContentUri());
            photo.setCreatedAt(videoItem.getTimelineTimestamp());
        }
        photo.setLocalMediaUri(videoItem.getContentUri());
        photo.setLocalMediaId(videoItem.getMediaId());
        photo.setLocalDateModified(videoItem.getDateModified());
        UserInfo user = new AuthRepository().getCurrentUser();
        PhotoTrashManager.moveToTrash(this, user == null ? null : user.getId(), photo,
                new PhotoTrashManager.Callback() {
                    @Override public void onSuccess(Photo moved) {
                        Toast.makeText(VideoPlayerActivity.this, "Đã chuyển video vào thùng rác", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                        finish();
                    }
                    @Override public void onError(String error) {
                        Toast.makeText(VideoPlayerActivity.this, "Không chuyển được video: " + error, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                    }
                });
    }
    private void showVideoInfo() {
        String unknown = "Không có dữ liệu";
        String name = videoItem != null && videoItem.getDisplayName() != null ? videoItem.getDisplayName() : unknown;
        String mime = videoItem != null && videoItem.getMimeType() != null ? videoItem.getMimeType() : unknown;
        String resolution = videoItem != null && videoItem.getWidth() > 0 && videoItem.getHeight() > 0
                ? videoItem.getWidth() + " × " + videoItem.getHeight() : unknown;
        String duration = videoItem != null && videoItem.getDurationMs() > 0
                ? com.example.th6.utils.VideoDurationFormatter.formatDuration(videoItem.getDurationMs()) : unknown;
        String size = videoItem != null && videoItem.getSizeBytes() > 0
                ? android.text.format.Formatter.formatFileSize(this, videoItem.getSizeBytes()) : unknown;
        String source = resolveStorageSource();
        String local = videoItem != null && videoItem.getContentUri() != null ? videoItem.getContentUri() : unknown;
        String date = videoItem != null && videoItem.getTimelineTimestamp() > 0
                ? java.text.DateFormat.getDateTimeInstance().format(new java.util.Date(videoItem.getTimelineTimestamp())) : unknown;
        String backup = videoItem != null && LocalMediaPhoto.STATUS_UPLOADED.equals(videoItem.getBackupStatus()) ? "Đã sao lưu"
                : videoItem != null && videoItem.getContentUri() != null ? "Chỉ có trên thiết bị" : "Không xác định";
        new androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog.Builder(this).setTitle("Thông tin video")
                .setMessage("Tên: " + name + "\nLoại: Video\nĐộ phân giải: " + resolution + "\nThời lượng: " + duration
                        + "\nKích thước: " + size + "\nNgày ghi nhận: " + date + "\nĐịnh dạng: " + mime
                        + "\nNguồn lưu trữ: " + source + "\nSao lưu: " + backup + "\nURI thiết bị: " + local)
                .setPositiveButton("Đóng", null).show();
    }

    private String resolveStorageSource() {
        boolean local = videoItem != null && videoItem.getContentUri() != null && !videoItem.getContentUri().isEmpty();
        com.example.th6.models.Photo cloud = videoItem == null ? null : videoItem.getCloudPhoto();
        boolean verifiedCloud = cloud != null && cloud.getStoragePath() != null && !cloud.getStoragePath().isEmpty();
        String provider = verifiedCloud ? cloud.getStorageProvider() : null;
        String cloudName = "supabase".equalsIgnoreCase(provider) ? "Supabase Cloud"
                : "imgbb".equalsIgnoreCase(provider) ? "ImgBB Cloud" : null;
        if (local && cloudName != null) return "Thiết bị + " + cloudName;
        if (local) return "Thiết bị";
        return cloudName == null ? "Không xác định" : cloudName;
    }

    @OptIn(markerClass = UnstableApi.class)
    private void initPlayer() {
        player = new ExoPlayer.Builder(this).build();
        player.addListener(new Player.Listener() {
            @Override
            public void onPlayerError(PlaybackException error) {
                if (!cloudFallbackAttempted && videoItem != null && videoItem.getCloudUrl() != null
                        && !videoItem.getCloudUrl().isEmpty() && !videoItem.getCloudUrl().equals(videoUri.toString())) {
                    cloudFallbackAttempted = true;
                    videoUri = Uri.parse(videoItem.getCloudUrl());
                    player.setMediaItem(MediaItem.fromUri(videoUri));
                    player.prepare();
                    player.setPlayWhenReady(true);
                    return;
                }
                Log.e(TAG, "Video playback failed", error);
                if (!isFinishing()) {
                    Toast.makeText(VideoPlayerActivity.this,
                            "Không thể phát video này. Tệp có thể không được hỗ trợ hoặc không còn truy cập được.",
                            Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                }
            }
        });
        binding.playerView.setPlayer(player);

        MediaItem mediaItem = MediaItem.fromUri(videoUri);
        player.setMediaItem(mediaItem);
        player.prepare();
        player.setPlayWhenReady(true);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onStop() {
        super.onStop();
        if (player != null) {
            player.pause();
        }
    }

    @Override protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        updateFavoriteButton();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        super.onDestroy();
        if (player != null) {
            player.release();
            player = null;
        }
        binding = null;
    }
}


AlbumAdapter.java
package com.example.th6.adapters;

import android.content.Context;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.ImageView;
import android.widget.TextView;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import com.bumptech.glide.Glide;
import com.bumptech.glide.request.RequestOptions;
import com.example.th6.R;
import com.example.th6.models.Album;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class AlbumAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<AlbumAdapter.AlbumViewHolder> {

    private final Context context;
    private List<Album> albums;
    private OnAlbumActionListener listener;

    public interface OnAlbumActionListener {
        void onAlbumClick(Album album);
        void onAlbumLongClick(Album album, View view);
    }

    public AlbumAdapter(Context context, OnAlbumActionListener listener) {
        this.context = context;
        this.albums = new ArrayList<>();
        this.listener = listener;
    }

    public void setAlbums(List<Album> albums) {
        this.albums = albums != null ? albums : new ArrayList<>();
        notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public AlbumViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
        View view = LayoutInflater.from(context).inflate(R.layout.item_album, parent, false);
        return new AlbumViewHolder(view);
    }

    @Override
    public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull AlbumViewHolder holder, int position) {
        Album album = albums.get(position);
        holder.tvAlbumName.setText(album.getName());
        holder.tvAlbumCount.setText(context.getResources().getQuantityString(R.plurals.album_photo_count,
                album.getPhotoCount(), album.getPhotoCount()));

        String cover = album.getDisplayCoverUri() != null && !album.getDisplayCoverUri().isEmpty()
                ? album.getDisplayCoverUri() : album.getCoverImageUrl();
        if (cover != null && !cover.isEmpty()) {
            if (album.getDisplayCoverVideo()) {
                Glide.with(context).asBitmap().load(cover)
                        .apply(RequestOptions.frameOf(1_000_000))
                        .placeholder(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder).error(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder)
                        .centerCrop().into(holder.imgAlbumCover);
            } else Glide.with(context).load(cover)
                    .placeholder(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder).error(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder)
                    .centerCrop().into(holder.imgAlbumCover);
        } else {
            Glide.with(context).clear(holder.imgAlbumCover);
            holder.imgAlbumCover.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder);
        }

        holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (listener != null) listener.onAlbumClick(album);
        });

        holder.itemView.setOnLongClickListener(v -> {
            if (listener != null) listener.onAlbumLongClick(album, v);
            return true;
        });
    }

    @Override
    public int getItemCount() {
        return albums.size();
    }

    public static class AlbumViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
        ImageView imgAlbumCover;
        TextView tvAlbumName;
        TextView tvAlbumCount;

        public AlbumViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
            super(itemView);
            imgAlbumCover = itemView.findViewById(R.id.imgAlbumCover);
            tvAlbumName = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvAlbumName);
            tvAlbumCount = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvAlbumCount);
        }
    }
}


AlbumMediaAdapter.java
package com.example.th6.adapters;

import android.content.Context;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.ImageView;
import android.widget.TextView;
import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;
import com.bumptech.glide.Glide;
import com.bumptech.glide.request.RequestOptions;
import com.example.th6.R;
import com.example.th6.models.AlbumMediaEntry;
import com.example.th6.utils.PhotoTimelineUtils;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public final class AlbumMediaAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<AlbumMediaAdapter.Holder> {
    public interface Listener { void onClick(AlbumMediaEntry entry); void onLongClick(AlbumMediaEntry entry, View anchor); }
    private final Context context; private final Listener listener; private final List<AlbumMediaEntry> items = new ArrayList<>();
    private boolean selectionMode;
    private boolean showAlreadyStatus;
    private final List<Row> rows = new ArrayList<>();

    public AlbumMediaAdapter(Context context, Listener listener) { this.context=context; this.listener=listener; }
    public void setItems(List<AlbumMediaEntry> entries) { setTimelineItems(entries, PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_ALL); }
    public void setTimelineItems(List<AlbumMediaEntry> entries, int viewMode) {
        items.clear(); rows.clear();
        if(entries!=null) items.addAll(entries);
        String previousKey = null;
        for (AlbumMediaEntry entry : items) {
            if (viewMode != PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_ALL) {
                String key = PhotoTimelineUtils.getGroupKey(entry.getTimestamp(), viewMode);
                if (!key.equals(previousKey)) { rows.add(Row.header(PhotoTimelineUtils.getGroupLabel(entry.getTimestamp(), viewMode))); previousKey = key; }
            }
            rows.add(Row.media(entry));
        }
        notifyDataSetChanged();
    }
    public List<AlbumMediaEntry> getItems() { return items; }
    public void notifyEntryChanged(AlbumMediaEntry entry) {
        int index = items.indexOf(entry);
        if (index < 0) return;
        for (int i = 0, mediaIndex = 0; i < rows.size(); i++) {
            if (rows.get(i).entry != null) {
                if (mediaIndex++ == index) { notifyItemChanged(i); return; }
            }
        }
    }
    public void setSelectionMode(boolean value) { selectionMode=value; notifyDataSetChanged(); }
    public void setShowAlreadyStatus(boolean value) { showAlreadyStatus=value; notifyDataSetChanged(); }

    @NonNull @Override public Holder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent,int type) {
        if (type == 1) {
            TextView header = new TextView(context);
            header.setLayoutParams(new RecyclerView.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
            header.setPadding(dp(12), dp(14), dp(12), dp(8)); header.setTextSize(18); header.setTypeface(null, android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD);
            android.util.TypedValue color = new android.util.TypedValue();
            if (context.getTheme().resolveAttribute(com.google.android.material.R.attr.colorOnBackground, color, true)) header.setTextColor(color.data);
            return new Holder(header);
        }
        return new Holder(LayoutInflater.from(context).inflate(R.layout.item_album_media,parent,false));
    }

    @Override public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull Holder h,int position) {
        Row row = rows.get(position);
        if (row.entry == null) { h.header.setText(row.header); return; }
        AlbumMediaEntry e=row.entry;
        h.name.setText(e.getName());
        boolean alreadyInAlbum = showAlreadyStatus && e.isAlreadyInAlbum();
        boolean checked = e.isSelected() || alreadyInAlbum;
        h.check.setVisibility(selectionMode ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        h.check.setImageResource(checked ? R.drawable.ic_album_media_checked : R.drawable.ic_album_media_unchecked);
        h.check.setContentDescription(context.getString(checked ? R.string.album_media_selected : R.string.album_media_not_selected));
        h.check.setAlpha(alreadyInAlbum ? .72f : 1f);
        h.already.setVisibility(alreadyInAlbum ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        h.play.setVisibility(e.isVideo() ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        Object source=e.getSource();
        if(e.isVideo()) Glide.with(context).asBitmap().load(source).apply(RequestOptions.frameOf(1_000_000)).placeholder(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder).error(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder).centerCrop().into(h.image);
        else Glide.with(context).load(source).placeholder(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder).error(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder).centerCrop().into(h.image);
        h.itemView.setOnClickListener(v -> { if(listener!=null) listener.onClick(e); });
        h.itemView.setOnLongClickListener(v -> { if(listener!=null) listener.onLongClick(e,v); return true; });
    }

    @Override public int getItemViewType(int position) { return rows.get(position).entry == null ? 1 : 0; }
    @Override public int getItemCount(){return rows.size();}
    private int dp(int value) { return Math.round(value * context.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density); }
    private static final class Row {
        final AlbumMediaEntry entry; final String header;
        private Row(AlbumMediaEntry entry,String header){this.entry=entry;this.header=header;}
        static Row media(AlbumMediaEntry entry){return new Row(entry,null);}
        static Row header(String label){return new Row(null,label);}
    }
    static final class Holder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
        final ImageView image,play,check; final TextView name,already;
        final TextView header;
        Holder(View v){super(v); header=v instanceof TextView?(TextView)v:null; image=v.findViewById(R.id.imgAlbumMedia); play=v.findViewById(R.id.imgAlbumMediaPlay); name=v.findViewById(R.id.tvAlbumMediaName); check=v.findViewById(R.id.tvAlbumMediaCheck); already=v.findViewById(R.id.tvAlbumMediaExisting);}
    }
}


LocalPhotoAdapter.java
package com.example.th6.adapters;

import android.content.Context;
import android.util.TypedValue;
import android.view.Gravity;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.ImageView;
import android.widget.TextView;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import com.bumptech.glide.Glide;
import com.bumptech.glide.request.RequestOptions;
import com.example.th6.R;
import com.example.th6.models.LocalMediaPhoto;
import com.example.th6.utils.PhotoTimelineUtils;
import com.example.th6.utils.VideoDurationFormatter;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.HashSet;

public class LocalPhotoAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<RecyclerView.ViewHolder> {
    private static final int TYPE_HEADER = 0;
    private static final int TYPE_PHOTO = 1;

    private final Context context;
    private final OnLocalPhotoClickListener listener;
    private final List<Row> rows = new ArrayList<>();
    private final Set<String> selectedKeys = new HashSet<>();

    public interface OnLocalPhotoClickListener {
        void onLocalPhotoClick(LocalMediaPhoto photo, int position);
        void onLocalPhotoLongClick(LocalMediaPhoto photo, View view);
    }

    private static class Row {
        final String header;
        final LocalMediaPhoto photo;
        final int photoPosition;

        private Row(String header, LocalMediaPhoto photo, int photoPosition) {
            this.header = header;
            this.photo = photo;
            this.photoPosition = photoPosition;
        }

        static Row header(String label) { return new Row(label, null, -1); }
        static Row photo(LocalMediaPhoto photo, int position) { return new Row(null, photo, position); }
    }

    public LocalPhotoAdapter(Context context, OnLocalPhotoClickListener listener) {
        this.context = context;
        this.listener = listener;
    }

    public void setPhotoList(List<LocalMediaPhoto> photoList, int viewMode) {
        rows.clear();
        if (photoList != null) {
            String previousKey = null;
            for (int i = 0; i < photoList.size(); i++) {
                LocalMediaPhoto photo = photoList.get(i);
                if (viewMode != PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_ALL) {
                    String key = PhotoTimelineUtils.getGroupKey(photo.getTimelineTimestamp(), viewMode);
                    if (!key.equals(previousKey)) {
                        rows.add(Row.header(PhotoTimelineUtils.getGroupLabel(photo.getTimelineTimestamp(), viewMode)));
                        previousKey = key;
                    }
                }
                rows.add(Row.photo(photo, i));
            }
        }
        notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    public void setSelectedKeys(Set<String> keys) {
        selectedKeys.clear();
        if (keys != null) selectedKeys.addAll(keys);
        notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    public static String keyFor(LocalMediaPhoto photo) {
        if (photo == null) return "";
        if (photo.getCloudPhoto() != null && (photo.getContentUri() == null || photo.getContentUri().isEmpty())) {
            return "cloud:" + photo.getCloudPhoto().getId();
        }
        return "local:" + photo.getMediaId() + ":" + String.valueOf(photo.getContentUri());
    }

    @Override
    public int getItemViewType(int position) {
        return rows.get(position).photo == null ? TYPE_HEADER : TYPE_PHOTO;
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public RecyclerView.ViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
        if (viewType == TYPE_HEADER) {
            TextView header = new TextView(context);
            header.setLayoutParams(new RecyclerView.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
            header.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);
            header.setPadding(dp(12), dp(14), dp(12), dp(8));
            header.setTextSize(TypedValue.COMPLEX_UNIT_SP, 18);
            header.setTypeface(null, android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD);
            TypedValue color = new TypedValue();
            if (context.getTheme().resolveAttribute(com.google.android.material.R.attr.colorOnBackground, color, true)) {
                header.setTextColor(color.data);
            }
            return new HeaderViewHolder(header);
        }
        View view = LayoutInflater.from(context).inflate(R.layout.item_photo, parent, false);
        return new PhotoViewHolder(view);
    }

    @Override
    public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull RecyclerView.ViewHolder holder, int position) {
        Row row = rows.get(position);
        if (holder instanceof HeaderViewHolder) {
            ((HeaderViewHolder) holder).textView.setText(row.header);
            return;
        }
        PhotoViewHolder photoHolder = (PhotoViewHolder) holder;
        LocalMediaPhoto photo = row.photo;
        if (photoHolder.tvPhotoName != null) photoHolder.tvPhotoName.setText(photo.getDisplayName());
        boolean selected = selectedKeys.contains(keyFor(photo));
        if (photoHolder.tvSelectionCheck != null) photoHolder.tvSelectionCheck.setVisibility(selected ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        if (photoHolder.cardPhoto != null) {
            photoHolder.cardPhoto.setStrokeWidth(selected ? dp(2) : 0);
            photoHolder.cardPhoto.setStrokeColor(androidx.core.content.ContextCompat.getColor(context,
                    selected ? com.example.th6.R.color.rosewood_primary : android.R.color.transparent));
        }
        if (photoHolder.btnFavorite != null) photoHolder.btnFavorite.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        if (photoHolder.imgPlayIcon != null) photoHolder.imgPlayIcon.setVisibility(photo.isVideo() ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        if (photoHolder.tvDuration != null) {
            photoHolder.tvDuration.setVisibility(photo.isVideo() ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
            if (photo.isVideo()) photoHolder.tvDuration.setText(VideoDurationFormatter.formatDuration(photo.getDurationMs()));
        }

        if (photo.isVideo()) {
            Glide.with(context).asBitmap().load(photo.getContentUri())
                    .apply(RequestOptions.frameOf(1_000_000))
                    .placeholder(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder)
                    .error(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder)
                    .centerCrop().into(photoHolder.imgPhoto);
        } else {
            Object imageSource = photo.getContentUri() != null && !photo.getContentUri().isEmpty()
                    ? photo.getContentUri() : photo.getCloudUrl();
            Glide.with(context).load(imageSource)
                    .placeholder(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder)
                    .error(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder)
                    .centerCrop().into(photoHolder.imgPhoto);
        }

        photoHolder.itemView.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (listener != null) listener.onLocalPhotoClick(photo, row.photoPosition);
        });
        photoHolder.itemView.setOnLongClickListener(v -> {
            if (listener != null) listener.onLocalPhotoLongClick(photo, v);
            return true;
        });
    }

    @Override
    public int getItemCount() { return rows.size(); }

    private int dp(int value) {
        return Math.round(value * context.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
    }

    private static class HeaderViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
        final TextView textView;
        HeaderViewHolder(TextView view) { super(view); textView = view; }
    }

    private static class PhotoViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
        final ImageView imgPhoto;
        final TextView tvPhotoName;
        final View btnFavorite;
        final ImageView imgPlayIcon;
        final TextView tvDuration;
        final TextView tvSelectionCheck;
        final com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView cardPhoto;

        PhotoViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
            super(itemView);
            imgPhoto = itemView.findViewById(R.id.imgPhoto);
            tvPhotoName = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvPhotoName);
            btnFavorite = itemView.findViewById(R.id.btnFavorite);
            imgPlayIcon = itemView.findViewById(R.id.imgPlayIcon);
            tvDuration = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvDuration);
            tvSelectionCheck = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvSelectionCheck);
            cardPhoto = itemView.findViewById(R.id.cardPhoto);
        }
    }
}


PhotoAdapter.java
package com.example.th6.adapters;

import android.content.Context;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.ImageButton;
import android.widget.ImageView;
import android.widget.TextView;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;
import com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView;

import com.bumptech.glide.Glide;
import com.bumptech.glide.request.RequestOptions;
import com.example.th6.R;
import com.example.th6.models.Photo;
import com.example.th6.utils.PhotoTimelineUtils;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.function.ToLongFunction;

public class PhotoAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<PhotoAdapter.PhotoViewHolder> {

    private final Context context;
    private List<Photo> photos;
    private final List<Row> rows = new ArrayList<>();
    private OnPhotoActionListener listener;
    private final Set<String> selectedIds = new HashSet<>();
    private boolean selectionMode;
    private boolean actionsHidden;

    public interface OnPhotoActionListener {
        void onPhotoClick(Photo photo);
        void onPhotoLongClick(Photo photo, View view);
        void onFavoriteToggle(Photo photo);
    }

    public PhotoAdapter(Context context, OnPhotoActionListener listener) {
        this.context = context;
        this.photos = new ArrayList<>();
        this.listener = listener;
    }

    public void setPhotos(List<Photo> photos) {
        this.photos = photos != null ? photos : new ArrayList<>();
        rebuildRows(PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_ALL);
    }

    public void setTimelinePhotos(List<Photo> photos, int viewMode) {
        setTimelinePhotos(photos,viewMode,Photo::getCreatedAt);
    }

    public void setTimelinePhotos(List<Photo> photos, int viewMode, ToLongFunction<Photo> timestamp) {
        this.photos = photos != null ? photos : new ArrayList<>();
        rebuildRows(viewMode,timestamp);
    }

    private void rebuildRows(int viewMode) {
        rebuildRows(viewMode,Photo::getCreatedAt);
    }

    private void rebuildRows(int viewMode,ToLongFunction<Photo> timestamp) {
        rows.clear();
        String previousKey = null;
        for (Photo photo : this.photos) {
            if (viewMode != PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_ALL) {
                long time=timestamp.applyAsLong(photo);
                String key = PhotoTimelineUtils.getGroupKey(time, viewMode);
                if (!key.equals(previousKey)) { rows.add(Row.header(PhotoTimelineUtils.getGroupLabel(time, viewMode))); previousKey = key; }
            }
            rows.add(Row.photo(photo));
        }
        notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    public List<Photo> getPhotos() {
        return photos;
    }

    public void setSelectionState(boolean active, Set<String> selected) {
        selectionMode = active;
        selectedIds.clear();
        if (selected != null) selectedIds.addAll(selected);
        notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    public void setActionsHidden(boolean hidden) {
        actionsHidden = hidden;
        notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public PhotoViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
        if (viewType == 1) {
            TextView header = new TextView(context);
            header.setLayoutParams(new RecyclerView.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));
            header.setGravity(android.view.Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);
            header.setPadding(dp(12), dp(14), dp(12), dp(8));
            header.setTextSize(18); header.setTypeface(null, android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD);
            android.util.TypedValue color = new android.util.TypedValue();
            if (context.getTheme().resolveAttribute(com.google.android.material.R.attr.colorOnBackground, color, true)) header.setTextColor(color.data);
            return new PhotoViewHolder(header);
        }
        View view = LayoutInflater.from(context).inflate(R.layout.item_photo, parent, false);
        return new PhotoViewHolder(view);
    }

    @Override
    public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull PhotoViewHolder holder, int position) {
        Row row = rows.get(position);
        if (row.photo == null) { holder.header.setText(row.header); return; }
        Photo photo = row.photo;
        holder.tvPhotoName.setText(photo.getName());
        String key = photoKey(photo);
        boolean selected = selectedIds.contains(key);
        holder.tvSelectionCheck.setVisibility(selectionMode ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        holder.tvSelectionCheck.setText(selected ? "✓" : "");
        if (holder.itemView instanceof MaterialCardView) {
            MaterialCardView card = (MaterialCardView) holder.itemView;
            card.setStrokeWidth(selectionMode && selected ? Math.round(2 * context.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density) : 0);
            if (selectionMode && selected) card.setStrokeColor(ContextCompat.getColor(context, R.color.rosewood_primary));
        }

        boolean video = "video".equalsIgnoreCase(photo.getMediaType());
        holder.imgPlayIcon.setVisibility(video ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        if (video) Glide.with(context).asBitmap().load(photo.getImageUrl())
                .apply(RequestOptions.frameOf(1_000_000)).placeholder(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder)
                .error(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder).centerCrop().into(holder.imgPhoto);
        else Glide.with(context).load(photo.getImageUrl()).placeholder(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder)
                .error(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder).centerCrop().into(holder.imgPhoto);

        if (photo.isFavorite()) {
            holder.btnFavorite.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_favorite);
            holder.btnFavorite.setColorFilter(ContextCompat.getColor(context, R.color.favorite_red));
        } else {
            holder.btnFavorite.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_favorite_border);
            holder.btnFavorite.setColorFilter(ContextCompat.getColor(context, android.R.color.white));
        }
        holder.btnFavorite.setVisibility(actionsHidden || selectionMode ? View.GONE : View.VISIBLE);

        holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (listener != null) listener.onPhotoClick(photo);
        });

        holder.itemView.setOnLongClickListener(v -> {
            if (listener != null) listener.onPhotoLongClick(photo, v);
            return true;
        });

        holder.btnFavorite.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            if (listener != null) listener.onFavoriteToggle(photo);
        });
    }

    public static String photoKey(Photo photo) {
        if (photo == null) return "";
        if (photo.getId() != null && !photo.getId().isEmpty()) return photo.getId();
        return photo.getLocalMediaUri() == null ? photo.getImageUrl() : photo.getLocalMediaUri();
    }

    @Override
    public int getItemCount() {
        return rows.size();
    }

    @Override public int getItemViewType(int position) { return rows.get(position).photo == null ? 1 : 0; }
    private int dp(int value) { return Math.round(value * context.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density); }
    private static final class Row {
        final Photo photo; final String header;
        private Row(Photo photo,String header){this.photo=photo;this.header=header;}
        static Row photo(Photo photo){return new Row(photo,null);}
        static Row header(String header){return new Row(null,header);}
    }

    public static class PhotoViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
        ImageView imgPhoto;
        TextView tvPhotoName;
        ImageButton btnFavorite;
        TextView tvSelectionCheck;
        ImageView imgPlayIcon;
        TextView header;

        public PhotoViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
            super(itemView);
            header = itemView instanceof TextView ? (TextView)itemView : null;
            imgPhoto = itemView.findViewById(R.id.imgPhoto);
            tvPhotoName = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvPhotoName);
            btnFavorite = itemView.findViewById(R.id.btnFavorite);
            tvSelectionCheck = itemView.findViewById(R.id.tvSelectionCheck);
            imgPlayIcon = itemView.findViewById(R.id.imgPlayIcon);
        }
    }
}


PhotoThumbnailAdapter.java
package com.example.th6.adapters;

import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.ImageView;
import android.net.Uri;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import com.bumptech.glide.Glide;
import com.example.th6.R;
import com.example.th6.models.Photo;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class PhotoThumbnailAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<PhotoThumbnailAdapter.Holder> {
    public interface Listener { void onPhotoSelected(int position); }

    private final Context context;
    private final Listener listener;
    private final List<Photo> photos = new ArrayList<>();
    private int selectedPosition = RecyclerView.NO_POSITION;
    private final int accent;

    public PhotoThumbnailAdapter(Context context, Listener listener) {
        this.context = context;
        this.listener = listener;
        this.accent = context.getColor(R.color.editor_accent);
    }

    public void setPhotos(List<Photo> values, int selected) {
        photos.clear();
        if (values != null) photos.addAll(values);
        selectedPosition = photos.isEmpty() ? RecyclerView.NO_POSITION : Math.max(0, Math.min(selected, photos.size() - 1));
        notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    public void setSelectedPosition(int position) {
        if (position < 0 || position >= photos.size() || selectedPosition == position) return;
        int old = selectedPosition;
        selectedPosition = position;
        if (old != RecyclerView.NO_POSITION) notifyItemChanged(old);
        notifyItemChanged(position);
    }

    @NonNull @Override public Holder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
        View view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.getContext()).inflate(R.layout.item_photo_thumbnail, parent, false);
        return new Holder(view);
    }

    @Override public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull Holder holder, int position) {
        Photo photo = photos.get(position);
        boolean video = "video".equalsIgnoreCase(photo.getMediaType());
        holder.playBadge.setVisibility(video ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        String localUri = photo.getLocalMediaUri();
        String url = localUri != null && !localUri.isEmpty() ? localUri
                : photo.getDisplayUrl() != null && !photo.getDisplayUrl().isEmpty()
                ? photo.getDisplayUrl() : photo.getImageUrl();
        if (video && url != null && !url.isEmpty()
                && ("content".equalsIgnoreCase(Uri.parse(url).getScheme())
                || "file".equalsIgnoreCase(Uri.parse(url).getScheme()))) {
            Glide.with(holder.image).asBitmap().load(url).apply(com.bumptech.glide.request.RequestOptions
                            .frameOf(1_000_000).override(120, 120))
                    .centerCrop().placeholder(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder)
                    .error(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder).into(holder.image);
        } else if (video) {
            // Do not fetch an entire remote video just to produce a small thumbnail.
            Glide.with(holder.image).clear(holder.image);
            holder.image.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder);
        } else {
            Glide.with(holder.image).load(url).override(120, 120).centerCrop()
                    .placeholder(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder).error(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder)
                    .into(holder.image);
        }
        GradientDrawable border = new GradientDrawable();
        border.setColor(Color.TRANSPARENT);
        border.setCornerRadius(dp(3));
        border.setStroke(dp(position == selectedPosition ? 3 : 0), accent);
        holder.image.setBackground(border);
        holder.image.setPadding(dp(position == selectedPosition ? 2 : 0), dp(position == selectedPosition ? 2 : 0),
                dp(position == selectedPosition ? 2 : 0), dp(position == selectedPosition ? 2 : 0));
        holder.itemView.setContentDescription((video ? "Video: " : "Ảnh: ") + (photo.getName() == null ? "Media" : photo.getName()));
        holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            int currentPosition = holder.getBindingAdapterPosition();
            if (currentPosition != RecyclerView.NO_POSITION) listener.onPhotoSelected(currentPosition);
        });
    }

    private int dp(float value) { return Math.round(value * context.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density); }
    @Override public int getItemCount() { return photos.size(); }

    static class Holder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
        final ImageView image;
        final ImageView playBadge;
        Holder(@NonNull View itemView) {
            super(itemView);
            image = itemView.findViewById(R.id.imgThumbnail);
            playBadge = itemView.findViewById(R.id.imgVideoPlayBadge);
        }
    }
}


SmartCleanupAdapter.java
package com.example.th6.adapters;

import android.content.Context;
import android.text.format.Formatter;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.CheckBox;
import android.widget.ImageView;
import android.widget.TextView;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import com.bumptech.glide.Glide;
import com.bumptech.glide.request.RequestOptions;
import com.example.th6.R;
import com.example.th6.models.SmartCleanupMedia;
import com.example.th6.services.SmartCleanupScanner;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public final class SmartCleanupAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<RecyclerView.ViewHolder> {
    public interface Listener { void onToggle(SmartCleanupMedia item); void onOpen(SmartCleanupMedia item); }
    private static final int TYPE_HEADER = 0, TYPE_MEDIA = 1;
    private final Context context;
    private final Listener listener;
    private final List<Row> rows = new ArrayList<>();
    private boolean interactionEnabled = true;

    private static final class Row {
        final String header; final SmartCleanupMedia item;
        Row(String header, SmartCleanupMedia item) { this.header = header; this.item = item; }
    }
    public SmartCleanupAdapter(Context context, Listener listener) { this.context = context; this.listener = listener; }

    public void setResults(SmartCleanupScanner.Result result) {
        rows.clear();
        if (result != null) {
            java.util.List<SmartCleanupScanner.Group> closeDuplicates = new ArrayList<>();
            java.util.List<SmartCleanupScanner.Group> similarGroups = new ArrayList<>();
            for (SmartCleanupScanner.Group group : result.duplicates) (group.similar ? similarGroups : closeDuplicates).add(group);
            for (SmartCleanupScanner.Group group : result.similar) (group.similar ? similarGroups : closeDuplicates).add(group);
            if (!closeDuplicates.isEmpty()) {
                rows.add(new Row("Ảnh trùng lặp • " + count(closeDuplicates) + " media", null));
                for (int i = 0; i < closeDuplicates.size(); i++) {
                    SmartCleanupScanner.Group group = closeDuplicates.get(i);
                    String heading = (group.exact ? "Trùng hoàn toàn" : "Nội dung gần như giống nhau") + " • Nhóm " + (i + 1);
                    long knownTotal = 0, smallest = Long.MAX_VALUE; boolean allSizesKnown = true;
                    for (SmartCleanupMedia item : group.media) {
                        if (item.sizeBytes <= 0) { allSizesKnown = false; break; }
                        knownTotal += item.sizeBytes; smallest = Math.min(smallest, item.sizeBytes);
                    }
                    if (allSizesKnown && group.exact) heading += " • dư thừa ước tính " + Formatter.formatFileSize(context, knownTotal - smallest) + " nếu giữ lại một bản";
                    else if (allSizesKnown) heading += " • tổng dung lượng nhóm " + Formatter.formatFileSize(context, knownTotal);
                    rows.add(new Row(heading, null));
                    for (SmartCleanupMedia item : group.media) rows.add(new Row(null, item));
                }
            }
            if (!similarGroups.isEmpty()) {
                rows.add(new Row("Ảnh tương tự • " + count(similarGroups) + " media", null));
                for (int i = 0; i < similarGroups.size(); i++) {
                    rows.add(new Row("Nhóm tương tự " + (i + 1), null));
                    for (SmartCleanupMedia item : similarGroups.get(i).media) rows.add(new Row(null, item));
                }
            }
            if (!result.largeVideos.isEmpty()) {
                rows.add(new Row("20 video lớn nhất • " + result.largeVideos.size() + " video có dung lượng xác định", null));
                for (SmartCleanupMedia item : result.largeVideos) rows.add(new Row(null, item));
            }
            if (!result.unknownSizeVideos.isEmpty()) {
                rows.add(new Row("Video chưa xác định dung lượng • không xếp hạng", null));
                for (SmartCleanupMedia item : result.unknownSizeVideos) rows.add(new Row(null, item));
            }
        }
        notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    public void setInteractionEnabled(boolean enabled) {
        if (interactionEnabled == enabled) return;
        interactionEnabled = enabled;
        notifyDataSetChanged();
    }

    private int count(List<SmartCleanupScanner.Group> groups) { int count = 0; for (SmartCleanupScanner.Group group : groups) count += group.media.size(); return count; }

    @Override public int getItemViewType(int position) { return rows.get(position).item == null ? TYPE_HEADER : TYPE_MEDIA; }
    @Override public int getItemCount() { return rows.size(); }
    @NonNull @Override public RecyclerView.ViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int type) {
        if (type == TYPE_HEADER) return new HeaderHolder(LayoutInflater.from(context).inflate(R.layout.item_smart_cleanup_header, parent, false));
        return new MediaHolder(LayoutInflater.from(context).inflate(R.layout.item_smart_cleanup_media, parent, false));
    }
    @Override public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull RecyclerView.ViewHolder holder, int position) {
        Row row = rows.get(position);
        if (holder instanceof HeaderHolder) ((HeaderHolder) holder).title.setText(row.header);
        else ((MediaHolder) holder).bind(row.item);
    }

    private final class HeaderHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
        final TextView title; HeaderHolder(View v) { super(v); title = v.findViewById(R.id.tvCleanupGroupHeader); }
    }
    private final class MediaHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
        final ImageView thumbnail; final TextView name, info, source; final CheckBox selected;
        MediaHolder(View v) {
            super(v); thumbnail = v.findViewById(R.id.ivCleanupMedia); name = v.findViewById(R.id.tvCleanupMediaName);
            info = v.findViewById(R.id.tvCleanupMediaInfo); source = v.findViewById(R.id.tvCleanupMediaSource);
            selected = v.findViewById(R.id.cbCleanupMedia);
        }
        void bind(SmartCleanupMedia item) {
            name.setText(item.getName());
            String detail = item.sizeBytes > 0 ? Formatter.formatFileSize(context, item.sizeBytes) : "Chưa xác định dung lượng";
            if (item.video && item.local != null && item.local.getDurationMs() > 0)
                detail += " • " + com.example.th6.utils.VideoDurationFormatter.formatDuration(item.local.getDurationMs());
            info.setText(detail);
            source.setText(item.getSourceLabel() + (item.video ? " • Video" : " • Ảnh"));
            selected.setOnCheckedChangeListener(null);
            selected.setEnabled(interactionEnabled);
            selected.setChecked(item.selected);
            selected.setOnCheckedChangeListener((button, checked) -> { if (item.selected != checked) listener.onToggle(item); });
            selected.setContentDescription(item.selected ? "Đã chọn " + item.getName() : "Chọn " + item.getName());
            String preview = item.getPreviewSource();
            if (item.video && item.local != null && preview != null && !preview.isEmpty()) {
                Glide.with(thumbnail).asBitmap().load(preview).apply(RequestOptions.frameOf(1_000_000L))
                        .centerCrop().placeholder(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder).error(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder).into(thumbnail);
            } else if (item.video || preview == null || preview.isEmpty()) {
                Glide.with(thumbnail).clear(thumbnail); thumbnail.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder);
            } else {
                Glide.with(thumbnail).load(preview).centerCrop().placeholder(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder).error(R.drawable.ic_photo_placeholder).into(thumbnail);
            }
            itemView.setOnClickListener(v -> listener.onOpen(item));
            itemView.setEnabled(interactionEnabled);
        }
    }
}


AuthRepository.kt
package com.example.th6.data

import io.github.jan.supabase.auth.auth
import io.github.jan.supabase.auth.exception.AuthRestException
import io.github.jan.supabase.auth.exception.AuthErrorCode
import io.github.jan.supabase.auth.providers.builtin.Email
import io.github.jan.supabase.auth.status.SessionStatus
import io.github.jan.supabase.auth.user.UserInfo
import io.github.jan.supabase.auth.parseSessionFromFragment
import io.github.jan.supabase.auth.status.SessionSource
import io.github.jan.supabase.exceptions.HttpRequestException
import io.github.jan.supabase.exceptions.RestException
import io.ktor.client.plugins.HttpRequestTimeoutException
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.io.IOException
import java.net.UnknownHostException

class AuthRepository {

    interface AuthCallback {
        fun onSuccess(userId: String?, message: String)
        fun onError(error: String)
    }

    interface SessionCallback {
        fun onResult(isLoggedIn: Boolean, userId: String?, errorMessage: String?)
    }

    interface LogoutCallback {
        fun onComplete(result: LogoutResult)
    }

    data class LogoutResult(
        val localSessionCleared: Boolean,
        val serverSignOutConfirmed: Boolean
    )

    sealed class AuthResult {
        data class Success(val message: String, val userId: String? = null) : AuthResult()
        data class Failure(val exception: Throwable, val message: String) : AuthResult()
    }

    private val auth by lazy {
        SupabaseManager.client.auth
    }

    /**
     * Signs up a new user using email and password via Supabase Auth.
     */
    suspend fun signUp(email: String, pass: String): AuthResult {
        return withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            try {
                auth.signUpWith(Email) {
                    this.email = email
                    this.password = pass
                }
                val user = auth.currentUserOrNull()
                AuthResult.Success("Đăng ký thành công!", user?.id)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                AuthResult.Failure(e, e.localizedMessage ?: "Đăng ký tài khoản thất bại")
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Signs in an existing user using email and password via Supabase Auth.
     */
    suspend fun signIn(email: String, pass: String): AuthResult {
        return withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            try {
                auth.signInWith(Email) {
                    this.email = email
                    this.password = pass
                }
                val session = auth.currentSessionOrNull()
                val userId = session?.user?.id
                if (userId.isNullOrBlank()) {
                    AuthResult.Failure(IllegalStateException("Supabase returned no authenticated session"),
                        "Không thể xác nhận phiên đăng nhập. Vui lòng thử lại.")
                } else {
                    AuthResult.Success("Đăng nhập thành công!", userId)
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                AuthResult.Failure(e, readableAuthError(e))
            }
        }
    }

    private fun readableAuthError(error: Throwable): String {
        var current: Throwable? = error
        while (current != null) {
            when (current) {
                is AuthRestException -> {
                    when (current.errorCode) {
                        AuthErrorCode.InvalidCredentials, AuthErrorCode.UserNotFound ->
                            return "Email hoặc mật khẩu không đúng."
                        AuthErrorCode.EmailNotConfirmed ->
                            return "Email của bạn chưa được xác nhận. Hãy kiểm tra hộp thư."
                        AuthErrorCode.OverRequestRateLimit ->
                            return "Bạn thử đăng nhập quá nhiều lần. Vui lòng đợi rồi thử lại."
                        else -> if (current.statusCode >= 500) {
                            return "Máy chủ xác thực đang gặp sự cố. Vui lòng thử lại sau."
                        }
                    }
                }
                is HttpRequestException, is HttpRequestTimeoutException,
                is UnknownHostException, is IOException ->
                    return "Không thể kết nối máy chủ. Kiểm tra mạng rồi thử lại."
                is RestException -> if (current.statusCode >= 500) {
                    return "Máy chủ xác thực đang gặp sự cố. Vui lòng thử lại sau."
                }
            }
            current = current.cause
        }
        return "Đăng nhập chưa thành công. Vui lòng kiểm tra thông tin và thử lại."
    }

    /**
     * Sends password reset email.
     */
    suspend fun resetPassword(email: String): AuthResult {
        return withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            try {
                auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, redirectUrl = SupabaseManager.AUTH_REDIRECT_URL)
                AuthResult.Success("Đã gửi email hướng dẫn đặt lại mật khẩu.")
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                AuthResult.Failure(e, recoveryRequestError(e))
            }
        }
    }

    suspend fun acceptRecoveryFragment(fragment: String): AuthResult = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        try {
            val session = auth.parseSessionFromFragment(fragment)
            if (!session.type.equals("recovery", ignoreCase = true)) {
                return@withContext AuthResult.Failure(IllegalStateException(), "Liên kết khôi phục không hợp lệ hoặc đã hết hạn.")
            }
            // Verify with Supabase before persisting the external callback session.
            val user = auth.retrieveUser(session.accessToken)
            auth.importSession(session.copy(user = user), source = SessionSource.External)
            AuthResult.Success("recovery")
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            AuthResult.Failure(e, "Liên kết khôi phục không hợp lệ hoặc đã hết hạn. Hãy yêu cầu liên kết mới.")
        }
    }

    suspend fun updateRecoveredPassword(password: String): AuthResult = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        try {
            val session = auth.currentSessionOrNull()
            if (session == null || !session.type.equals("recovery", ignoreCase = true)) {
                return@withContext AuthResult.Failure(IllegalStateException(), "Phiên khôi phục không hợp lệ hoặc đã hết hạn. Hãy yêu cầu liên kết mới.")
            }
            auth.updateUser { this.password = password }
            auth.clearSession()
            AuthResult.Success("Mật khẩu đã được cập nhật. Vui lòng đăng nhập lại.")
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            AuthResult.Failure(e, readableRecoveryUpdateError(e))
        }
    }

    private fun recoveryRequestError(error: Throwable): String = when {
        isNetworkError(error) -> "Không thể kết nối. Kiểm tra mạng rồi thử lại."
        error is AuthRestException && error.statusCode >= 500 -> "Máy chủ xác thực đang gặp sự cố. Vui lòng thử lại sau."
        error is RestException && error.statusCode >= 500 -> "Máy chủ xác thực đang gặp sự cố. Vui lòng thử lại sau."
        else -> "Chưa thể gửi yêu cầu khôi phục. Vui lòng thử lại sau."
    }

    private fun readableRecoveryUpdateError(error: Throwable): String {
        var current: Throwable? = error
        while (current != null) {
            if (current is AuthRestException && current.errorCode == AuthErrorCode.WeakPassword) {
                return "Mật khẩu chưa đáp ứng chính sách bảo mật. Hãy chọn mật khẩu khác."
            }
            if (current is RestException && current.statusCode >= 500 || current is AuthRestException && current.statusCode >= 500) {
                return "Máy chủ xác thực đang gặp sự cố. Vui lòng thử lại sau."
            }
            if (isNetworkError(current)) return "Không thể kết nối. Kiểm tra mạng rồi thử lại."
            current = current.cause
        }
