        return "Chưa thể cập nhật mật khẩu. Phiên có thể đã hết hạn; hãy yêu cầu liên kết mới."
    }

    private fun isNetworkError(error: Throwable): Boolean {
        var current: Throwable? = error
        while (current != null) {
            if (current is HttpRequestException || current is HttpRequestTimeoutException ||
                current is UnknownHostException || current is IOException) return true
            current = current.cause
        }
        return false
    }

    /**
     * Checks if the current user has a valid active session in Supabase Auth.
     */
    suspend fun checkIsLoggedIn(): Boolean {
        return withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            try {
                auth.awaitInitialization()
                auth.currentSessionOrNull()?.user?.id?.isNotBlank() == true
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                false
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Synchronous session check returning true if current user info is cached.
     */
    fun isLoggedIn(): Boolean {
        return auth.currentUserOrNull() != null && auth.currentSessionOrNull() != null
    }

    /**
     * Signs out the user session from Supabase Auth and clears session tokens.
     */
    suspend fun signOut(): LogoutResult {
        return withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            try {
                auth.signOut()
                val cleared = auth.currentSessionOrNull() == null
                if (cleared) LogoutResult(true, true) else {
                    auth.clearSession()
                    LogoutResult(auth.currentSessionOrNull() == null, false)
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                // A network failure may prevent remote token revocation. Always clear the
                // device session so the user cannot continue into private screens here.
                try {
                    auth.clearSession()
                    LogoutResult(auth.currentSessionOrNull() == null, false)
                } catch (_: Exception) {
                    LogoutResult(false, false)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Returns the currently authenticated user info, or null if not logged in.
     */
    fun getCurrentUser(): UserInfo? {
        return auth.currentUserOrNull()
    }

    /**
     * Returns the currently authenticated user's ID, or null.
     */
    fun getCurrentUserUid(): String? {
        return auth.currentUserOrNull()?.id
    }

    // --- Java Async Callback Helpers ---

    fun checkIsLoggedInAsync(callback: SessionCallback) {
        CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO).launch {
            var loggedIn = false
            var uid: String? = null
            var errorMessage: String? = null
            try {
                auth.awaitInitialization()
                when (val status = auth.sessionStatus.value) {
                    is SessionStatus.Authenticated -> {
                        uid = status.session.user?.id
                        loggedIn = !uid.isNullOrBlank()
                    }
                    is SessionStatus.RefreshFailure -> {
                        errorMessage = "Không thể xác minh phiên đăng nhập. Kiểm tra mạng rồi thử lại."
                    }
                    else -> Unit
                }
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                errorMessage = "Không thể kiểm tra phiên đăng nhập. Kiểm tra mạng rồi thử lại."
            }
            withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                callback.onResult(loggedIn, uid, errorMessage)
            }
        }
    }

    fun signUpAsync(email: String, pass: String, callback: AuthCallback) {
        CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO).launch {
            when (val result = signUp(email, pass)) {
                is AuthResult.Success -> {
                    withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                        callback.onSuccess(result.userId, result.message)
                    }
                }
                is AuthResult.Failure -> {
                    withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                        callback.onError(result.message)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun signInAsync(email: String, pass: String, callback: AuthCallback) {
        CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO).launch {
            when (val result = signIn(email, pass)) {
                is AuthResult.Success -> {
                    withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                        callback.onSuccess(result.userId, result.message)
                    }
                }
                is AuthResult.Failure -> {
                    withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                        callback.onError(result.message)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun resetPasswordAsync(email: String, callback: AuthCallback) {
        CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO).launch {
            when (val result = resetPassword(email)) {
                is AuthResult.Success -> {
                    withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                        callback.onSuccess(null, result.message)
                    }
                }
                is AuthResult.Failure -> {
                    withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                        callback.onError(result.message)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun signOutAsync(callback: LogoutCallback?) {
        CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO).launch {
            val result = signOut()
            callback?.let {
                withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                    it.onComplete(result)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}


LocalAlbumStore.java
package com.example.th6.data;

import android.content.ContentValues;
import android.content.Context;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteDatabase;
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteOpenHelper;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/** Device-local memberships for media that has not been backed up yet. */
public final class LocalAlbumStore extends SQLiteOpenHelper {
    private static final String DB_NAME = "photovault_local_albums.db";
    private static final int DB_VERSION = 1;
    private static final String MEMBERS = "local_album_members";
    private static final String COVERS = "local_album_covers";

    public LocalAlbumStore(Context context) { super(context.getApplicationContext(), DB_NAME, null, DB_VERSION); }

    @Override public void onCreate(SQLiteDatabase db) {
        db.execSQL("CREATE TABLE " + MEMBERS + " (uid TEXT NOT NULL, album_id TEXT NOT NULL, media_key TEXT NOT NULL, added_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(uid,album_id,media_key))");
        db.execSQL("CREATE TABLE " + COVERS + " (uid TEXT NOT NULL, album_id TEXT NOT NULL, media_key TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(uid,album_id))");
    }
    @Override public void onUpgrade(SQLiteDatabase db, int oldVersion, int newVersion) { }

    public synchronized boolean add(String uid, String albumId, String mediaKey) {
        ContentValues v = new ContentValues(); v.put("uid", uid); v.put("album_id", albumId); v.put("media_key", mediaKey); v.put("added_at", System.currentTimeMillis());
        return getWritableDatabase().insertWithOnConflict(MEMBERS, null, v, SQLiteDatabase.CONFLICT_IGNORE) != -1;
    }
    public synchronized boolean remove(String uid, String albumId, String mediaKey) {
        return getWritableDatabase().delete(MEMBERS, "uid=? AND album_id=? AND media_key=?", new String[]{uid, albumId, mediaKey}) > 0;
    }
    public synchronized List<String> getMembers(String uid, String albumId) {
        List<String> result = new ArrayList<>();
        try (Cursor c = getReadableDatabase().query(MEMBERS, new String[]{"media_key"}, "uid=? AND album_id=?", new String[]{uid, albumId}, null, null, "added_at ASC, media_key ASC")) {
            while (c.moveToNext()) result.add(c.getString(0));
        }
        return result;
    }
    public synchronized boolean hasMember(String uid, String albumId, String mediaKey) {
        try (Cursor c = getReadableDatabase().query(MEMBERS, new String[]{"media_key"}, "uid=? AND album_id=? AND media_key=?", new String[]{uid, albumId, mediaKey}, null, null, null, "1")) { return c.moveToFirst(); }
    }
    public synchronized String getCover(String uid, String albumId) {
        try (Cursor c = getReadableDatabase().query(COVERS, new String[]{"media_key"}, "uid=? AND album_id=?", new String[]{uid, albumId}, null, null, null, "1")) { return c.moveToFirst() ? c.getString(0) : null; }
    }
    public synchronized void setCover(String uid, String albumId, String mediaKey) {
        ContentValues v = new ContentValues(); v.put("uid", uid); v.put("album_id", albumId); v.put("media_key", mediaKey);
        getWritableDatabase().insertWithOnConflict(COVERS, null, v, SQLiteDatabase.CONFLICT_REPLACE);
    }
    public synchronized void clearCover(String uid, String albumId) {
        getWritableDatabase().delete(COVERS, "uid=? AND album_id=?", new String[]{uid, albumId});
    }
    public synchronized void deleteAlbum(String uid, String albumId) {
        SQLiteDatabase db = getWritableDatabase();
        db.beginTransaction();
        try {
            db.delete(MEMBERS, "uid=? AND album_id=?", new String[]{uid, albumId});
            db.delete(COVERS, "uid=? AND album_id=?", new String[]{uid, albumId});
            db.setTransactionSuccessful();
        } finally { db.endTransaction(); }
    }
}


PhotoRepository.kt
package com.example.th6.data

import com.example.th6.models.Album
import com.example.th6.models.Photo
import com.example.th6.models.UserProfile
import io.github.jan.supabase.postgrest.from
import io.github.jan.supabase.postgrest.query.Order
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive
import kotlinx.serialization.json.buildJsonObject
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException

class PhotoRepository {

    interface Callback<T> {
        fun onSuccess(result: T)
        fun onError(error: String)
    }

    companion object {
        const val TABLE_PHOTOS = "photos"
        const val TABLE_ALBUMS = "albums"
        const val TABLE_USERS = "users"
    }

    private val photosTable by lazy { SupabaseManager.client.from(TABLE_PHOTOS) }
    private val albumsTable by lazy { SupabaseManager.client.from(TABLE_ALBUMS) }
    private val usersTable by lazy { SupabaseManager.client.from(TABLE_USERS) }

    // --- PHOTOS ---

    suspend fun getAllPhotos(): List<Photo> {
        return withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            photosTable.select().decodeList<Photo>()
        }
    }

    suspend fun getPhotosByUser(userId: String): List<Photo> {
        return withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            photosTable.select {
                filter {
                    eq("user_id", userId)
                }
            }.decodeList<Photo>()
        }
    }

    /** Fetch the complete account library in bounded PostgREST pages for media analysis. */
    suspend fun getPhotosByUserPaged(userId: String, pageSize: Long = 500L): List<Photo> = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        require(userId.isNotBlank()) { "A signed-in UID is required" }
        require(pageSize in 1L..1000L) { "Page size must be between 1 and 1000" }
        val result = ArrayList<Photo>()
        var offset = 0L
        while (true) {
            val page = photosTable.select {
                filter { eq("user_id", userId) }
                order("id", Order.ASCENDING)
                range(offset, offset + pageSize - 1)
            }.decodeList<Photo>()
            result.addAll(page)
            if (page.size.toLong() < pageSize) break
            offset += pageSize
        }
        result
    }

    suspend fun getPhotoByUser(userId: String, photoId: String): Photo? = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        photosTable.select {
            filter { eq("user_id", userId); eq("id", photoId) }
            range(0, 0)
        }.decodeList<Photo>().firstOrNull()
    }

    suspend fun getPhotos(userId: String): List<Photo> = getPhotosByUser(userId)

    suspend fun insertPhoto(photo: Photo) {
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            photosTable.insert(photo)
        }
    }

    suspend fun savePhoto(photo: Photo) {
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            photosTable.upsert(photo)
        }
    }

    suspend fun saveBackupPhoto(photo: Photo) {
        val uri = photo.localMediaUri
        if (photo.id.isEmpty() && !uri.isNullOrEmpty()) {
            // Include the account in the deterministic key: the same MediaStore URI
            // can exist for different signed-in users on one device.
            photo.id = "backup_" + sha256(photo.ownerUid + "|" + uri)
        } else if (photo.id.isEmpty()) {
            photo.id = "backup_" + sha256(photo.ownerUid + "|" + System.currentTimeMillis())
        }
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            photosTable.upsert(photo)
        }
    }

    private fun sha256(value: String): String {
        try {
            val digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(value.toByteArray(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
            val result = StringBuilder(digest.size * 2)
            for (b in digest) {
                result.append(String.format(java.util.Locale.US, "%02x", b.toInt() and 0xff))
            }
            return result.toString()
        } catch (e: NoSuchAlgorithmException) {
            throw IllegalStateException("SHA-256 unavailable", e)
        }
    }

    suspend fun updatePhoto(photo: Photo) {
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            photosTable.update(photo) {
                filter {
                    eq("id", photo.id)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    suspend fun updatePhoto(photoId: String, newName: String) {
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            photosTable.update(
                buildJsonObject { put("title", JsonPrimitive(newName)) }
            ) {
                filter {
                    eq("id", photoId)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    suspend fun toggleFavorite(photoId: String, isFavorite: Boolean) {
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            photosTable.update(
                buildJsonObject { put("is_favorite", JsonPrimitive(isFavorite)) }
            ) {
                filter {
                    eq("id", photoId)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    suspend fun toggleFavorite(userId: String, photoId: String, isFavorite: Boolean) {
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            photosTable.update(
                buildJsonObject { put("is_favorite", JsonPrimitive(isFavorite)) }
            ) {
                filter {
                    eq("user_id", userId)
                    eq("id", photoId)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    suspend fun moveToTrash(photoId: String, isTrashed: Boolean) {
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            photosTable.update(
                buildJsonObject {
                    put("is_trashed", JsonPrimitive(isTrashed))
                    put("trashed_at", JsonPrimitive(if (isTrashed) System.currentTimeMillis() else 0L))
                }
            ) {
                filter {
                    eq("id", photoId)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    suspend fun moveToTrash(userId: String, photoId: String, isTrashed: Boolean) {
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            photosTable.update(
                buildJsonObject {
                    put("is_trashed", JsonPrimitive(isTrashed))
                    put("trashed_at", JsonPrimitive(if (isTrashed) System.currentTimeMillis() else 0L))
                }
            ) {
                filter {
                    eq("id", photoId)
                    eq("user_id", userId)
                }
            }
            val updated = getPhotosByUser(userId).firstOrNull { it.id == photoId }
                ?: throw IllegalStateException("Photo row was not found for the current user")
            if (updated.isTrashed != isTrashed) {
                throw IllegalStateException("Photo trash state was not updated")
            }
        }
    }

    suspend fun deletePhoto(photoId: String) {
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            photosTable.delete {
                filter {
                    eq("id", photoId)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    suspend fun deletePhoto(userId: String, photoId: String) {
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            photosTable.delete {
                filter {
                    eq("id", photoId)
                    eq("user_id", userId)
                }
            }
            if (getPhotosByUser(userId).any { it.id == photoId }) {
                throw IllegalStateException("Photo metadata still exists for the current user")
            }
        }
    }

    suspend fun updatePhotoAlbums(photoId: String, albumIds: List<String>) {
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            photosTable.update(
                buildJsonObject {
                    put("album_ids", kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonArray(albumIds.map(::JsonPrimitive)))
                }
            ) {
                filter {
                    eq("id", photoId)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    suspend fun updatePhotoAlbums(userId: String, photoId: String, albumIds: List<String>) {
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            val ownedAlbumIds = getAlbums(userId).map { it.id }.toSet()
            val current = getPhotosByUser(userId).firstOrNull { it.id == photoId }
                ?: throw IllegalStateException("Photo row was not found for the current user")
            val newlyRequestedForeignIds = albumIds.filter { it !in ownedAlbumIds && it !in current.albumIds }
            if (newlyRequestedForeignIds.isNotEmpty()) {
                throw IllegalStateException("Album membership contains an album not owned by the current user")
            }
            // Drop stale IDs left by an album deleted earlier, while retaining every
            // currently owned relationship supplied by the caller.
            val normalizedIds = albumIds.distinct().filter { it in ownedAlbumIds }
            photosTable.update(
                buildJsonObject { put("album_ids", kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonArray(normalizedIds.map(::JsonPrimitive))) }
            ) {
                filter { eq("id", photoId); eq("user_id", userId) }
            }
            val updated = getPhotosByUser(userId).firstOrNull { it.id == photoId }
                ?: throw IllegalStateException("Photo row was not found for the current user")
            if (updated.albumIds.toSet() != normalizedIds.toSet()) throw IllegalStateException("Album membership was not updated")
        }
    }

    suspend fun addPhotoToAlbum(userId: String, photoId: String, albumId: String) {
        val ownedAlbumIds = getAlbums(userId).map { it.id }.toSet()
        if (albumId !in ownedAlbumIds) throw IllegalStateException("Album was not found for the current user")
        val photo = getPhotosByUser(userId).firstOrNull { it.id == photoId }
            ?: throw IllegalStateException("Photo row was not found for the current user")
        val ids = photo.albumIds.filter { it in ownedAlbumIds }.toMutableList()
        if (!ids.contains(albumId)) ids.add(albumId)
        updatePhotoAlbums(userId, photoId, ids)
    }

    suspend fun removePhotoFromAlbum(userId: String, photoId: String, albumId: String) {
        val ownedAlbumIds = getAlbums(userId).map { it.id }.toSet()
        if (albumId !in ownedAlbumIds) throw IllegalStateException("Album was not found for the current user")
        val photo = getPhotosByUser(userId).firstOrNull { it.id == photoId }
            ?: throw IllegalStateException("Photo row was not found for the current user")
        updatePhotoAlbums(userId, photoId, photo.albumIds.filter { it != albumId && it in ownedAlbumIds })
    }

    // --- ALBUMS ---

    suspend fun getAlbums(userId: String): List<Album> {
        return withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            albumsTable.select {
                filter {
                    eq("owner_uid", userId)
                }
            }.decodeList<Album>()
        }
    }

    suspend fun createAlbum(album: Album) {
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            albumsTable.upsert(album)
            if (getAlbums(album.ownerUid).none { it.id == album.id }) {
                throw IllegalStateException("Album was not created for the current user")
            }
        }
    }

    suspend fun deleteAlbum(albumId: String) {
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            albumsTable.delete {
                filter {
                    eq("id", albumId)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    suspend fun deleteAlbum(userId: String, albumId: String) {
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            if (getAlbums(userId).none { it.id == albumId }) throw IllegalStateException("Album was not found for the current user")
            albumsTable.delete { filter { eq("id", albumId); eq("owner_uid", userId) } }
            if (getAlbums(userId).any { it.id == albumId }) throw IllegalStateException("Album was not deleted for the current user")
        }
    }

    suspend fun updateAlbumName(albumId: String, newName: String) {
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            albumsTable.update(
                buildJsonObject { put("name", JsonPrimitive(newName)) }
            ) {
                filter {
                    eq("id", albumId)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    suspend fun updateAlbumName(userId: String, albumId: String, newName: String) {
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            albumsTable.update(buildJsonObject { put("name", JsonPrimitive(newName)) }) {
                filter { eq("id", albumId); eq("owner_uid", userId) }
            }
            val updated = getAlbums(userId).firstOrNull { it.id == albumId }
                ?: throw IllegalStateException("Album was not found for the current user")
            if (updated.name != newName) throw IllegalStateException("Album name was not updated")
        }
    }

    suspend fun updateAlbumCoverUrl(userId: String, albumId: String, coverUrl: String) {
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            if (getAlbums(userId).none { it.id == albumId }) throw IllegalStateException("Album was not found for the current user")
            if (coverUrl.isNotEmpty() && getPhotosByUser(userId).none {
                    !it.isTrashed && it.imageUrl == coverUrl && it.albumIds.contains(albumId)
                }) throw IllegalStateException("Cover media must belong to this album and current user")
            albumsTable.update(buildJsonObject { put("cover_image_url", JsonPrimitive(coverUrl)) }) {
                filter { eq("id", albumId); eq("owner_uid", userId) }
            }
            val updated = getAlbums(userId).firstOrNull { it.id == albumId }
                ?: throw IllegalStateException("Album was not found for the current user")
            if (updated.coverImageUrl != coverUrl) throw IllegalStateException("Album cover was not updated")
        }
    }

    // --- USER PROFILE ---

    suspend fun createUserProfile(profile: UserProfile) {
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            usersTable.upsert(profile)
        }
    }

    suspend fun getUserProfile(uid: String): UserProfile? {
        return withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            try {
                usersTable.select {
                    filter {
                        eq("uid", uid)
                    }
                }.decodeSingleOrNull<UserProfile>()
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                null
            }
        }
    }

    suspend fun updateUserProfile(
        uid: String,
        updates: Map<String, Any>,
        fallbackDisplayName: String,
        fallbackEmail: String
    ) {
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            require(uid.isNotBlank()) { "A signed-in user is required" }
            require(updates.keys.all { it == "display_name" || it == "photo_url" }) {
                "Unsupported profile field"
            }

            // Email confirmation can leave a valid Auth user without a row in public.users.
            // A PostgREST UPDATE against that missing row succeeds with zero rows, so merge
            // the requested fields into a complete profile and upsert it instead.
            val existing = usersTable.select {
                filter { eq("uid", uid) }
            }.decodeSingleOrNull<UserProfile>()

            val profile = UserProfile(
                uid = uid,
                displayName = (updates["display_name"] as? String)
                    ?: existing?.displayName?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
                    ?: fallbackDisplayName,
                email = existing?.email?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: fallbackEmail,
                photoUrl = (updates["photo_url"] as? String)
                    ?: existing?.photoUrl.orEmpty(),
                createdAt = existing?.createdAt?.takeIf { it > 0L } ?: System.currentTimeMillis()
            )

            usersTable.upsert(profile)

            val saved = usersTable.select {
                filter { eq("uid", uid) }
            }.decodeSingleOrNull<UserProfile>()
                ?: throw IllegalStateException("Profile row was not saved")
            if (saved.displayName != profile.displayName || saved.photoUrl != profile.photoUrl) {
                throw IllegalStateException("Profile values did not persist")
            }
        }
    }

    private fun Map<String, Any>.toJsonObject(): JsonObject = buildJsonObject {
        for ((key, value) in this@toJsonObject) {
            when (value) {
                is String -> put(key, JsonPrimitive(value))
                is Boolean -> put(key, JsonPrimitive(value))
                is Int -> put(key, JsonPrimitive(value))
                is Long -> put(key, JsonPrimitive(value))
                is Double -> put(key, JsonPrimitive(value))
                is Float -> put(key, JsonPrimitive(value.toDouble()))
                else -> throw IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported update value type")
            }
        }
    }

StorageRepository.kt
package com.example.th6.data

import android.content.Context
import android.net.Uri
import android.provider.OpenableColumns
import io.github.jan.supabase.storage.storage
import io.github.jan.supabase.storage.upload
import io.github.jan.supabase.storage.FileObject
import io.ktor.http.ContentType
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext

/** Storage operations for the public PhotoVault bucket. URI uploads use SDK streaming APIs. */
class StorageRepository {
    interface UploadCallback {
        fun onSuccess(publicUrl: String)
        fun onError(error: String)
    }
    interface DeleteCallback {
        fun onSuccess()
        fun onError(error: String)
    }
    interface UsageCallback {
        fun onSuccess(bytes: Long)
        fun onError(error: String)
    }
    sealed class Result {
        data class Success(val publicUrl: String) : Result()
        data class Failure(val exception: Throwable, val message: String) : Result()
    }
    companion object {
        const val BUCKET_NAME = "photos_bucket"
        const val MAX_FILE_BYTES = 50L * 1024L * 1024L
    }

    private val bucket by lazy { SupabaseManager.client.storage.from(BUCKET_NAME) }
    fun getImageUrl(path: String): String = bucket.publicUrl(path)

    fun objectPathFromPublicUrl(publicUrl: String?): String {
        if (publicUrl.isNullOrBlank()) return ""
        val segments = Uri.parse(publicUrl).pathSegments
        val index = segments.indexOf(BUCKET_NAME)
        return if (index >= 0 && index + 1 < segments.size) segments.subList(index + 1, segments.size).joinToString("/") else ""
    }

    /** Upload a content URI without buffering the entire image/video in memory. */
    suspend fun uploadMedia(context: Context, uri: Uri, path: String, mimeType: String?): Result = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        try {
            val appContext = context.applicationContext
            val size = querySize(appContext, uri)
            if (size <= 0L) return@withContext Result.Failure(IllegalArgumentException("Unknown media size"), "Không xác định được dung lượng tệp.")
            if (size > MAX_FILE_BYTES) return@withContext Result.Failure(IllegalArgumentException("Media exceeds bucket limit"), "Tệp vượt giới hạn 50 MiB của bucket.")
            appContext.contentResolver.openAssetFileDescriptor(uri, "r")?.use { }
                ?: return@withContext Result.Failure(IllegalArgumentException("Unreadable URI"), "Không còn quyền đọc tệp đã chọn.")
            bucket.upload(path = path, uri = uri) {
                upsert = true
                contentType = mimeType?.takeIf { it.contains('/') }?.let { ContentType.parse(it) }
            }
            Result.Success(bucket.publicUrl(path))
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            val message = when {
                e is SecurityException -> "Không còn quyền đọc tệp. Hãy chọn lại tệp và thử lại."
                e.cause is java.io.IOException || e is java.io.IOException -> "Không thể đọc tệp hoặc kết nối mạng. Kiểm tra quyền truy cập và mạng rồi thử lại."
                else -> e.localizedMessage?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: "Không thể tải tệp lên Supabase Storage."
            }
            Result.Failure(e, message)
        }
    }

    private fun querySize(context: Context, uri: Uri): Long {
        context.contentResolver.query(uri, arrayOf(OpenableColumns.SIZE), null, null, null)?.use { cursor ->
            if (cursor.moveToFirst()) {
                val index = cursor.getColumnIndex(OpenableColumns.SIZE)
                if (index >= 0 && !cursor.isNull(index)) return cursor.getLong(index)
            }
        }
        return context.contentResolver.openAssetFileDescriptor(uri, "r")?.use { it.length } ?: -1L
    }

    suspend fun uploadImage(byteArray: ByteArray, fileName: String): Result = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        try {
            if (byteArray.size > MAX_FILE_BYTES) return@withContext Result.Failure(IllegalArgumentException("Image exceeds limit"), "Tệp vượt giới hạn 50 MiB.")
            bucket.upload(path = fileName, data = byteArray) { upsert = true }
            Result.Success(bucket.publicUrl(fileName))
        } catch (e: Exception) { Result.Failure(e, e.localizedMessage ?: "Lỗi upload ảnh lên Supabase Storage") }
    }

    suspend fun uploadImage(context: Context, uri: Uri, fileName: String): Result = uploadMedia(context, uri, fileName, context.contentResolver.getType(uri))

    suspend fun deleteImage(path: String): Result = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        try { bucket.delete(path); Result.Success(bucket.publicUrl(path)) }
        catch (e: Exception) { Result.Failure(e, e.localizedMessage ?: "Lỗi xóa tệp khỏi Supabase Storage") }
    }

    /** Sum the actual object sizes visible to the signed-in user through Storage RLS. */
    suspend fun getCurrentUserStorageBytes(userId: String): Long = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        require(userId.isNotBlank()) { "A signed-in user is required" }
        val pendingPrefixes = ArrayDeque<String>()
        pendingPrefixes.add("")
        var total = 0L
        while (pendingPrefixes.isNotEmpty()) {
            val prefix = pendingPrefixes.removeFirst()
            var offset = 0
            while (true) {
                val page = bucket.list(prefix = prefix) {
                    limit = 100
                    this.offset = offset
                }
                for (item: FileObject in page) {
                    if (item.id == null) {
                        pendingPrefixes.add(prefix + item.name.trimEnd('/') + "/")
                    } else {
                        val rawSize = item.metadata?.get("size")?.toString()?.trim('"')
                        val size = rawSize?.toLongOrNull()
                            ?: throw IllegalStateException("Storage did not return a valid size for ${item.name}")
                        if (size < 0L) throw IllegalStateException("Storage returned a negative object size")
                        total = Math.addExact(total, size)
                    }
                }
                if (page.size < 100) break
                offset += page.size
            }
        }
        total
    }

    fun getCurrentUserStorageBytesAsync(userId: String, callback: UsageCallback) = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO).launch {
        try {
            val bytes = getCurrentUserStorageBytes(userId)
            withContext(Dispatchers.Main) { callback.onSuccess(bytes) }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            withContext(Dispatchers.Main) { callback.onError(e.localizedMessage ?: "Không thể tải dung lượng Storage") }
        }
    }

    fun uploadImageAsync(byteArray: ByteArray, fileName: String, callback: UploadCallback) = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO).launch {
        dispatchUpload(uploadImage(byteArray, fileName), callback)
    }
    fun uploadImageAsync(context: Context, uri: Uri, fileName: String, callback: UploadCallback) = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO).launch {
        dispatchUpload(uploadImage(context, uri, fileName), callback)
    }
    fun uploadMediaAsync(context: Context, uri: Uri, path: String, mimeType: String?, callback: UploadCallback) = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO).launch {
        dispatchUpload(uploadMedia(context, uri, path, mimeType), callback)
    }
    private suspend fun dispatchUpload(result: Result, callback: UploadCallback) {
        withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
            when (result) {
                is Result.Success -> callback.onSuccess(result.publicUrl)
                is Result.Failure -> callback.onError(result.message)
            }
        }
    }
    fun deleteImageAsync(path: String, callback: DeleteCallback) = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO).launch {
        when (val result = deleteImage(path)) {
            is Result.Success -> withContext(Dispatchers.Main) { callback.onSuccess() }
            is Result.Failure -> withContext(Dispatchers.Main) { callback.onError(result.message) }
        }
    }
}

AlbumFragment.java
package com.example.th6.fragments;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.text.TextUtils;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog;
import androidx.appcompat.widget.PopupMenu;
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.GridLayoutManager;

import com.example.th6.R;
import com.example.th6.activities.AlbumDetailActivity;
import com.example.th6.adapters.AlbumAdapter;
import com.example.th6.data.AuthRepository;
import com.example.th6.data.PhotoRepository;
import com.example.th6.databinding.FragmentAlbumBinding;
import com.example.th6.models.Album;
import com.example.th6.models.LocalMediaPhoto;
import com.example.th6.models.Photo;
import com.example.th6.data.LocalAlbumStore;
import com.example.th6.services.DevicePhotoScanner;
import com.example.th6.utils.PhotoVaultTrashCache;
import io.github.jan.supabase.auth.user.UserInfo;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

public class AlbumFragment extends Fragment implements AlbumAdapter.OnAlbumActionListener {

    private FragmentAlbumBinding binding;
    private AlbumAdapter albumAdapter;
    private PhotoRepository repository;
    private AuthRepository authRepository;
    private List<Album> albumList = new ArrayList<>();

    @Override
    public void onCreate(@Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        authRepository = new AuthRepository();
        repository = new PhotoRepository();
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public View onCreateView(@NonNull LayoutInflater inflater, @Nullable ViewGroup container, @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        binding = FragmentAlbumBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false);
        return binding.getRoot();
    }

    @Override
    public void onViewCreated(@NonNull View view, @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState);

        setupRecyclerView();
        setupListeners();
        loadAlbums();
    }

    private void setupRecyclerView() {
        albumAdapter = new AlbumAdapter(requireContext(), this);
        binding.rvAlbums.setLayoutManager(new GridLayoutManager(requireContext(), 2));
        binding.rvAlbums.setAdapter(albumAdapter);
    }

    private void setupListeners() {
        binding.swipeRefresh.setOnRefreshListener(this::loadAlbums);
        binding.btnCreateAlbum.setOnClickListener(v -> showCreateAlbumDialog());
    }

    private void loadAlbums() {
        UserInfo user = authRepository.getCurrentUser();
        if (user == null || binding == null) return;
        String requestedUid = user.getId();

        binding.progressBar.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        repository.getAlbumsAsync(requestedUid, new PhotoRepository.Callback<List<Album>>() {
            @Override
            public void onSuccess(List<Album> albums) {
                UserInfo activeUser = authRepository.getCurrentUser();
                if (binding == null || !isAdded() || activeUser == null || !requestedUid.equals(activeUser.getId())) return;
                binding.progressBar.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                binding.swipeRefresh.setRefreshing(false);
                albumList = albums != null ? albums : new ArrayList<>();
                albumAdapter.setAlbums(albumList);
                updateEmptyState();
                repository.getPhotosByUserAsync(requestedUid, new PhotoRepository.Callback<List<Photo>>() {
                    @Override public void onSuccess(List<Photo> photos) {
                        new DevicePhotoScanner().scanPhotos(requireContext(), new DevicePhotoScanner.ScanCallback() {
                            @Override public void onScanComplete(List<LocalMediaPhoto> localItems) {
                                UserInfo current = authRepository.getCurrentUser();
                                if (binding == null || !isAdded() || current == null || !requestedUid.equals(current.getId())) return;
                                java.util.Map<String, LocalMediaPhoto> byUri = new java.util.HashMap<>();
                                for (LocalMediaPhoto local : localItems) byUri.put(local.getContentUri(), local);
                                java.util.Map<String, java.util.Set<String>> members = new java.util.HashMap<>();
                                java.util.Map<String, List<Photo>> cloudMembers = new java.util.HashMap<>();
                                java.util.Set<String> trashedLocalKeys = new java.util.HashSet<>();
                                java.util.Set<String> localTrashIdentities = PhotoVaultTrashCache.getLocalMediaIdentityKeys(requireContext());
                                for (LocalMediaPhoto local : localItems) if (PhotoVaultTrashCache.isLocalMediaTrashed(localTrashIdentities, local)) trashedLocalKeys.add(AlbumMediaPickerActivityKey.forLocal(local));
                                if (photos != null) for (Photo photo : photos) {
                                    LocalMediaPhoto local = byUri.get(photo.getLocalMediaUri());
                                    if (photo.isTrashed()) { if (local != null) trashedLocalKeys.add(AlbumMediaPickerActivityKey.forLocal(local)); continue; }
                                    if (photo.getAlbumIds() == null) continue;
                                    String mediaKey = local == null ? "cloud:" + photo.getId() : AlbumMediaPickerActivityKey.forLocal(local);
                                    for (String albumId : photo.getAlbumIds()) {
                                        members.computeIfAbsent(albumId, ignored -> new java.util.HashSet<>()).add(mediaKey);
                                        cloudMembers.computeIfAbsent(albumId, ignored -> new ArrayList<>()).add(photo);
                                    }
                                }
                                try (LocalAlbumStore store = new LocalAlbumStore(requireContext())) {
                                    for (Album album : albumList) {
                                        java.util.Set<String> all = members.computeIfAbsent(album.getId(), ignored -> new java.util.HashSet<>());
                                        java.util.Set<String> availableLocalKeys = new java.util.HashSet<>();
                                        for (LocalMediaPhoto local : localItems) availableLocalKeys.add(AlbumMediaPickerActivityKey.forLocal(local));
                                        java.util.Set<String> localMemberships = new java.util.HashSet<>(store.getMembers(requestedUid, album.getId()));
                                        for (String key : localMemberships) if (availableLocalKeys.contains(key) && !trashedLocalKeys.contains(key)) all.add(key);
                                        album.setPhotoCount(all.size());
                                        List<Photo> cloud = cloudMembers.getOrDefault(album.getId(), new ArrayList<>());
                                        cloud.sort(java.util.Comparator.comparingLong(Photo::getCreatedAt).thenComparing(Photo::getId));
                                        boolean cloudCoverValid = false;
                                        if (album.getCoverImageUrl() != null) for (Photo p : cloud) if (album.getCoverImageUrl().equals(p.getImageUrl())) cloudCoverValid = true;
                                        String localCover = store.getCover(requestedUid, album.getId());
                                        LocalMediaPhoto localCoverItem = null;
                                        if (localCover != null && localMemberships.contains(localCover)) for (LocalMediaPhoto local : localItems) if (localCover.equals(AlbumMediaPickerActivityKey.forLocal(local)) && !trashedLocalKeys.contains(localCover)) { localCoverItem = local; break; }
                                        album.setDisplayCoverUri(localCoverItem == null ? "" : localCoverItem.getContentUri());
                                        Photo selectedCloudCover = null;
                                        if (cloudCoverValid) for (Photo p : cloud) if (album.getCoverImageUrl().equals(p.getImageUrl())) { selectedCloudCover = p; break; }
                                        album.setDisplayCoverVideo(localCoverItem != null ? localCoverItem.isVideo() : selectedCloudCover != null && "video".equalsIgnoreCase(selectedCloudCover.getMediaType()));
                                        if (!cloudCoverValid && localCoverItem == null && !cloud.isEmpty()) {
                                            Photo first = cloud.get(0);
                                            album.setCoverImageUrl(first.getImageUrl());
                                            album.setDisplayCoverVideo("video".equalsIgnoreCase(first.getMediaType()));
                                            repository.updateAlbumCoverUrlAsync(requestedUid, album.getId(), first.getImageUrl(), new PhotoRepository.Callback<Void>() {
                                                @Override public void onSuccess(Void result) { }
                                                @Override public void onError(String error) { }
                                            });
                                        } else if (!cloudCoverValid && localCoverItem == null && all.isEmpty()) {
                                            album.setCoverImageUrl(""); store.clearCover(requestedUid, album.getId());
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                albumAdapter.setAlbums(albumList);
                            }
                            @Override public void onScanError(String error) {
                                if (binding == null || !isAdded()) return;
                                albumAdapter.setAlbums(albumList);
                            }
                        });
                    }
                    @Override public void onError(String error) {
                        if (binding == null || !isAdded() || getContext() == null) return;
                        Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Không tải được nội dung album; đang giữ danh sách album.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                    }
                });
            }

            @Override
            public void onError(String error) {
                if (binding == null || !isAdded()) return;
                binding.progressBar.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                binding.swipeRefresh.setRefreshing(false);
                if (getContext() != null) {
                    Toast.makeText(getContext(), "Lỗi tải danh sách album: " + error, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void showCreateAlbumDialog() {
        if (getContext() == null) return;
        EditText input = new EditText(requireContext());
        input.setHint(R.string.album_name_hint);
        input.setPadding(32, 32, 32, 32);

        new AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext())
                .setTitle(R.string.create_album)
                .setView(input)
                .setPositiveButton(R.string.btn_create, (dialog, which) -> {
                    String name = input.getText().toString().trim();
                    if (!TextUtils.isEmpty(name)) {
                        createAlbum(name);
                    } else if (getContext() != null) {
                        Toast.makeText(getContext(), "Vui lòng nhập tên album", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                    }
                })
                .setNegativeButton(R.string.btn_cancel, null)
                .show();
    }

    private void createAlbum(String name) {
        UserInfo user = authRepository.getCurrentUser();
        if (user == null || binding == null) return;

        String albumId = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
        Album album = new Album(albumId, user.getId(), name, System.currentTimeMillis());

        binding.progressBar.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        repository.createAlbumAsync(album, new PhotoRepository.Callback<Void>() {
            @Override
            public void onSuccess(Void result) {
                if (binding == null || !isAdded()) return;
                binding.progressBar.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                if (getContext() != null) {
                    Toast.makeText(getContext(), "Tạo album thành công!", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                }
                loadAlbums();
            }

            @Override
            public void onError(String error) {
                if (binding == null || !isAdded()) return;
                binding.progressBar.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                if (getContext() != null) {
                    Toast.makeText(getContext(), "Lỗi tạo album: " + error, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void updateEmptyState() {
        if (binding == null) return;
        if (albumList.isEmpty()) {
            binding.layoutEmpty.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            binding.rvAlbums.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        } else {
            binding.layoutEmpty.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            binding.rvAlbums.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onAlbumClick(Album album) {
        Intent intent = new Intent(requireContext(), AlbumDetailActivity.class);
        intent.putExtra("album", album);
        startActivity(intent);
    }

    @Override
    public void onAlbumLongClick(Album album, View view) {
        PopupMenu popupMenu = new PopupMenu(requireContext(), view);
        popupMenu.getMenu().add(0, 1, 0, R.string.rename_album);
        popupMenu.getMenu().add(0, 2, 1, R.string.btn_delete);

        popupMenu.setOnMenuItemClickListener(item -> {
            if (item.getItemId() == 1) {
                showEditAlbumNameDialog(album);
                return true;
            } else if (item.getItemId() == 2) {
                confirmDeleteAlbum(album);
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        });

        popupMenu.show();
    }

    private void showEditAlbumNameDialog(Album album) {
        if (getContext() == null) return;
        EditText input = new EditText(requireContext());
        input.setText(album.getName());
        input.setPadding(32, 32, 32, 32);

        new AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext())
                .setTitle(R.string.rename_album)
                .setView(input)
                .setPositiveButton(R.string.btn_save, (dialog, which) -> {
                    String newName = input.getText().toString().trim();
                    if (!TextUtils.isEmpty(newName)) {
                        UserInfo user = authRepository.getCurrentUser();
                        if (user != null) {
                            repository.updateAlbumNameAsync(user.getId(), album.getId(), newName, new PhotoRepository.Callback<Void>() {
                                @Override
                                public void onSuccess(Void result) {
                                    if (binding == null || !isAdded()) return;
                                    if (getContext() != null) {
                                        Toast.makeText(getContext(), "Cập nhật tên album thành công!", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                                    }
                                    loadAlbums();
                                }

                                @Override
                                public void onError(String error) {
                                    if (binding == null || !isAdded()) return;
                                    if (getContext() != null) {
                                        Toast.makeText(getContext(), "Lỗi: " + error, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                                    }
                                }
                            });
                        }
                    }
                })
                .setNegativeButton(R.string.btn_cancel, null)
                .show();
    }

    private void confirmDeleteAlbum(Album album) {
        if (getContext() == null) return;
        new AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext())
                .setTitle("Xóa Album")
                .setMessage(R.string.confirm_delete_album)
                .setPositiveButton("Xóa", (dialog, which) -> {
                    UserInfo user = authRepository.getCurrentUser();
                    if (user != null) {
                        repository.deleteAlbumAsync(user.getId(), album.getId(), new PhotoRepository.Callback<Void>() {
                            @Override
                            public void onSuccess(Void result) {
                                if (binding == null || !isAdded()) return;
                                try (LocalAlbumStore store = new LocalAlbumStore(requireContext())) { store.deleteAlbum(user.getId(), album.getId()); }
                                if (getContext() != null) {
                                    Toast.makeText(getContext(), "Đã xóa album", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                                }
                                loadAlbums();
                            }

                            @Override
                            public void onError(String error) {
                                if (binding == null || !isAdded()) return;
                                if (getContext() != null) {
                                    Toast.makeText(getContext(), "Lỗi: " + error, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                                }
                            }
                        });
                    }
                })
                .setNegativeButton("Hủy", null)
                .show();
    }

    @Override
    public void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        loadAlbums();
    }

    @Override
    public void onDestroyView() {
        super.onDestroyView();
        binding = null;
    }

    private static final class AlbumMediaPickerActivityKey {
        static String forLocal(LocalMediaPhoto local) {
            return "media:" + (local.isVideo() ? "video" : "image") + ":" + local.getMediaId() + ":" + local.getDateModified() + ":" + local.getSizeBytes();
        }
    }
}


BackupOnboardingDialog.java
package com.example.th6.fragments;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

import com.example.th6.data.AuthRepository;
import com.example.th6.databinding.DialogBackupOnboardingBinding;
import com.example.th6.utils.BackupPreferences;
import com.google.android.material.bottomsheet.BottomSheetDialogFragment;
import io.github.jan.supabase.auth.user.UserInfo;

public class BackupOnboardingDialog extends BottomSheetDialogFragment {

    private DialogBackupOnboardingBinding binding;
    private OnBackupDecisionListener listener;

    public interface OnBackupDecisionListener {
        void onEnableBackup(boolean isWifiOnly);
        void onSkipBackup();
    }

    public static BackupOnboardingDialog newInstance(OnBackupDecisionListener listener) {
        BackupOnboardingDialog dialog = new BackupOnboardingDialog();
        dialog.listener = listener;
        return dialog;
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public View onCreateView(@NonNull LayoutInflater inflater, @Nullable ViewGroup container, @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        binding = DialogBackupOnboardingBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false);
        return binding.getRoot();
    }

    @Override
    public void onViewCreated(@NonNull View view, @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState);

        AuthRepository authRepository = new AuthRepository();

        binding.btnEnableBackup.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            UserInfo user = authRepository.getCurrentUser();
            if (user != null && getContext() != null) {
                BackupPreferences prefs = new BackupPreferences(requireContext(), user.getId());
                boolean wifiOnly = binding.switchWifiOnly.isChecked();
                prefs.setBackupEnabled(true);
                prefs.setWifiOnly(wifiOnly);
                prefs.setOnboardingShown(true);
                if (listener != null) listener.onEnableBackup(wifiOnly);
            }
            dismiss();
        });

        binding.btnNotNow.setOnClickListener(v -> {
            UserInfo user = authRepository.getCurrentUser();
            if (user != null && getContext() != null) {
                BackupPreferences prefs = new BackupPreferences(requireContext(), user.getId());
                prefs.setBackupEnabled(false);
                prefs.setOnboardingShown(true);
                if (listener != null) listener.onSkipBackup();
            }
            dismiss();
        });
    }

    @Override
    public void onDestroyView() {
        super.onDestroyView();
        binding = null;
    }
}


FavoritesFragment.java
package com.example.th6.fragments;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.MenuItem;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.Toast;
import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog;
import androidx.appcompat.widget.PopupMenu;
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.GridLayoutManager;
import com.example.th6.R;
import com.example.th6.activities.PhotoDetailActivity;
import com.example.th6.adapters.PhotoAdapter;
import com.example.th6.data.AuthRepository;
import com.example.th6.data.PhotoRepository;
import com.example.th6.databinding.FragmentFavoritesBinding;
import com.example.th6.models.LocalMediaPhoto;
import com.example.th6.models.Photo;
import com.example.th6.services.DevicePhotoScanner;
import com.example.th6.utils.MediaTimelineUtils;
import com.example.th6.utils.PhotoTimelineUtils;
import com.example.th6.utils.TimelineSortMenu;
import com.example.th6.utils.LocalVideoFavorites;
import io.github.jan.supabase.auth.user.UserInfo;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class FavoritesFragment extends Fragment implements PhotoAdapter.OnPhotoActionListener {
    private FragmentFavoritesBinding binding;
    private PhotoAdapter photoAdapter;
    private PhotoRepository repository;
    private AuthRepository authRepository;
    private List<Photo> favoritePhotos = new ArrayList<>();
    private Map<String, LocalMediaPhoto> localByUri = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private List<Photo> pendingCloudPhotos;
    private Map<String, LocalMediaPhoto> pendingLocalByUri;
    private boolean cloudReady, localReady;
    private int loadGeneration;
    private int currentViewMode = PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_ALL;
    private int currentMediaFilter = MediaTimelineUtils.FILTER_ALL;
    private int currentSortMode = R.id.sort_date_desc;

    @Override public void onCreate(@Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        authRepository = new AuthRepository();
        repository = new PhotoRepository();
        currentSortMode = requireContext().getSharedPreferences("photovault_library", android.content.Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .getInt("sort_mode", R.id.sort_date_desc);
        currentViewMode = requireContext().getSharedPreferences("photovault_library", android.content.Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .getInt("view_mode", PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_ALL);
        currentMediaFilter = requireContext().getSharedPreferences("photovault_library", android.content.Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .getInt("media_filter", MediaTimelineUtils.FILTER_ALL);
    }

    @Nullable @Override public View onCreateView(@NonNull LayoutInflater inflater, @Nullable ViewGroup container, @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        binding = FragmentFavoritesBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false);
        return binding.getRoot();
    }

    @Override public void onViewCreated(@NonNull View view, @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState);
        photoAdapter = new PhotoAdapter(requireContext(), this);
        GridLayoutManager favoritesGrid = new GridLayoutManager(requireContext(), 2);
        favoritesGrid.setSpanSizeLookup(new GridLayoutManager.SpanSizeLookup() {
            @Override public int getSpanSize(int position) { return photoAdapter.getItemViewType(position) == 1 ? 2 : 1; }
        });
        binding.rvFavorites.setLayoutManager(favoritesGrid);
        binding.rvFavorites.setAdapter(photoAdapter);
        binding.swipeRefresh.setOnRefreshListener(this::loadFavorites);
        setCheckedChip(currentViewMode,currentMediaFilter);
        binding.chipFavoriteAllTime.setOnClickListener(v -> selectTimeline(PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_ALL,currentMediaFilter));
        binding.chipFavoriteDays.setOnClickListener(v -> selectTimeline(PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_DAYS,currentMediaFilter));
        binding.chipFavoriteMonths.setOnClickListener(v -> selectTimeline(PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_MONTHS,currentMediaFilter));
        binding.chipFavoriteYears.setOnClickListener(v -> selectTimeline(PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_YEARS,currentMediaFilter));
        binding.chipFavoriteMediaAll.setOnClickListener(v -> selectTimeline(currentViewMode,MediaTimelineUtils.FILTER_ALL));
        binding.chipFavoriteImages.setOnClickListener(v -> selectTimeline(currentViewMode,MediaTimelineUtils.FILTER_IMAGES));
        binding.chipFavoriteVideos.setOnClickListener(v -> selectTimeline(currentViewMode,MediaTimelineUtils.FILTER_VIDEOS));
        binding.btnFavoriteSort.setOnClickListener(v -> TimelineSortMenu.show(requireContext(), v, currentSortMode, sort -> {
            currentSortMode=sort;
            requireContext().getSharedPreferences("photovault_library", android.content.Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                    .edit().putInt("sort_mode", sort).apply();
            applyTimeline();
        }));
    }

    private void loadFavorites() {
        UserInfo user = authRepository.getCurrentUser();
        if (user == null || binding == null) return;
        final String uid = user.getId();
        final int generation = ++loadGeneration;
        cloudReady = false; localReady = false; pendingCloudPhotos = null; pendingLocalByUri = null;
        binding.progressBar.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        repository.getPhotosByUserAsync(uid, new PhotoRepository.Callback<List<Photo>>() {
            @Override public void onSuccess(List<Photo> photos) {
                if (!isCurrentLoad(generation, uid)) return;
                LinkedHashMap<String, Photo> unique = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                if (photos != null) for (Photo photo : photos) {
                    if (photo == null || !photo.isFavorite() || photo.isTrashed()) continue;
                    String uri = photo.getLocalMediaUri();
                    String key = uri == null || uri.isEmpty() ? "cloud:" + photo.getId() : "local:" + uri;
                    unique.putIfAbsent(key, photo);
                }
                pendingCloudPhotos = new ArrayList<>(unique.values());
                cloudReady = true;
                renderWhenReady(generation, uid);
            }
            @Override public void onError(String error) {
                if (!isCurrentLoad(generation, uid)) return;
                pendingCloudPhotos = new ArrayList<>();
                cloudReady = true;
                renderWhenReady(generation, uid);
                Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "KhÃ´ng táº£i Ä‘Æ°á»£c má»¥c yÃªu thÃ­ch: " + error, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
            }
        });
        new DevicePhotoScanner().scanPhotos(requireContext(), new DevicePhotoScanner.ScanCallback() {
            @Override public void onScanComplete(List<LocalMediaPhoto> photos) {
                if (!isCurrentLoad(generation, uid)) return;
                Map<String, LocalMediaPhoto> byUri = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                if (photos != null) for (LocalMediaPhoto local : photos) if (local.getContentUri() != null) byUri.put(local.getContentUri(), local);
                pendingLocalByUri = byUri;
                localReady = true; renderWhenReady(generation, uid);
            }
            @Override public void onScanError(String error) {
                if (!isCurrentLoad(generation, uid)) return;
                pendingLocalByUri = new LinkedHashMap<>(); localReady = true; renderWhenReady(generation, uid);
            }
        });
    }

    private boolean isCurrentLoad(int generation, String uid) {
        UserInfo active = authRepository.getCurrentUser();
        return binding != null && isAdded() && generation == loadGeneration && active != null && uid.equals(active.getId());
    }

    private void renderWhenReady(int generation, String uid) {
        if (!cloudReady || !localReady || !isCurrentLoad(generation, uid)) return;
        favoritePhotos = pendingCloudPhotos == null ? new ArrayList<>() : pendingCloudPhotos;
        localByUri = pendingLocalByUri == null ? new LinkedHashMap<>() : pendingLocalByUri;
        for (LocalMediaPhoto local : localByUri.values()) {
            if (!local.isVideo() || local.getContentUri() == null
                    || !LocalVideoFavorites.contains(requireContext(), uid, local.getContentUri())) continue;
            Photo represented = favoritePhotos.stream().filter(p -> local.getContentUri().equals(p.getLocalMediaUri())).findFirst().orElse(null);
            if (represented != null) {
                represented.setFavorite(true);
                continue;
            }
            Photo localFavorite = new Photo();
            localFavorite.setId("local:" + local.getMediaId());
            localFavorite.setOwnerUid(uid);
            localFavorite.setName(local.getDisplayName());
            localFavorite.setMediaType("video");
            localFavorite.setImageUrl(local.getContentUri());
            localFavorite.setCreatedAt(local.getTimelineTimestamp());
            localFavorite.setLocalMediaId(local.getMediaId());
            localFavorite.setLocalMediaUri(local.getContentUri());
            localFavorite.setLocalDateModified(local.getDateModified());
            localFavorite.setFavorite(true);
            favoritePhotos.add(localFavorite);
        }
        binding.progressBar.setVisibility(View.GONE); binding.swipeRefresh.setRefreshing(false);
        applyTimeline();
    }

    private long timestamp(Photo photo) {
        LocalMediaPhoto local = photo.getLocalMediaUri() == null ? null : localByUri.get(photo.getLocalMediaUri());
        long localTimestamp=local==null?0:local.getTimelineTimestamp();
        return localTimestamp<=0?photo.getCreatedAt():localTimestamp;
    }

    private void applyTimeline() {
        if (binding == null || photoAdapter == null) return;
        List<Photo> visible = MediaTimelineUtils.filterAndSort(favoritePhotos, currentMediaFilter, currentViewMode,
                currentSortMode, this::timestamp, Photo::getName, p -> "video".equalsIgnoreCase(p.getMediaType()));
        photoAdapter.setTimelinePhotos(visible, currentViewMode, this::timestamp);
        boolean noResults = visible.isEmpty();
        binding.layoutEmpty.setVisibility(noResults ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        binding.rvFavorites.setVisibility(noResults ? View.GONE : View.VISIBLE);
        binding.tvFavoriteEmptyMessage.setText(favoritePhotos.isEmpty() ? R.string.empty_favorites : R.string.empty_media_filter);
    }

    private void selectTimeline(int viewMode,int mediaFilter) {
        currentViewMode=viewMode; currentMediaFilter=mediaFilter;
        requireContext().getSharedPreferences("photovault_library",android.content.Context.MODE_PRIVATE).edit()
                .putInt("view_mode",viewMode).putInt("media_filter",mediaFilter).apply();
        setCheckedChip(viewMode,mediaFilter); applyTimeline();
    }

    private void setCheckedChip(int viewMode,int mediaFilter) {
        if(binding==null)return;
        if(viewMode==PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_DAYS)binding.chipFavoriteDays.setChecked(true);
        else if(viewMode==PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_MONTHS)binding.chipFavoriteMonths.setChecked(true);
        else if(viewMode==PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_YEARS)binding.chipFavoriteYears.setChecked(true);
        else binding.chipFavoriteAllTime.setChecked(true);
        if(mediaFilter==MediaTimelineUtils.FILTER_IMAGES)binding.chipFavoriteImages.setChecked(true);
        else if(mediaFilter==MediaTimelineUtils.FILTER_VIDEOS)binding.chipFavoriteVideos.setChecked(true);
        else binding.chipFavoriteMediaAll.setChecked(true);
    }

    @Override public void onPhotoClick(Photo photo) {
        List<Photo> visibleFavorites = photoAdapter == null ? favoritePhotos : photoAdapter.getPhotos();
        startActivity(PhotoDetailActivity.createIntent(requireContext(), photo, visibleFavorites));
    }

    @Override public void onPhotoLongClick(Photo photo, View view) {
        PopupMenu popupMenu = new PopupMenu(requireContext(), view);
        popupMenu.getMenuInflater().inflate(R.menu.context_menu_photo, popupMenu.getMenu());
        MenuItem favItem = popupMenu.getMenu().findItem(R.id.ctx_toggle_favorite);
        if (favItem != null) favItem.setTitle(photo.isFavorite() ? R.string.ctx_remove_favorite : R.string.ctx_add_favorite);
        popupMenu.setOnMenuItemClickListener(item -> {
            if (item.getItemId() == R.id.ctx_view_detail) { onPhotoClick(photo); return true; }
            if (item.getItemId() == R.id.ctx_toggle_favorite) { onFavoriteToggle(photo); return true; }
            if (item.getItemId() == R.id.ctx_share) { sharePhoto(photo); return true; }
            if (item.getItemId() == R.id.ctx_delete) { confirmDeletePhoto(photo); return true; }
            return false;
        });
        popupMenu.show();
    }

    @Override public void onFavoriteToggle(Photo photo) {
        UserInfo user = authRepository.getCurrentUser();
        if (user == null || getContext() == null) return;
        boolean newFavorite = !photo.isFavorite();
        if (photo.getId() != null && photo.getId().startsWith("local:")) {
            LocalVideoFavorites.set(requireContext(), user.getId(), photo.getLocalMediaUri(), newFavorite);
            loadFavorites();
            return;
        }
        repository.toggleFavoriteAsync(user.getId(), photo.getId(), newFavorite, new PhotoRepository.Callback<Void>() {
            @Override public void onSuccess(Void result) {
                if (binding == null || !isAdded()) return;
                LocalVideoFavorites.set(requireContext(), user.getId(), photo.getLocalMediaUri(), false);
                Toast.makeText(requireContext(), newFavorite ? "ÄÃ£ thÃªm vÃ o yÃªu thÃ­ch" : "ÄÃ£ bá» khá»i yÃªu thÃ­ch", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                loadFavorites();
            }
            @Override public void onError(String error) { if (binding != null && isAdded()) Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Lá»—i: " + error, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show(); }
        });
    }

    private void sharePhoto(Photo photo) {
        Intent shareIntent = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND); shareIntent.setType("text/plain");
        shareIntent.putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_SUBJECT, photo.getName());
        shareIntent.putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_TEXT, "Xem áº£nh \"" + photo.getName() + "\" trÃªn PhotoVault: " + photo.getImageUrl());
        startActivity(Intent.createChooser(shareIntent, "Chia sáº» áº£nh qua"));
    }

    private void confirmDeletePhoto(Photo photo) {
        if (getContext() == null) return;
        new AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext()).setTitle("XÃ¡c nháº­n xÃ³a").setMessage(R.string.confirm_delete_photo)
                .setPositiveButton("XÃ³a", (dialog, which) -> {
                    UserInfo user = authRepository.getCurrentUser(); if (user == null) return;
                    repository.deletePhotoAsync(user.getId(), photo.getId(), new PhotoRepository.Callback<Void>() {
                        @Override public void onSuccess(Void result) { if (binding != null && isAdded()) { Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "ÄÃ£ xÃ³a áº£nh khá»i thÆ° viá»‡n", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show(); loadFavorites(); } }
                        @Override public void onError(String error) { if (binding != null && isAdded()) Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "Lá»—i xÃ³a áº£nh: " + error, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show(); }
                    });
                }).setNegativeButton("Há»§y", null).show();
    }

    @Override public void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        if(binding!=null){
            android.content.SharedPreferences prefs=requireContext().getSharedPreferences("photovault_library",android.content.Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
            currentSortMode=prefs.getInt("sort_mode",R.id.sort_date_desc);
            currentViewMode=prefs.getInt("view_mode",PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_ALL);
            currentMediaFilter=prefs.getInt("media_filter",MediaTimelineUtils.FILTER_ALL);
            setCheckedChip(currentViewMode,currentMediaFilter); applyTimeline(); loadFavorites();
        }
    }
    @Override public void onDestroyView() { loadGeneration++; super.onDestroyView(); binding = null; }
}

                                && !hasPermission(Manifest.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO)
                                && (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.UPSIDE_DOWN_CAKE
                                || !hasPermission(Manifest.permission.READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USER_SELECTED))) {
                            Toast.makeText(getContext(), "Video permission was not granted; videos may be unavailable", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                        }
                        scanDeviceGallery();
                        UserInfo backupUser = authRepository.getCurrentUser();
                        if (backupUser != null && getContext() != null
                                && new BackupPreferences(requireContext(), backupUser.getId()).isBackupEnabled()) {
                            BackupWorkScheduler.reconcile(requireContext(), backupUser.getId(), true);
                        }
                    }
                    else {
                        Toast.makeText(getContext(), "Media permission is needed to show device media", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                        loadCloudPhotosForCurrentUser();
                        updateEmptyState();
                    }
                }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public View onCreateView(@NonNull LayoutInflater inflater, @Nullable ViewGroup container, @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        binding = FragmentLibraryBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false);
        return binding.getRoot();
    }

    @Override
    public void onViewCreated(@NonNull View view, @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState);

        setupRecyclerView();
        setupListeners();
        setCheckedTimelineChips();
        observeBackupWork();
        checkPermissionAndScan();
        checkBackupOnboarding();
    }

    private void observeBackupWork() {
        UserInfo user = authRepository.getCurrentUser();
        if (user == null) {
            renderBackupStatus();
            return;
        }
        WorkManager workManager = WorkManager.getInstance(requireContext().getApplicationContext());
        String uid = user.getId();
        workManager.getWorkInfosForUniqueWorkLiveData(BackupWorkScheduler.immediateWorkName(uid))
                .observe(getViewLifecycleOwner(), infos -> {
                    immediateBackupWork = latestWorkInfo(infos);
                    renderBackupStatus();
                });
        workManager.getWorkInfosForUniqueWorkLiveData(BackupWorkScheduler.periodicWorkName(uid))
                .observe(getViewLifecycleOwner(), infos -> {
                    periodicBackupWork = latestWorkInfo(infos);
                    renderBackupStatus();
                });
    }

    @Nullable
    private WorkInfo latestWorkInfo(@Nullable List<WorkInfo> infos) {
        if (infos == null || infos.isEmpty()) return null;
        for (int i = infos.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            if (infos.get(i).getState() == WorkInfo.State.RUNNING) return infos.get(i);
        }
        return infos.get(infos.size() - 1);
    }

    private void renderBackupStatus() {
        if (binding == null) return;
        WorkInfo running = isRunning(immediateBackupWork) ? immediateBackupWork
                : isRunning(periodicBackupWork) ? periodicBackupWork : null;
        if (running != null) {
            binding.layoutBackupStatus.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            binding.progressBackupStatus.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            binding.tvBackupStatus.setText("Đang sao lưu ảnh");
            int total = running.getProgress().getInt("total", 0);
            int completed = running.getProgress().getInt("completed", 0);
            boolean videoUpload = "video".equals(running.getProgress().getString("current_type"));
            binding.tvBackupStatus.setText(videoUpload ? "Đang sao lưu video" : "Đang sao lưu media");
            if (total > 0) {
                binding.tvBackupProgress.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                binding.tvBackupProgress.setText("Đã xử lý " + Math.min(completed, total) + "/" + total + " media");
            } else {
                binding.tvBackupProgress.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            }
            return;
        }
        binding.layoutBackupStatus.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        binding.progressBackupStatus.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        maybeReportPartialCompletion(immediateBackupWork, false);
        maybeReportPartialCompletion(periodicBackupWork, true);
    }

    private boolean isRunning(@Nullable WorkInfo info) {
        return info != null && info.getState() == WorkInfo.State.RUNNING;
    }

    private void maybeReportPartialCompletion(@Nullable WorkInfo info, boolean periodic) {
        if (info == null || binding == null) return;
        boolean completed = info.getState() == WorkInfo.State.SUCCEEDED
                || (periodic && info.getState() == WorkInfo.State.ENQUEUED);
        if (!completed) return;
        String id = info.getId().toString();
        int failures = info.getOutputData().getInt("failures", 0);
        if (failures <= 0) return;
        UserInfo user = authRepository.getCurrentUser();
        if (user == null) return;
        android.content.SharedPreferences noticePrefs = requireContext().getSharedPreferences(
                "backup_status_notices", android.content.Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        String noticeKey = "last_partial_" + user.getId();
        if (id.equals(noticePrefs.getString(noticeKey, null))) return;
        noticePrefs.edit().putString(noticeKey, id).apply();
        Snackbar.make(binding.getRoot(), "Sao lưu hoàn tất một phần · " + failures + " ảnh cần xử lý", Snackbar.LENGTH_LONG)
                .setAction("Chi tiết", v -> {
                    if (isAdded()) startActivity(new Intent(requireContext(), BackupCenterActivity.class));
                }).show();
    }

    private void setupRecyclerView() {
        localPhotoAdapter = new LocalPhotoAdapter(requireContext(), this);
        GridLayoutManager layoutManager = new GridLayoutManager(requireContext(), 4);
        layoutManager.setSpanSizeLookup(new GridLayoutManager.SpanSizeLookup() {
            @Override
            public int getSpanSize(int position) {
                return localPhotoAdapter.getItemViewType(position) == 0 ? 4 : 1;
            }
        });
        binding.rvPhotos.setLayoutManager(layoutManager);
        binding.rvPhotos.setAdapter(localPhotoAdapter);
    }

    private void selectTimeline(int viewMode,int mediaFilter) {
        currentViewMode=viewMode; currentMediaFilter=mediaFilter;
        requireContext().getSharedPreferences("photovault_library",Context.MODE_PRIVATE).edit()
                .putInt("view_mode",viewMode).putInt("media_filter",mediaFilter).apply();
        setCheckedTimelineChips(); applyViewModeAndSort(); updateEmptyState();
