import io.github.jan.supabase.auth.user.UserInfo;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;

public class TrashFragment extends Fragment implements PhotoAdapter.OnPhotoActionListener {
    private enum LocalState { EXISTS, MISSING, UNKNOWN }

    private FragmentTrashBinding binding;
    private PhotoAdapter photoAdapter;
    private PhotoRepository repository;
    private StorageRepository storageRepository;
    private AuthRepository authRepository;
    private final List<Photo> trashedPhotos = new ArrayList<>();
    private final Set<String> selectedIds = new LinkedHashSet<>();
    private final Set<String> cloudDeletedIds = new LinkedHashSet<>();
    private final List<Photo> pendingAndroidDelete = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<Photo> pendingQDelete = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<String> failures = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<String> localNotRestored = new ArrayList<>();
    private ActivityResultLauncher<IntentSenderRequest> deleteMediaLauncher;
    private ActivityResultLauncher<String> writePermissionLauncher;
    private OnBackPressedCallback selectionBackCallback;
    private boolean selectionMode;
    private boolean bulkRunning;
    private boolean waitingForQConsent;
    private int operationSuccesses;
    private int qDeleteIndex;
    private String operationUid;
    private List<Photo> operationItems = new ArrayList<>();

    @Override public void onCreate(@Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        authRepository = new AuthRepository();
        repository = new PhotoRepository();
        storageRepository = new StorageRepository();
        deleteMediaLauncher = registerForActivityResult(new ActivityResultContracts.StartIntentSenderForResult(), result -> {
            if (!bulkRunning) return;
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT == Build.VERSION_CODES.Q && waitingForQConsent) {
                waitingForQConsent = false;
                if (result.getResultCode() == Activity.RESULT_OK) deleteCurrentQItem(false);
                else {
                    Photo item = pendingQDelete.get(qDeleteIndex);
                    fail(item, "Đã hủy xác nhận MediaStore; local và cloud của mục này vẫn được giữ.");
                    qDeleteIndex++;
                    continueQDeletes();
                }
                return;
            }
            if (result.getResultCode() == Activity.RESULT_OK) {
                List<Photo> confirmed = new ArrayList<>();
                for (Photo item : pendingAndroidDelete) {
                    LocalState state = localState(item);
                    if (state == LocalState.MISSING) confirmed.add(item);
                    else fail(item, state == LocalState.EXISTS
                            ? "MediaStore vẫn báo file local còn tồn tại sau xác nhận."
                            : "Không thể xác minh kết quả xóa local sau xác nhận.");
                }
                deleteCloudQueue(confirmed, 0, this::finishPermanentDelete);
            } else {
                for (Photo item : pendingAndroidDelete) fail(item, "Đã hủy xác nhận MediaStore; local và cloud vẫn được giữ.");
                finishPermanentDelete();
            }
            pendingAndroidDelete.clear();
        });
        writePermissionLauncher = registerForActivityResult(new ActivityResultContracts.RequestPermission(), granted -> {
            if (!bulkRunning) return;
            if (granted) deleteLegacyQueue(0);
            else {
                for (Photo item : pendingQDelete) fail(item, "Chưa cấp quyền xóa local; local và cloud vẫn được giữ.");
                finishPermanentDelete();
            }
        });
    }

    @Nullable @Override public View onCreateView(@NonNull LayoutInflater inflater, @Nullable ViewGroup container, @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        binding = FragmentTrashBinding.inflate(inflater, container, false);
        return binding.getRoot();
    }

    @Override public void onViewCreated(@NonNull View view, @Nullable Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState);
        photoAdapter = new PhotoAdapter(requireContext(), this);
        photoAdapter.setActionsHidden(true);
        binding.rvTrashPhotos.setLayoutManager(new GridLayoutManager(requireContext(), 2));
        binding.rvTrashPhotos.setAdapter(photoAdapter);
        binding.swipeRefresh.setOnRefreshListener(this::loadTrashPhotos);
        binding.btnTrashSelectAll.setOnClickListener(v -> selectAll());
        binding.btnTrashClearSelection.setOnClickListener(v -> clearSelectedItems());
        binding.btnTrashExitSelection.setOnClickListener(v -> exitSelectionMode());
        binding.btnTrashBulkRestore.setOnClickListener(v -> startBulkRestore());
        binding.btnTrashBulkDelete.setOnClickListener(v -> confirmBulkDelete());
        selectionBackCallback = new OnBackPressedCallback(false) {
            @Override public void handleOnBackPressed() {
                if (bulkRunning) showMessage("Đang xử lý các mục đã chọn. Vui lòng đợi hoàn tất.");
                else exitSelectionMode();
            }
        };
        requireActivity().getOnBackPressedDispatcher().addCallback(getViewLifecycleOwner(), selectionBackCallback);
        loadTrashPhotos();
    }

    private void loadTrashPhotos() {
        UserInfo user = authRepository.getCurrentUser();
        if (binding == null || bulkRunning) return;
        if (user == null) { setLoadedTrash(null); return; }
        binding.progressBar.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        repository.getPhotosByUserAsync(user.getId(), new PhotoRepository.Callback<List<Photo>>() {
            @Override public void onSuccess(List<Photo> photos) {
                if (binding == null || !isAdded()) return;
                binding.progressBar.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                binding.swipeRefresh.setRefreshing(false);
                UserInfo active = authRepository.getCurrentUser();
                if (active == null || !user.getId().equals(active.getId())) return;
                setLoadedTrash(photos);
            }
            @Override public void onError(String error) {
                if (binding == null || !isAdded()) return;
                binding.progressBar.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                binding.swipeRefresh.setRefreshing(false);
                appendLocalTrash();
                Toast.makeText(getContext(), "Không tải được cloud Trash: " + error, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            }
        });
    }

    private void setLoadedTrash(@Nullable List<Photo> cloudPhotos) {
        trashedPhotos.clear();
        UserInfo user = authRepository.getCurrentUser();
        if (cloudPhotos != null && user != null) for (Photo item : cloudPhotos) {
            if (item.isTrashed() && user.getId().equals(item.getOwnerUid())) trashedPhotos.add(item);
        }
        for (Photo local : PhotoVaultTrashCache.getLocal(requireContext())) {
            if (local.isTrashed()) trashedPhotos.add(local);
        }
        Set<String> valid = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        for (Photo item : trashedPhotos) valid.add(PhotoAdapter.photoKey(item));
        selectedIds.retainAll(valid);
        if (selectionMode && selectedIds.isEmpty()) selectionMode = false;
        updateSelectionUi();
        syncAdapter();
        updateEmptyState();
    }

    private void appendLocalTrash() {
        Set<String> keys = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        for (Photo photo : trashedPhotos) keys.add(PhotoAdapter.photoKey(photo));
        for (Photo local : PhotoVaultTrashCache.getLocal(requireContext())) {
            String key = PhotoAdapter.photoKey(local);
            if (local.isTrashed() && keys.add(key)) trashedPhotos.add(local);
        }
        syncAdapter();
        updateEmptyState();
    }
    private void updateEmptyState() {
        if (binding == null) return;
        boolean empty = trashedPhotos.isEmpty();
        binding.layoutEmpty.setVisibility(empty ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        binding.rvTrashPhotos.setVisibility(empty ? View.GONE : View.VISIBLE);
    }

    private void syncAdapter() {
        if (photoAdapter == null) return;
        photoAdapter.setPhotos(new ArrayList<>(trashedPhotos));
        photoAdapter.setSelectionState(selectionMode, selectedIds);
    }

    @Override public void onPhotoClick(Photo photo) {
        if (bulkRunning) return;
        if (selectionMode) toggleSelection(photo);
        else startActivity(TrashDetailActivity.createIntent(requireContext(), photo));
    }

    @Override public void onPhotoLongClick(Photo photo, View view) {
        if (bulkRunning) return;
        if (!selectionMode) selectionMode = true;
        toggleSelection(photo);
    }

    @Override public void onFavoriteToggle(Photo photo) { }

    private void toggleSelection(Photo photo) {
        String key = PhotoAdapter.photoKey(photo);
        if (!selectedIds.add(key)) selectedIds.remove(key);
        if (selectedIds.isEmpty()) selectionMode = false;
        updateSelectionUi();
        photoAdapter.setSelectionState(selectionMode, selectedIds);
    }

    private void selectAll() {
        if (bulkRunning) return;
        selectionMode = true;
        selectedIds.clear();
        for (Photo item : trashedPhotos) selectedIds.add(PhotoAdapter.photoKey(item));
        updateSelectionUi();
        photoAdapter.setSelectionState(true, selectedIds);
    }

    private void clearSelectedItems() {
        if (bulkRunning) return;
        selectedIds.clear();
        updateSelectionUi();
        photoAdapter.setSelectionState(selectionMode, selectedIds);
    }

    private void exitSelectionMode() {
        if (bulkRunning) return;
        selectionMode = false;
        selectedIds.clear();
        updateSelectionUi();
        photoAdapter.setSelectionState(false, selectedIds);
    }

    private void updateSelectionUi() {
        if (binding == null) return;
        binding.layoutTrashSelection.setVisibility(selectionMode ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        binding.layoutTrashBulkActions.setVisibility(selectionMode ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        if (selectionBackCallback != null) selectionBackCallback.setEnabled(selectionMode);
        binding.tvTrashSelectedCount.setText("Đã chọn " + selectedIds.size());
        binding.swipeRefresh.setEnabled(!selectionMode && !bulkRunning);
        binding.btnTrashSelectAll.setEnabled(!bulkRunning && selectedIds.size() != trashedPhotos.size());
        binding.btnTrashClearSelection.setEnabled(!bulkRunning && !selectedIds.isEmpty());
        binding.btnTrashExitSelection.setEnabled(!bulkRunning);
        binding.btnTrashBulkRestore.setEnabled(!bulkRunning && !selectedIds.isEmpty());
        binding.btnTrashBulkDelete.setEnabled(!bulkRunning && !selectedIds.isEmpty());
    }

    private List<Photo> selectedPhotos() {
        List<Photo> result = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Photo item : trashedPhotos) if (selectedIds.contains(PhotoAdapter.photoKey(item))) result.add(item);
        return result;
    }

    private void startBulkRestore() {
        if (bulkRunning || selectedIds.isEmpty()) return;
        UserInfo user = authRepository.getCurrentUser();
        operationUid = user == null ? null : user.getId();
        operationItems = selectedPhotos();
        failures.clear();
        localNotRestored.clear();
        operationSuccesses = 0;
        bulkRunning = true;
        updateSelectionUi();
        restoreNext(0);
    }

    private void restoreNext(int index) {
        if (index >= operationItems.size()) { finishRestore(); return; }
        Photo item = operationItems.get(index);
        if ("local".equals(item.getOwnerUid())) {
            PhotoVaultTrashCache.remove(requireContext().getApplicationContext(), "local", item.getId());
            operationSuccesses++;
            trashedPhotos.remove(item);
            selectedIds.remove(PhotoAdapter.photoKey(item));
            syncAdapter();
            restoreNext(index + 1);
            return;
        }
        if (operationUid == null || !operationUid.equals(item.getOwnerUid())) {
            fail(item, "Mục cloud không thuộc tài khoản hiện tại; không thay đổi dữ liệu.");
            restoreNext(index + 1);
            return;
        }
        LocalState local = localState(item);
        if (local != LocalState.EXISTS && item.getLocalMediaUri() != null && !item.getLocalMediaUri().isBlank()) {
            localNotRestored.add(displayName(item) + (local == LocalState.MISSING
                    ? ": file local không còn trong MediaStore; chỉ khôi phục metadata cloud."
                    : ": không xác minh được file local; chỉ khôi phục metadata cloud."));
        }
        repository.moveToTrashAsync(operationUid, item.getId(), false, new PhotoRepository.Callback<Void>() {
            @Override public void onSuccess(Void result) {
                PhotoVaultTrashCache.remove(requireContext().getApplicationContext(), operationUid, item.getId());
                operationSuccesses++;
                trashedPhotos.remove(item);
                selectedIds.remove(PhotoAdapter.photoKey(item));
                syncAdapter();
                restoreNext(index + 1);
            }
            @Override public void onError(String error) {
                fail(item, "Khôi phục cloud thất bại: " + error);
                restoreNext(index + 1);
            }
        });
    }
    private void finishRestore() {
        bulkRunning = false;
        if (selectedIds.isEmpty()) selectionMode = false;
        updateSelectionUi();
        syncAdapter();
        updateEmptyState();
        showBatchSummary("Khôi phục", localNotRestored);
    }

    private void confirmBulkDelete() {
        if (bulkRunning || selectedIds.isEmpty()) return;
        List<Photo> chosen = selectedPhotos();
        int local = 0, cloud = 0, both = 0, unknown = 0, unsupportedCloud = 0;
        for (Photo item : chosen) {
            LocalState state = localState(item);
            boolean hasCloud = hasSupportedCloudSource(item);
            if (state == LocalState.EXISTS) local++;
            if (hasCloud) cloud++;
            if (state == LocalState.EXISTS && hasCloud) both++;
            if (state == LocalState.UNKNOWN) unknown++;
            if (!"local".equals(item.getOwnerUid()) && !hasCloud) unsupportedCloud++;
        }
        String message = "Đã chọn " + chosen.size() + " mục: " + local + " có bản local, " + cloud + " có bản cloud, " + both + " có cả hai."
                + (unknown > 0 ? " Không xác minh được nguồn local của " + unknown + " mục; các mục đó sẽ được giữ lại nếu không thể kiểm tra an toàn." : "")
                + (unsupportedCloud > 0 ? " Không xác định được đường dẫn cloud có thể xóa cho " + unsupportedCloud + " mục; các mục đó sẽ được giữ nguyên." : "")
                + "\nXóa vĩnh viễn không thể hoàn tác.";
        new AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext()).setTitle("Xóa vĩnh viễn các mục đã chọn?")
                .setMessage(message).setNegativeButton("Hủy", null)
                .setPositiveButton("Xóa vĩnh viễn", (dialog, which) -> startBulkDelete(chosen)).show();
    }

    private void startBulkDelete(List<Photo> chosen) {
        if (bulkRunning) return;
        UserInfo user = authRepository.getCurrentUser();
        operationUid = user == null ? null : user.getId();
        operationItems = chosen;
        pendingAndroidDelete.clear();
        pendingQDelete.clear();
        failures.clear();
        operationSuccesses = 0;
        bulkRunning = true;
        updateSelectionUi();

        List<Photo> cloudOnlyOrLocalMissing = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Photo> validLocal = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Photo item : chosen) {
            boolean localOnly = "local".equals(item.getOwnerUid());
            if (localOnly) {
                LocalState state = localState(item);
                if (state == LocalState.EXISTS) validLocal.add(item);
                else if (state == LocalState.MISSING) cloudOnlyOrLocalMissing.add(item);
                else fail(item, "Không thể xác minh URI local; mục được giữ trong thùng rác.");
                continue;
            }
            if (operationUid == null || !operationUid.equals(item.getOwnerUid())) {
                fail(item, "Mục không thuộc tài khoản hiện tại; không thay đổi dữ liệu.");
                continue;
            }
            if (!hasSupportedCloudSource(item)) {
                fail(item, "Không có đường dẫn Supabase Storage có thể xóa an toàn; metadata được giữ.");
                continue;
            }
            LocalState state = localState(item);
            if (state == LocalState.EXISTS) validLocal.add(item);
            else if (state == LocalState.MISSING) cloudOnlyOrLocalMissing.add(item);
            else fail(item, "Không thể xác minh URI local; mục được giữ để tránh xóa một phần ngoài ý muốn.");
        }
        deleteCloudQueue(cloudOnlyOrLocalMissing, 0, () -> processLocalDeleteQueue(validLocal));
    }
    private void processLocalDeleteQueue(List<Photo> localItems) {
        if (localItems.isEmpty()) { finishPermanentDelete(); return; }
        pendingAndroidDelete.clear();
        pendingAndroidDelete.addAll(localItems);
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
            List<Uri> uris = new ArrayList<>();
            for (Photo item : localItems) uris.add(Uri.parse(item.getLocalMediaUri()));
            try {
                android.app.PendingIntent request = MediaStore.createDeleteRequest(requireContext().getContentResolver(), uris);
                deleteMediaLauncher.launch(new IntentSenderRequest.Builder(request.getIntentSender()).build());
            } catch (Exception e) {
                for (Photo item : localItems) fail(item, "Không mở được xác nhận xóa MediaStore: " + e.getMessage());
                pendingAndroidDelete.clear();
                finishPermanentDelete();
            }
        } else if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT == Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
            pendingQDelete.clear();
            pendingQDelete.addAll(localItems);
            qDeleteIndex = 0;
            continueQDeletes();
        } else if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(requireContext(), Manifest.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            pendingQDelete.clear();
            pendingQDelete.addAll(localItems);
            writePermissionLauncher.launch(Manifest.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE);
        } else {
            pendingQDelete.clear();
            pendingQDelete.addAll(localItems);
            deleteLegacyQueue(0);
        }
    }

    private void continueQDeletes() {
        if (qDeleteIndex >= pendingQDelete.size()) { finishPermanentDelete(); return; }
        deleteCurrentQItem(true);
    }

    private void deleteCurrentQItem(boolean allowConsent) {
        Photo item = pendingQDelete.get(qDeleteIndex);
        Uri uri = Uri.parse(item.getLocalMediaUri());
        try {
            int rows = requireContext().getContentResolver().delete(uri, null, null);
            if (rows > 0 || localState(item) == LocalState.MISSING) {
                deleteCloudQueue(Collections.singletonList(item), 0, () -> { qDeleteIndex++; continueQDeletes(); });
            } else {
                fail(item, "MediaStore không xác nhận đã xóa local.");
                qDeleteIndex++;
                continueQDeletes();
            }
        } catch (android.app.RecoverableSecurityException recoverable) {
            if (!allowConsent) {
                fail(item, "Android chưa cấp quyền xóa local sau xác nhận.");
                qDeleteIndex++;
                continueQDeletes();
                return;
            }
            try {
                waitingForQConsent = true;
                deleteMediaLauncher.launch(new IntentSenderRequest.Builder(recoverable.getUserAction().getActionIntent().getIntentSender()).build());
            } catch (Exception e) {
                fail(item, "Không mở được xác nhận xóa local: " + e.getMessage());
                qDeleteIndex++;
                continueQDeletes();
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            fail(item, "Lỗi MediaStore: " + e.getMessage());
            qDeleteIndex++;
            continueQDeletes();
        }
    }

    private void deleteLegacyQueue(int index) {
        if (index >= pendingQDelete.size()) { finishPermanentDelete(); return; }
        Photo item = pendingQDelete.get(index);
        try {
            int rows = requireContext().getContentResolver().delete(Uri.parse(item.getLocalMediaUri()), null, null);
            if (rows > 0 || localState(item) == LocalState.MISSING) {
                deleteCloudQueue(Collections.singletonList(item), 0, () -> deleteLegacyQueue(index + 1));
            } else {
                fail(item, "MediaStore không xác nhận đã xóa local.");
                deleteLegacyQueue(index + 1);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            fail(item, "Lỗi MediaStore: " + e.getMessage());
            deleteLegacyQueue(index + 1);
        }
    }

    private void deleteCloudQueue(List<Photo> items, int index, Runnable done) {
        if (index >= items.size()) { done.run(); return; }
        Photo item = items.get(index);
        if ("local".equals(item.getOwnerUid())) {
            PhotoVaultTrashCache.remove(requireContext().getApplicationContext(), "local", item.getId());
            operationSuccesses++;
            trashedPhotos.remove(item);
            selectedIds.remove(PhotoAdapter.photoKey(item));
            syncAdapter();
            deleteCloudQueue(items, index + 1, done);
            return;
        }
        if (operationUid == null || !operationUid.equals(item.getOwnerUid())) {
            fail(item, "Mục không thuộc tài khoản hiện tại; không thay đổi dữ liệu.");
            deleteCloudQueue(items, index + 1, done);
            return;
        }
        if (!hasSupportedCloudSource(item)) {
            fail(item, "Không có đường dẫn Supabase Storage có thể xóa an toàn; metadata được giữ.");
            deleteCloudQueue(items, index + 1, done);
            return;
        }
        if (cloudDeletedIds.contains(item.getId())) {
            deleteCloudMetadata(item, () -> deleteCloudQueue(items, index + 1, done));
            return;
        }
        String path = cloudPath(item);
        storageRepository.deleteImageAsync(path, new StorageRepository.DeleteCallback() {
            @Override public void onSuccess() {
                cloudDeletedIds.add(item.getId());
                deleteCloudMetadata(item, () -> deleteCloudQueue(items, index + 1, done));
            }
            @Override public void onError(String error) {
                fail(item, "Xóa cloud Storage thất bại; metadata được giữ: " + error);
                deleteCloudQueue(items, index + 1, done);
            }
        });
    }

    private void deleteCloudMetadata(Photo item, Runnable done) {
        repository.deletePhotoAsync(operationUid, item.getId(), new PhotoRepository.Callback<Void>() {
            @Override public void onSuccess(Void result) {
                PhotoVaultTrashCache.remove(requireContext().getApplicationContext(), operationUid, item.getId());
                operationSuccesses++;
                trashedPhotos.remove(item);
                selectedIds.remove(PhotoAdapter.photoKey(item));
                syncAdapter();
                done.run();
            }
            @Override public void onError(String error) {
                fail(item, "Cloud Storage đã xóa nhưng metadata còn lại; có thể thử đồng bộ lại: " + error);
                done.run();
            }
        });
    }

    private void finishPermanentDelete() {
        bulkRunning = false;
        if (selectedIds.isEmpty()) selectionMode = false;
        updateSelectionUi();
        syncAdapter();
        updateEmptyState();
        showBatchSummary("Xóa vĩnh viễn", null);
    }

    private boolean hasSupportedCloudSource(Photo item) {
        return "supabase".equalsIgnoreCase(item.getStorageProvider()) && !cloudPath(item).isEmpty();
    }

    private String cloudPath(Photo item) {
        String path = item.getStoragePath();
        if (path == null || path.isBlank()) path = storageRepository.objectPathFromPublicUrl(item.getImageUrl());
        return path == null ? "" : path;
    }

    private LocalState localState(Photo item) {
        String text = item.getLocalMediaUri();
        if (text == null || text.isBlank()) return LocalState.MISSING;
        Uri uri;
        try { uri = Uri.parse(text); }
        catch (Exception e) { return LocalState.UNKNOWN; }
        if (!"content".equalsIgnoreCase(uri.getScheme()) || uri.getAuthority() == null || !uri.getAuthority().contains("media")) return LocalState.UNKNOWN;
        try (android.database.Cursor cursor = requireContext().getContentResolver().query(uri, new String[]{MediaStore.MediaColumns._ID}, null, null, null)) {
            if (cursor == null) return LocalState.UNKNOWN;
            return cursor.moveToFirst() ? LocalState.EXISTS : LocalState.MISSING;
        } catch (Exception e) { return LocalState.UNKNOWN; }
    }

    private void fail(Photo item, String reason) { failures.add(displayName(item) + ": " + reason); }
    private String displayName(Photo item) { return item.getName() == null || item.getName().isBlank() ? item.getId() : item.getName(); }

    private void showBatchSummary(String action, List<String> extra) {
        List<String> details = new ArrayList<>();
        if (extra != null) details.addAll(extra);
        details.addAll(failures);
        int total = operationItems.size();
        int failed = Math.max(0, total - operationSuccesses);
        String summary = action + " hoàn tất: " + operationSuccesses + "/" + total + " mục thành công, " + failed + " mục cần xử lý lại.";
        if (details.isEmpty()) Toast.makeText(getContext(), summary, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        else new AlertDialog.Builder(requireContext()).setTitle(summary)
                .setMessage(android.text.TextUtils.join("\n\n", details))
                .setPositiveButton("Đóng", null).show();
    }

    private void showMessage(String message) {
        if (getContext() != null) Toast.makeText(getContext(), message, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
    }

    @Override public void onResume() { super.onResume(); loadTrashPhotos(); }

    @Override public void onDestroyView() { super.onDestroyView(); binding = null; }
}


AdjustmentSettings.java
package com.example.th6.models;

import java.io.Serializable;

public class AdjustmentSettings implements Serializable {
    private float exposure = 0.0f;     // -3.0 to +3.0 EV
    private float brightness = 0.0f;   // -100.0 to +100.0
    private float contrast = 1.0f;     // 0.5 to 2.0
    private float saturation = 1.0f;   // 0.0 to 2.0
    private float highlights = 0.0f;   // -100.0 to +100.0
    private float shadows = 0.0f;      // -100.0 to +100.0
    private float temperature = 0.0f;  // -100.0 (Cool) to +100.0 (Warm)
    private float tint = 0.0f;         // -100.0 (Green) to +100.0 (Magenta)

    public AdjustmentSettings() {
        reset();
    }

    public AdjustmentSettings(AdjustmentSettings source) {
        if (source == null) reset();
        else {
            exposure = source.exposure;
            brightness = source.brightness;
            contrast = source.contrast;
            saturation = source.saturation;
            highlights = source.highlights;
            shadows = source.shadows;
            temperature = source.temperature;
            tint = source.tint;
        }
    }

    public AdjustmentSettings copy() { return new AdjustmentSettings(this); }

    public void reset() {
        this.exposure = 0.0f;
        this.brightness = 0.0f;
        this.contrast = 1.0f;
        this.saturation = 1.0f;
        this.highlights = 0.0f;
        this.shadows = 0.0f;
        this.temperature = 0.0f;
        this.tint = 0.0f;
    }

    public boolean isNeutral() {
        return exposure == 0.0f &&
                brightness == 0.0f &&
                contrast == 1.0f &&
                saturation == 1.0f &&
                highlights == 0.0f &&
                shadows == 0.0f &&
                temperature == 0.0f &&
                tint == 0.0f;
    }

    public float getExposure() { return exposure; }

AlbumMediaEntry.java
package com.example.th6.models;

import java.io.Serializable;

/** One deduplicated local/cloud media item shown in album flows. */
public class AlbumMediaEntry implements Serializable {
    private final String key;
    private final LocalMediaPhoto local;
    private final Photo cloud;
    private boolean selected;
    private final boolean alreadyInAlbum;

    public AlbumMediaEntry(String key, LocalMediaPhoto local, Photo cloud, boolean alreadyInAlbum) {
        this.key = key; this.local = local; this.cloud = cloud; this.alreadyInAlbum = alreadyInAlbum;
    }
    public String getKey() { return key; }
    public LocalMediaPhoto getLocal() { return local; }
    public Photo getCloud() { return cloud; }
    public boolean isAlreadyInAlbum() { return alreadyInAlbum; }
    public boolean isSelected() { return selected; }
    public void setSelected(boolean value) { selected = value; }
    public boolean isVideo() { return local != null ? local.isVideo() : cloud != null && "video".equalsIgnoreCase(cloud.getMediaType()); }
    public String getName() { return local != null && local.getDisplayName() != null ? local.getDisplayName() : cloud != null ? cloud.getName() : "Media"; }
    public String getSource() { return local != null && local.getContentUri() != null && !local.getContentUri().isEmpty() ? local.getContentUri() : cloud != null ? cloud.getImageUrl() : null; }
    public long getDurationMs() { return local == null ? 0 : local.getDurationMs(); }
    public long getTimestamp() {
        long localTimestamp = local == null ? 0 : local.getTimelineTimestamp();
        return localTimestamp > 0 ? localTimestamp : cloud != null ? cloud.getCreatedAt() : 0;
    }
    public String getLocalKey() {
        if (local == null) return null;
        return "media:" + (local.isVideo() ? "video" : "image") + ":" + local.getMediaId() + ":" + local.getDateModified() + ":" + local.getSizeBytes();
    }
}

package com.example.th6.models

import kotlinx.serialization.SerialName
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlinx.serialization.Transient
import kotlinx.serialization.KSerializer
import kotlinx.serialization.descriptors.PrimitiveKind
import kotlinx.serialization.descriptors.PrimitiveSerialDescriptor
import kotlinx.serialization.descriptors.SerialDescriptor
import kotlinx.serialization.encoding.Decoder
import kotlinx.serialization.encoding.Encoder
import kotlinx.datetime.Instant
import java.io.Serializable as JavaSerializable

object EpochMillisSerializer : KSerializer<Long> {
    override val descriptor: SerialDescriptor = PrimitiveSerialDescriptor("EpochMillis", PrimitiveKind.STRING)

    override fun serialize(encoder: Encoder, value: Long) {
        encoder.encodeString(Instant.fromEpochMilliseconds(value).toString())
    }

    override fun deserialize(decoder: Decoder): Long {
        val value = decoder.decodeString()
        return value.toLongOrNull() ?: Instant.parse(value).toEpochMilliseconds()
    }
}

PhotoEditState.java
package com.example.th6.models;

import android.graphics.RectF;

import com.example.th6.utils.BitmapEditor;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/** Lightweight edit recipe. It stores parameters and operations, never bitmap snapshots. */
public final class PhotoEditState {
    public static final int ROTATE = 0;
    public static final int FLIP = 1;
    public static final int CROP = 2;
    public static final int STROKE = 3;

    public static final class Operation {
        public final int type;
        public final float value;
        public final boolean horizontal;
        public final boolean vertical;
        public final RectF crop;
        public final float[] points;
        public final int color;
        public final float strokeWidth;
        public final boolean erase;

        private Operation(int type, float value, boolean horizontal, boolean vertical,
                          RectF crop, float[] points, int color, float strokeWidth, boolean erase) {
            this.type = type;
            this.value = value;
            this.horizontal = horizontal;
            this.vertical = vertical;
            this.crop = crop == null ? null : new RectF(crop);
            this.points = points == null ? null : points.clone();
            this.color = color;
            this.strokeWidth = strokeWidth;
            this.erase = erase;
        }

        public static Operation rotate(float degrees) { return new Operation(ROTATE, degrees, false, false, null, null, 0, 0, false); }
        public static Operation flip(boolean horizontal, boolean vertical) { return new Operation(FLIP, 0, horizontal, vertical, null, null, 0, 0, false); }
        public static Operation crop(RectF normalized) { return new Operation(CROP, 0, false, false, normalized, null, 0, 0, false); }
        public static Operation stroke(float[] points, int color, float width) { return stroke(points, color, width, false); }
        public static Operation stroke(float[] points, int color, float width, boolean erase) { return new Operation(STROKE, 0, false, false, null, points, color, width, erase); }
        public Operation copy() { return new Operation(type, value, horizontal, vertical, crop, points, color, strokeWidth, erase); }
    }

    public AdjustmentSettings adjustments = new AdjustmentSettings();
    public int filter = BitmapEditor.FILTER_ORIGINAL;
    public float filterIntensity = 1f;
    public final List<Operation> operations = new ArrayList<>();

    public PhotoEditState copy() {
        PhotoEditState result = new PhotoEditState();
        result.adjustments = adjustments.copy();
        result.filter = filter;
        result.filterIntensity = filterIntensity;
        for (Operation operation : operations) result.operations.add(operation.copy());
        return result;
    }

    public boolean isNeutral() {
        return operations.isEmpty() && adjustments.isNeutral()
                && filter == BitmapEditor.FILTER_ORIGINAL;
    }
}

BackupUploadLedger.java
package com.example.th6.services;

import android.content.ContentValues;
import android.content.Context;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteDatabase;
import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteOpenHelper;

public class BackupUploadLedger extends SQLiteOpenHelper {
    private static final String DB_NAME = "photovault_backup_uploads.db";
    private static final int DB_VERSION = 1;
    private static final String TABLE = "pending_metadata";
    private static final String COL_UID = "uid";
    private static final String COL_URI = "media_uri";
    private static final String COL_MODIFIED = "media_modified";
    private static final String COL_URL = "image_url";

    public static class Entry {
        public final long modified;
        public final String imageUrl;
        Entry(long modified, String imageUrl) {
            this.modified = modified;
            this.imageUrl = imageUrl;
        }
    }

    public BackupUploadLedger(Context context) {
        super(context.getApplicationContext(), DB_NAME, null, DB_VERSION);
    }

    @Override
    public void onCreate(SQLiteDatabase db) {
        db.execSQL("CREATE TABLE " + TABLE + " (" + COL_UID + " TEXT NOT NULL, "
                + COL_URI + " TEXT NOT NULL, " + COL_MODIFIED + " INTEGER NOT NULL, "
                + COL_URL + " TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (" + COL_UID + ", " + COL_URI + "))");
    }

    @Override
    public void onUpgrade(SQLiteDatabase db, int oldVersion, int newVersion) {
        // No schema migrations are needed for version 1.
    }

    public synchronized void recordUpload(String uid, String mediaUri, long modified, String imageUrl) {
        ContentValues values = new ContentValues();
        values.put(COL_UID, uid);
        values.put(COL_URI, mediaUri);
        values.put(COL_MODIFIED, modified);
        values.put(COL_URL, imageUrl);
        getWritableDatabase().insertWithOnConflict(TABLE, null, values, SQLiteDatabase.CONFLICT_REPLACE);
    }

    public synchronized Entry find(String uid, String mediaUri) {
        try (Cursor cursor = getReadableDatabase().query(TABLE,
                new String[]{COL_MODIFIED, COL_URL}, COL_UID + "=? AND " + COL_URI + "=?",
                new String[]{uid, mediaUri}, null, null, null)) {
            if (cursor != null && cursor.moveToFirst()) return new Entry(cursor.getLong(0), cursor.getString(1));
            return null;
        }
    }

    public synchronized void remove(String uid, String mediaUri) {
        getWritableDatabase().delete(TABLE, COL_UID + "=? AND " + COL_URI + "=?",
                new String[]{uid, mediaUri});
    }
}


BackupWorkScheduler.java
package com.example.th6.services;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.work.Constraints;
import androidx.work.Data;
import androidx.work.ExistingPeriodicWorkPolicy;
import androidx.work.ExistingWorkPolicy;
import androidx.work.NetworkType;
import androidx.work.OneTimeWorkRequest;
import androidx.work.PeriodicWorkRequest;
import androidx.work.WorkManager;
import androidx.work.WorkInfo;

import com.example.th6.utils.BackupPreferences;
import com.example.th6.data.AuthRepository;

import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutionException;
import java.util.List;

/** Keeps one persistent, low-frequency scan schedule per signed-in account. */
public final class BackupWorkScheduler {
    private static final long PERIOD_HOURS = 6;
    private static final String PERIODIC_PREFIX = "photovault_backup_periodic_";
    private static final String IMMEDIATE_PREFIX = "photovault_backup_immediate_";
    private static final ExecutorService ENQUEUE_EXECUTOR = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();

    private BackupWorkScheduler() { }

    public static String immediateWorkName(String uid) { return IMMEDIATE_PREFIX + uid; }
    public static String periodicWorkName(String uid) { return PERIODIC_PREFIX + uid; }

    public static void reconcile(Context context, String uid, boolean scanNow) {
        if (context == null || uid == null || uid.isEmpty()) return;
        Context appContext = context.getApplicationContext();
        BackupPreferences prefs = new BackupPreferences(appContext, uid);
        WorkManager workManager = WorkManager.getInstance(appContext);
        String periodicName = periodicWorkName(uid);

        if (!prefs.isBackupEnabled() || prefs.isPaused()) {
            disable(appContext, uid);
            return;
        }

        Constraints constraints = createConstraints(prefs.isWifiOnly());
        PeriodicWorkRequest periodic = new PeriodicWorkRequest.Builder(
                PhotoBackupWorker.class, PERIOD_HOURS, TimeUnit.HOURS)
                .setInputData(backupInput(uid))
                .setConstraints(constraints)
                .setBackoffCriteria(androidx.work.BackoffPolicy.EXPONENTIAL, 30, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                .build();
        workManager.enqueueUniquePeriodicWork(periodicName, ExistingPeriodicWorkPolicy.UPDATE, periodic);

        if (scanNow) enqueueIfEligible(appContext, uid);
    }

    /**
     * Shared account-scoped backup trigger. A queued run already scans the current
     * MediaStore state, so requests coalesce while it is waiting. If a run is active,
     * one follow-up is appended; later requests coalesce behind that queued scan.
     */
    public static boolean enqueueIfEligible(Context context, String uid) {
        if (context == null || uid == null || uid.isEmpty()) return false;
        Context appContext = context.getApplicationContext();
        AuthRepository authRepository = new AuthRepository();
        if (!authRepository.isLoggedIn()) return false;
        String activeUid = authRepository.getCurrentUserUid();
        if (!uid.equals(activeUid)) return false;
        BackupPreferences prefs = new BackupPreferences(appContext, uid);
        if (!prefs.isBackupEnabled() || prefs.isPaused()) return false;

        ENQUEUE_EXECUTOR.execute(() -> enqueueCoalesced(appContext, uid));
        return true;
    }

    private static void enqueueCoalesced(Context context, String uid) {
        AuthRepository authRepository = new AuthRepository();
        if (!authRepository.isLoggedIn() || !uid.equals(authRepository.getCurrentUserUid())) return;
        BackupPreferences prefs = new BackupPreferences(context, uid);
        if (!prefs.isBackupEnabled() || prefs.isPaused()) return;

        WorkManager workManager = WorkManager.getInstance(context);
        String workName = immediateWorkName(uid);
        boolean running = false;
        boolean waiting = false;
        try {
            List<WorkInfo> infos = workManager.getWorkInfosForUniqueWork(workName).get();
            for (WorkInfo info : infos) {
                if (info.getState() == WorkInfo.State.RUNNING) running = true;
                else if (info.getState() == WorkInfo.State.ENQUEUED || info.getState() == WorkInfo.State.BLOCKED) waiting = true;
            }
        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            return;
        } catch (ExecutionException | RuntimeException e) {
            // If WorkManager state cannot be read, preserve the request with a serialized
            // append rather than dropping a scan that may have arrived during a running job.
            enqueueRequest(workManager, context, uid, prefs, ExistingWorkPolicy.APPEND_OR_REPLACE);
            return;
        }

        if (waiting) return;
        ExistingWorkPolicy policy = running ? ExistingWorkPolicy.APPEND_OR_REPLACE : ExistingWorkPolicy.KEEP;
        enqueueRequest(workManager, context, uid, prefs, policy);
    }

    private static void enqueueRequest(WorkManager workManager, Context context, String uid,
                                      BackupPreferences prefs, ExistingWorkPolicy policy) {
        OneTimeWorkRequest request = new OneTimeWorkRequest.Builder(PhotoBackupWorker.class)
                .setInputData(backupInput(uid))
                .setConstraints(createConstraints(prefs.isWifiOnly()))
                .setBackoffCriteria(androidx.work.BackoffPolicy.EXPONENTIAL, 30, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                .build();
        try {
            workManager.enqueueUniqueWork(immediateWorkName(uid), policy, request).getResult().get();
        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
        } catch (ExecutionException | RuntimeException ignored) { }
    }

    public static void disable(Context context, String uid) {
        if (context == null || uid == null || uid.isEmpty()) return;
        // Cancel queued periodic work only when no worker owns the upload lock. A running
        // worker cancels its own periodic schedule after the current image is committed.
        if (PhotoBackupWorker.acquireIdleRunLock()) {
            try {
                WorkManager.getInstance(context.getApplicationContext())
                        .cancelUniqueWork(PERIODIC_PREFIX + uid);
            } finally {
                PhotoBackupWorker.releaseIdleRunLock();
            }
        }
    }

    public static void cancelPeriodic(Context context, String uid) {
        if (context != null && uid != null && !uid.isEmpty()) {
            WorkManager.getInstance(context.getApplicationContext())
                    .cancelUniqueWork(PERIODIC_PREFIX + uid);
        }
    }

    private static Constraints createConstraints(boolean wifiOnly) {
        NetworkType networkType = wifiOnly ? NetworkType.UNMETERED : NetworkType.CONNECTED;
        return new Constraints.Builder().setRequiredNetworkType(networkType).build();
    }

    private static Data backupInput(String uid) {
        return new Data.Builder().putString("backup_uid", uid).build();
    }
}


DevicePhotoScanner.java
package com.example.th6.services;

import android.content.ContentResolver;
import android.content.ContentUris;
import android.content.Context;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.provider.MediaStore;
import android.util.Log;

import com.example.th6.models.LocalMediaPhoto;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

public class DevicePhotoScanner {
    private static final String TAG = "DevicePhotoScanner";
    private static final ExecutorService SCAN_EXECUTOR = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
    private final Handler mainHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

    public interface ScanCallback {
        void onScanComplete(List<LocalMediaPhoto> localPhotos);
        void onScanError(String error);
    }

    public void scanPhotos(Context context, ScanCallback callback) {
        scan(context, callback, false);
    }

    /** Scans only images and reports revoked image permission instead of returning an empty queue. */
    public void scanImages(Context context, ScanCallback callback) {
        scan(context, callback, true);
    }

    private void scan(Context context, ScanCallback callback, boolean imagesOnly) {
        SCAN_EXECUTOR.execute(() -> {
            try {
                ContentResolver resolver = context.getContentResolver();
                List<LocalMediaPhoto> media = new ArrayList<>();
                scanCollection(resolver, getExternalCollectionUri(false), false, media, imagesOnly);
                if (!imagesOnly) scanCollection(resolver, getExternalCollectionUri(true), true, media, false);
                Collections.sort(media, (a, b) -> Long.compare(b.getTimelineTimestamp(), a.getTimelineTimestamp()));
                mainHandler.post(() -> {
                    if (callback != null) callback.onScanComplete(media);
                });
            } catch (Exception e) {
                mainHandler.post(() -> {
                    if (callback != null) callback.onScanError("Media scan failed: " + e.getLocalizedMessage());
                });
            }
        });
    }

    private void scanCollection(ContentResolver resolver, Uri collection, boolean video,
                                List<LocalMediaPhoto> result, boolean failOnSecurityError) {
        String[] projection = video
                ? new String[]{MediaStore.Video.Media._ID, MediaStore.Video.Media.DISPLAY_NAME,
                    MediaStore.Video.Media.MIME_TYPE, MediaStore.Video.Media.SIZE,
                    MediaStore.Video.Media.WIDTH, MediaStore.Video.Media.HEIGHT,
                    MediaStore.Video.Media.DATE_TAKEN, MediaStore.Video.Media.DATE_ADDED,
                    MediaStore.Video.Media.DATE_MODIFIED, MediaStore.Video.Media.DURATION}
                : new String[]{MediaStore.Images.Media._ID, MediaStore.Images.Media.DISPLAY_NAME,
                    MediaStore.Images.Media.MIME_TYPE, MediaStore.Images.Media.SIZE,
                    MediaStore.Images.Media.WIDTH, MediaStore.Images.Media.HEIGHT,
                    MediaStore.Images.Media.DATE_TAKEN, MediaStore.Images.Media.DATE_ADDED,
                    MediaStore.Images.Media.DATE_MODIFIED};
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
            projection = Arrays.copyOf(projection, projection.length + 1);
            projection[projection.length - 1] = MediaStore.MediaColumns.IS_PENDING;
        }
        int itemCount = 0;
        try (Cursor cursor = resolver.query(collection, projection, null, null, null)) {
            if (cursor == null) {
                Log.i(TAG, (video ? "Video" : "Image") + " query returned a null cursor");
                if (failOnSecurityError) throw new IllegalStateException("MediaStore did not return an image cursor.");
                return;
            }
            int idCol = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.MediaColumns._ID);
            int nameCol = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.MediaColumns.DISPLAY_NAME);
            int mimeCol = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.MediaColumns.MIME_TYPE);
            int sizeCol = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.MediaColumns.SIZE);
            int widthCol = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.MediaColumns.WIDTH);
            int heightCol = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.MediaColumns.HEIGHT);
            int takenCol = cursor.getColumnIndex(MediaStore.Images.Media.DATE_TAKEN);
            int addedCol = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.MediaColumns.DATE_ADDED);
            int modifiedCol = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.MediaColumns.DATE_MODIFIED);
            int pendingCol = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q
                    ? cursor.getColumnIndex(MediaStore.MediaColumns.IS_PENDING) : -1;
            int durationCol = video ? cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Video.Media.DURATION) : -1;

            while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
                if (pendingCol >= 0 && cursor.getInt(pendingCol) != 0) continue;
                long id = cursor.getLong(idCol);
                long timestamp = getModifiedTimestamp(cursor, modifiedCol);
                Uri contentUri = ContentUris.withAppendedId(collection, id);
                LocalMediaPhoto item = new LocalMediaPhoto(id, contentUri.toString(),
                        cursor.getString(nameCol), cursor.getString(mimeCol), cursor.getLong(sizeCol),
                        cursor.getInt(widthCol), cursor.getInt(heightCol), timestamp);
                item.setDateTaken(getCaptureTimestamp(cursor, takenCol, addedCol, modifiedCol));
                item.setVideo(video);
                if (video && durationCol >= 0) item.setDurationMs(Math.max(0, cursor.getLong(durationCol)));
                result.add(item);
                itemCount++;
            }
            Log.i(TAG, (video ? "Video" : "Image") + " query returned " + itemCount + " items");
        } catch (SecurityException e) {
            Log.w(TAG, (video ? "Video" : "Image") + " query denied by media permissions", e);
            if (failOnSecurityError) throw e;
        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
            Log.e(TAG, (video ? "Video" : "Image") + " MediaStore query failed", e);
            if (failOnSecurityError) throw e;
        }
    }

    private Uri getExternalCollectionUri(boolean video) {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
            return video
                    ? MediaStore.Video.Media.getContentUri(MediaStore.VOLUME_EXTERNAL)
                    : MediaStore.Images.Media.getContentUri(MediaStore.VOLUME_EXTERNAL);
        }
        return video ? MediaStore.Video.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI : MediaStore.Images.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI;
    }

    private long getModifiedTimestamp(Cursor cursor, int modifiedCol) {
        long modified = cursor.getLong(modifiedCol);
        // This value is persisted as local_date_modified and used for change detection.
        // DATE_TAKEN/DATE_ADDED describe capture/import time and are not safe revision signals.
        return modified > 0 ? modified * 1000L : 0L;
    }

    private long getCaptureTimestamp(Cursor cursor, int takenCol, int addedCol, int modifiedCol) {
        long taken = takenCol >= 0 ? cursor.getLong(takenCol) : 0L;
        if (taken > 0) return taken;
        long added = cursor.getLong(addedCol);
        if (added > 0) return added * 1000L;
        long modified = cursor.getLong(modifiedCol);
        return modified > 0 ? modified * 1000L : 0L;
    }
}


MediaStoreBackupObserver.java
package com.example.th6.services;

import android.content.ContentResolver;
import android.content.Context;
import android.database.ContentObserver;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.HandlerThread;
import android.provider.MediaStore;

import com.example.th6.utils.BackupPreferences;

import java.io.InputStream;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;

/** Foreground-only MediaStore watcher. It only debounces and validates changed URIs;
 * actual scanning and uploading remain in PhotoBackupWorker. */
public final class MediaStoreBackupObserver {
    private static final long DEBOUNCE_MS = 1_500L;
    private static final long STABILITY_SAMPLE_MS = 700L;
    private static final long NOT_READY_RETRY_MS = 1_800L;
    private static final int MAX_URIS_PER_BATCH = 48;
    private static final int MAX_READINESS_RETRIES = 2;

    private final Context appContext;
    private final String uid;
    private final ContentResolver resolver;
    private final Set<String> changedUris = new LinkedHashSet<>();
    private HandlerThread handlerThread;
    private volatile Handler handler;
    private ContentObserver observer;
    private boolean collectionChange;
    private int retryCount;
    private boolean registered;

    private final Runnable debounceRunnable = () -> validateAndEnqueue(false);
    private final Runnable retryRunnable = () -> validateAndEnqueue(true);

    public MediaStoreBackupObserver(Context context, String uid) {
        this.appContext = context.getApplicationContext();
        this.uid = uid;
        this.resolver = appContext.getContentResolver();
    }

    public synchronized void register() {
        if (registered || uid == null || uid.isEmpty()) return;
        BackupPreferences preferences = new BackupPreferences(appContext, uid);
        if (!preferences.isBackupEnabled() || preferences.isPaused()) return;

        handlerThread = new HandlerThread("PhotoVaultMediaStoreObserver");
        handlerThread.start();
        handler = new Handler(handlerThread.getLooper());
        observer = new ContentObserver(handler) {
            @Override public void onChange(boolean selfChange, Uri uri) {
                onMediaStoreChanged(uri);
            }
        };
        try {
            for (Uri collection : collections()) resolver.registerContentObserver(collection, true, observer);
            registered = true;
        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
            unregisterInternal();
        }
    }

    public synchronized void unregister() {
        if (!registered && handlerThread == null) return;
        unregisterInternal();
    }

    private void unregisterInternal() {
        if (observer != null) {
            try { resolver.unregisterContentObserver(observer); } catch (RuntimeException ignored) { }
        }
        if (handler != null) {
            handler.removeCallbacks(debounceRunnable);
            handler.removeCallbacks(retryRunnable);
        }
        synchronized (changedUris) {
            changedUris.clear();
            collectionChange = false;
            retryCount = 0;
        }
        observer = null;
        handler = null;
        registered = false;
        if (handlerThread != null) {
            handlerThread.quitSafely();
            handlerThread = null;
        }
    }

    private void onMediaStoreChanged(Uri uri) {
        Handler current = handler;
        if (current == null) return;
        synchronized (changedUris) {
            if (uri == null || !isItemUri(uri)) {
                collectionChange = true;
            } else if (changedUris.size() < MAX_URIS_PER_BATCH) {
                changedUris.add(uri.toString());
            } else {
                // A large/bulk operation is verified by the worker's normal MediaStore scan.
                collectionChange = true;
            }
            retryCount = 0;
        }
        current.removeCallbacks(retryRunnable);
        current.removeCallbacks(debounceRunnable);
        current.postDelayed(debounceRunnable, DEBOUNCE_MS);
    }

    private boolean isItemUri(Uri uri) {
        List<String> path = uri.getPathSegments();
        for (Uri collection : collections()) {
            if (collection.getAuthority() != null && collection.getAuthority().equals(uri.getAuthority())
                    && path.size() > collection.getPathSegments().size()
                    && path.subList(0, collection.getPathSegments().size()).equals(collection.getPathSegments())) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private void validateAndEnqueue(boolean retry) {
        List<String> batch;
        boolean collectionOnly;
        synchronized (changedUris) {
            batch = new ArrayList<>(changedUris);
            collectionOnly = collectionChange;
        }
        // A collection notification has no safe item URI to probe. The existing scanner
        // performs the full query and excludes IS_PENDING rows before they reach the worker.
        boolean ready = collectionOnly || batch.isEmpty();
        if (!ready) {
            List<MediaSnapshot> first = new ArrayList<>();
            for (String itemUri : batch) first.add(readSnapshot(Uri.parse(itemUri)));
            try { Thread.sleep(STABILITY_SAMPLE_MS); }
            catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); return; }
            for (int i = 0; i < batch.size(); i++) {
                MediaSnapshot before = first.get(i);
                MediaSnapshot after = readSnapshot(Uri.parse(batch.get(i)));
                if (before != null && after != null && before.pending == 0 && after.pending == 0
                        && before.size > 0 && before.size == after.size
                        && before.dateModified == after.dateModified && before.readable && after.readable) {
                    ready = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        if (ready) {
            synchronized (changedUris) {
                changedUris.clear();
                collectionChange = false;
                retryCount = 0;
            }
            BackupWorkScheduler.enqueueIfEligible(appContext, uid);
            return;
        }

        synchronized (changedUris) {
            retryCount++;
            if (retryCount > MAX_READINESS_RETRIES) {
                changedUris.clear();
                collectionChange = false;
                retryCount = 0;
                return;
            }
        }
        Handler current = handler;
        if (current != null) current.postDelayed(retryRunnable, NOT_READY_RETRY_MS);
    }

    private MediaSnapshot readSnapshot(Uri uri) {
        String[] projection = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q
                ? new String[]{MediaStore.MediaColumns.SIZE, MediaStore.MediaColumns.DATE_MODIFIED,
                    MediaStore.MediaColumns.IS_PENDING}
                : new String[]{MediaStore.MediaColumns.SIZE, MediaStore.MediaColumns.DATE_MODIFIED};
        try (Cursor cursor = resolver.query(uri, projection, null, null, null)) {
            if (cursor == null || !cursor.moveToFirst()) return null;
            int sizeIndex = cursor.getColumnIndex(MediaStore.MediaColumns.SIZE);
            int modifiedIndex = cursor.getColumnIndex(MediaStore.MediaColumns.DATE_MODIFIED);
            int pendingIndex = cursor.getColumnIndex(MediaStore.MediaColumns.IS_PENDING);
            long size = sizeIndex >= 0 && !cursor.isNull(sizeIndex) ? cursor.getLong(sizeIndex) : -1L;
            long modified = modifiedIndex >= 0 && !cursor.isNull(modifiedIndex) ? cursor.getLong(modifiedIndex) : -1L;
            int pending = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q && pendingIndex >= 0
                    ? cursor.getInt(pendingIndex) : 0;
            if (pending != 0 || size <= 0) return new MediaSnapshot(size, modified, pending, false);
            boolean readable = false;
            try (InputStream input = resolver.openInputStream(uri)) {
                readable = input != null && input.read() >= 0;
            }
            return new MediaSnapshot(size, modified, pending, readable);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private List<Uri> collections() {
        List<Uri> result = new ArrayList<>(2);
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
            result.add(MediaStore.Images.Media.getContentUri(MediaStore.VOLUME_EXTERNAL));
            result.add(MediaStore.Video.Media.getContentUri(MediaStore.VOLUME_EXTERNAL));
        } else {
            result.add(MediaStore.Images.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI);
            result.add(MediaStore.Video.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI);
        }
        return result;
    }

    private static final class MediaSnapshot {
        final long size;
        final long dateModified;
        final int pending;
        final boolean readable;

        MediaSnapshot(long size, long dateModified, int pending, boolean readable) {
            this.size = size;
            this.dateModified = dateModified;
            this.pending = pending;
            this.readable = readable;
        }
    }
}


PhotoBackupManager.java
package com.example.th6.services;

import android.content.Context;

import com.example.th6.data.PhotoRepository;
import com.example.th6.models.LocalMediaPhoto;
import com.example.th6.models.Photo;
import com.example.th6.utils.PhotoVaultTrashCache;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/** Builds the image/video backup queue from MediaStore and cloud metadata. */
public class PhotoBackupManager {
    public interface ManagerCallback {
        void onStatsReady(BackupStats stats, List<LocalMediaPhoto> allLocalPhotos);
        void onError(String error);
    }

    public static class BackupStats {
        public final int totalLocalPhotos;
        public final int backedUpCount;
        public final int remainingCount;
        public final int totalImages;
        public final int backedUpImages;
        public final int pendingImages;
        public final int totalVideos;
        public final int backedUpVideos;
        public final int pendingVideos;
        public final List<LocalMediaPhoto> pendingPhotos;

        BackupStats(int total, int backedUp, List<LocalMediaPhoto> pending,
                    int totalImages, int backedUpImages, int pendingImages,
                    int totalVideos, int backedUpVideos, int pendingVideos) {
            totalLocalPhotos = total;
            backedUpCount = backedUp;
            remainingCount = pending.size();
            this.totalImages = totalImages;
            this.backedUpImages = backedUpImages;
            this.pendingImages = pendingImages;
            this.totalVideos = totalVideos;
            this.backedUpVideos = backedUpVideos;
            this.pendingVideos = pendingVideos;
            pendingPhotos = pending;
        }
    }

    public void processBackupState(Context context, String uid, ManagerCallback callback) {
        new DevicePhotoScanner().scanPhotos(context, new DevicePhotoScanner.ScanCallback() {
            @Override public void onScanComplete(List<LocalMediaPhoto> scanned) {
                new PhotoRepository().getPhotosByUserAsync(uid, new PhotoRepository.Callback<List<Photo>>() {
                    @Override public void onSuccess(List<Photo> cloudPhotos) {
                        buildStats(context, uid, scanned, cloudPhotos, callback);
                    }
                    @Override public void onError(String error) { callback.onError(error); }
                });
            }
            @Override public void onScanError(String error) { callback.onError(error); }
        });
    }

    private void buildStats(Context context, String uid, List<LocalMediaPhoto> images,
                            List<Photo> cloudPhotos, ManagerCallback callback) {
        Map<String, Photo> byUri = new HashMap<>();
        Map<String, Photo> byHash = new HashMap<>();
        java.util.Set<String> trashedUris = new java.util.HashSet<>();
        java.util.Set<Long> trashedIds = new java.util.HashSet<>();
        java.util.Set<String> trashedHashes = new java.util.HashSet<>();
        boolean cloudHasHashes = false;
        for (Photo photo : cloudPhotos) {
            if (photo.getLocalMediaUri() != null && !photo.getLocalMediaUri().isEmpty()) byUri.put(photo.getLocalMediaUri(), photo);
            if (photo.isTrashed()) {
                if (photo.getLocalMediaUri() != null && !photo.getLocalMediaUri().isEmpty()) trashedUris.add(photo.getLocalMediaUri());
                if (photo.getLocalMediaId() > 0) trashedIds.add(photo.getLocalMediaId());
                if (photo.getContentHash() != null && !photo.getContentHash().isEmpty()) trashedHashes.add(photo.getContentHash());
            }
            if (photo.getContentHash() != null && !photo.getContentHash().isEmpty()) {
                cloudHasHashes = true;
                byHash.put(photo.getContentHash(), photo);
            }
        }
        List<LocalMediaPhoto> pending = new ArrayList<>();
        java.util.Set<String> locallyTrashedUris = new java.util.HashSet<>();
        java.util.Set<Long> locallyTrashedIds = new java.util.HashSet<>();
        for (Photo trashed : PhotoVaultTrashCache.getLocal(context)) {
            if (trashed.getLocalMediaUri() != null && !trashed.getLocalMediaUri().isEmpty()) {
                locallyTrashedUris.add(trashed.getLocalMediaUri());
            }
            if (trashed.getLocalMediaId() > 0) locallyTrashedIds.add(trashed.getLocalMediaId());
        }
        for (Photo trashed : PhotoVaultTrashCache.get(context, uid)) {
            if (trashed.getLocalMediaUri() != null && !trashed.getLocalMediaUri().isEmpty()) trashedUris.add(trashed.getLocalMediaUri());
            if (trashed.getLocalMediaId() > 0) trashedIds.add(trashed.getLocalMediaId());
            if (trashed.getContentHash() != null && !trashed.getContentHash().isEmpty()) trashedHashes.add(trashed.getContentHash());
        }
        int backedUp = 0;
        int totalImages = 0, backedImages = 0, pendingImages = 0;
        int totalVideos = 0, backedVideos = 0, pendingVideos = 0;
        try (BackupUploadLedger ledger = new BackupUploadLedger(context)) {
            for (LocalMediaPhoto local : images) {
                if ((local.getContentUri() != null && locallyTrashedUris.contains(local.getContentUri()))
                        || (local.getMediaId() > 0 && locallyTrashedIds.contains(local.getMediaId()))) continue;
                Photo cloud = byUri.get(local.getContentUri());
                if ((local.getContentUri() != null && trashedUris.contains(local.getContentUri()))
                        || (local.getMediaId() > 0 && trashedIds.contains(local.getMediaId()))) continue;
                String localHash = null;
                if (cloud == null && (cloudHasHashes || !trashedHashes.isEmpty())) {
                    localHash = hashUri(context, local.getContentUri());
                    if (localHash != null && trashedHashes.contains(localHash)) continue;
                }
                if (local.isVideo()) totalVideos++; else totalImages++;
                if (cloud == null && cloudHasHashes) {
                    if (localHash == null) localHash = hashUri(context, local.getContentUri());
                    if (localHash != null) cloud = byHash.get(localHash);
                }
                if (cloud != null) {
                    local.setCloudPhotoId(cloud.getId());
                    local.setCloudPhoto(cloud);
                }
                if (cloud != null && cloud.isTrashed()) {
                    // A trashed cloud row is a known backup target, not a new upload candidate.
                    local.setBackupStatus(LocalMediaPhoto.STATUS_UPLOADED);
                    backedUp++;
                    if (local.isVideo()) backedVideos++; else backedImages++;
                    continue;
                }
                boolean verifiedCloudCopy = false;
                if (cloud != null && cloud.getLocalDateModified() > 0) {
                    verifiedCloudCopy = cloud.getLocalDateModified() == local.getDateModified();
                } else if (cloud != null && cloud.getContentHash() != null
                        && !cloud.getContentHash().isEmpty()) {
                    // A URI match alone is not enough when the cloud row lacks a revision.
                    // Compare its stored digest so edits to a local file are not mistaken
                    // for an already completed backup.
                    if (localHash == null) localHash = hashUri(context, local.getContentUri());
                    verifiedCloudCopy = localHash != null && localHash.equals(cloud.getContentHash());
                }
                if (cloud != null && verifiedCloudCopy) {
                    local.setBackupStatus(LocalMediaPhoto.STATUS_UPLOADED);
                    local.setCloudPhotoId(cloud.getId());
                    local.setCloudUrl(cloud.getImageUrl());
                    backedUp++;
                    if (local.isVideo()) backedVideos++; else backedImages++;
                    continue;
                }
                BackupUploadLedger.Entry entry = ledger.find(uid, local.getContentUri());
                if (entry != null && (entry.modified == 0 || entry.modified == local.getDateModified())) {
                    local.setBackupStatus(LocalMediaPhoto.STATUS_METADATA_PENDING);
                    local.setCloudUrl(entry.imageUrl);
                } else {
                    if (entry != null) ledger.remove(uid, local.getContentUri());
                    local.setBackupStatus(LocalMediaPhoto.STATUS_PENDING);
                }
                pending.add(local);
                if (local.isVideo()) pendingVideos++; else pendingImages++;
            }
        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
            callback.onError("Không đọc được trạng thái backup cục bộ: " + e.getLocalizedMessage());
            return;
        }
        callback.onStatsReady(new BackupStats(totalImages + totalVideos, backedUp, pending,
                totalImages, backedImages, pendingImages, totalVideos, backedVideos, pendingVideos), images);
    }

    private String hashUri(Context context, String uriText) {
        if (uriText == null || uriText.isEmpty()) return null;
        try (java.io.InputStream input = context.getContentResolver().openInputStream(android.net.Uri.parse(uriText))) {
            if (input == null) return null;
            java.security.MessageDigest digest = java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
            byte[] buffer = new byte[32 * 1024];
            int count;
            while ((count = input.read(buffer)) != -1) digest.update(buffer, 0, count);
            StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder(64);
            for (byte value : digest.digest()) result.append(String.format(java.util.Locale.US, "%02x", value & 0xff));
            return result.toString();
        } catch (Exception ignored) { return null; }
    }
}


PhotoBackupWorker.java
package com.example.th6.services;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.Manifest;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.SystemClock;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat;
import androidx.work.Data;
import androidx.work.Worker;
import androidx.work.WorkerParameters;

import com.example.th6.data.AuthRepository;
import com.example.th6.data.PhotoRepository;
import com.example.th6.data.StorageRepository;
import com.example.th6.models.LocalMediaPhoto;
import com.example.th6.models.Photo;
import com.example.th6.utils.BackupPreferences;
import io.github.jan.supabase.auth.user.UserInfo;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference;
import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantLock;

public class PhotoBackupWorker extends Worker {
    private static final long CALLBACK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 210;
    private static final long MAX_RUN_MILLIS = TimeUnit.MINUTES.toMillis(8);
    private static final ReentrantLock RUN_LOCK = new ReentrantLock();

    public PhotoBackupWorker(@NonNull Context context, @NonNull WorkerParameters workerParams) {
        super(context, workerParams);
    }

    static boolean acquireIdleRunLock() { return RUN_LOCK.tryLock(); }
    static void releaseIdleRunLock() { RUN_LOCK.unlock(); }

    @NonNull @Override public Result doWork() {
        if (!RUN_LOCK.tryLock()) return Result.retry();
        try {
            return runBackup();
        } finally {
            RUN_LOCK.unlock();
        }
    }

    @NonNull private Result runBackup() {
        long runStartedAt = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime();
        Context context = getApplicationContext();
        String requestedUid = getInputData().getString("backup_uid");
        AuthRepository authRepository = new AuthRepository();
        UserInfo user = authRepository.isLoggedIn() ? authRepository.getCurrentUser() : null;
        if (user == null) {
            if (requestedUid != null) BackupWorkScheduler.cancelPeriodic(context, requestedUid);
            return Result.success(output(0, 0, 0, "Bạn cần đăng nhập để backup."));
        }
        String uid = user.getId();
        if (requestedUid != null && !requestedUid.equals(uid)) {
            BackupWorkScheduler.cancelPeriodic(context, requestedUid);
            return Result.success(output(0, 0, 0, "Tài khoản đã thay đổi; bỏ qua lượt backup cũ."));
        }
        BackupPreferences prefs = new BackupPreferences(context, uid);
        if (!prefs.isBackupEnabled() || prefs.isPaused()) {
            BackupWorkScheduler.cancelPeriodic(context, uid);
            return Result.success(output(0, 0, 0, "Backup đang tắt hoặc tạm dừng."));
        }
        if (!hasAnyMediaReadPermission(context)) {
            return Result.success(output(0, 0, 0, "Chưa có quyền đọc ảnh; backup sẽ thử lại sau khi được cấp quyền."));
        }

        AtomicReference<List<LocalMediaPhoto>> pendingRef = new AtomicReference<>();
        AtomicReference<PhotoBackupManager.BackupStats> statsRef = new AtomicReference<>();
        AtomicReference<String> scanError = new AtomicReference<>();
        CountDownLatch scanLatch = new CountDownLatch(1);
        new PhotoBackupManager().processBackupState(context, uid, new PhotoBackupManager.ManagerCallback() {
            @Override public void onStatsReady(PhotoBackupManager.BackupStats stats, List<LocalMediaPhoto> all) {
                statsRef.set(stats);
                pendingRef.set(stats.pendingPhotos);
                scanLatch.countDown();
            }
            @Override public void onError(String error) { scanError.set(error); scanLatch.countDown(); }
        });
        if (!await(scanLatch, 45)) return Result.retry();
        if (scanError.get() != null) return Result.retry();
        List<LocalMediaPhoto> pending = pendingRef.get();
        PhotoBackupManager.BackupStats initialStats = statsRef.get();
        if (!prefs.isBackupEnabled() || prefs.isPaused()) {
            BackupWorkScheduler.cancelPeriodic(context, uid);
            return Result.success(output(0, 0, pending == null ? 0 : pending.size(), "Backup đang tắt hoặc tạm dừng."));
        }
        if (pending == null || pending.isEmpty()) {
            prefs.setLastSyncTime(System.currentTimeMillis());
            return Result.success(output(0, 0, 0, "Không có ảnh cần backup."));
        }

        StorageRepository storageRepository = new StorageRepository();
        PhotoRepository photoRepository = new PhotoRepository();
        BackupUploadLedger ledger = new BackupUploadLedger(context);
        String runKey = "run_" + uid + "_" + getId();
        android.content.SharedPreferences runPrefs = context.getSharedPreferences("photovault_backup_run_counts", Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        int success = runPrefs.getInt(runKey, 0), failures = 0;
        int imageSuccess = 0;
        int videoSuccess = 0;
        boolean retryableFailure = false;
        String lastError = "";

        try {
            for (int index = 0; index < pending.size(); index++) {
                if (isStopped() || Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) return Result.retry();
                UserInfo activeUser = authRepository.isLoggedIn() ? authRepository.getCurrentUser() : null;
                if (activeUser == null || !uid.equals(activeUser.getId())) {
                    BackupWorkScheduler.cancelPeriodic(context, uid);
                    return Result.success(output(success, failures, pending.size() - index,
                            "Phiên hoặc tài khoản đã thay đổi; đã dừng backup để tránh dùng nhầm tài khoản."));
                }
                if (!prefs.isBackupEnabled() || prefs.isPaused()) {
                    BackupWorkScheduler.cancelPeriodic(context, uid);
                    runPrefs.edit().remove(runKey).apply();
                    return Result.success(output(success, failures, pending.size() - index, "Backup đã tạm dừng."));
                }
                LocalMediaPhoto local = pending.get(index);
                if (!hasMediaReadPermission(context, local.isVideo())) {
                    if (success > 0) prefs.setLastSyncTime(System.currentTimeMillis());
                    runPrefs.edit().remove(runKey).apply();
                    return Result.success(output(success, failures, pending.size() - index,
                            "Quyền đọc ảnh đã bị thu hồi; các ảnh còn lại được giữ để thử lại sau."));
                }
                if (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - runStartedAt >= MAX_RUN_MILLIS) return Result.retry();
                boolean hasUploadedObject = LocalMediaPhoto.STATUS_METADATA_PENDING.equals(local.getBackupStatus())
                        && local.getCloudUrl() != null && !local.getCloudUrl().isEmpty();
                String url;
                String storagePath;
                if (hasUploadedObject) {
                    url = local.getCloudUrl();
                    storagePath = storageRepository.objectPathFromPublicUrl(url);
                    if (storagePath.isEmpty()) storagePath = stableStoragePath(uid, local);
                } else {
                    AtomicReference<String> uploadedUrl = new AtomicReference<>();
                    AtomicReference<String> uploadError = new AtomicReference<>();
                    CountDownLatch uploadLatch = new CountDownLatch(1);
                    String fileName = stableStoragePath(uid, local);
                    setUploadingProgress(index, pending.size(), success, failures, local, imageSuccess, videoSuccess);
                    storageRepository.uploadMediaAsync(context, Uri.parse(local.getContentUri()), fileName,
                            resolveMimeType(local), new StorageRepository.UploadCallback() {
                        @Override public void onSuccess(String publicUrl) {
                            try (BackupUploadLedger callbackLedger = new BackupUploadLedger(context)) {
                                callbackLedger.recordUpload(uid, local.getContentUri(), local.getDateModified(), publicUrl);
                            } catch (RuntimeException ignored) { }
                            uploadedUrl.set(publicUrl);
                            uploadLatch.countDown();
                        }
                        @Override public void onError(String error) {
