    }
}


ImageSaveUtils.java
package com.example.th6.utils;

import android.app.RecoverableSecurityException;
import android.content.ContentResolver;
import android.content.ContentValues;
import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Environment;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.provider.MediaStore;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

/** MediaStore save helpers. Image data is fully encoded before a destination is changed. */
public final class ImageSaveUtils {
    private static final ExecutorService IO = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
    private static final Handler MAIN = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

    private ImageSaveUtils() { }

    public interface SaveCallback {
        void onSuccess(Uri savedUri, String filePath);
        void onError(String error);
        default void onPermissionRequired(android.content.IntentSender sender) {
            onError("Android yêu cầu xác nhận quyền sửa ảnh.");
        }
    }

    public static void saveBitmapAsCopy(Context context, Bitmap bitmap, SaveCallback callback) {
        Context app = context.getApplicationContext();
        IO.execute(() -> {
            File encoded = null;
            Uri inserted = null;
            boolean complete = false;
            try {
                encoded = encode(app, bitmap, Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 95);
                String stamp = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss_SSS", Locale.US).format(new Date());
                String filename = "PhotoVault_" + stamp + "_" + UUID.randomUUID().toString().substring(0, 4) + ".jpg";
                ContentResolver resolver = app.getContentResolver();
                ContentValues values = new ContentValues();
                values.put(MediaStore.Images.Media.DISPLAY_NAME, filename);
                values.put(MediaStore.Images.Media.MIME_TYPE, "image/jpeg");
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
                    values.put(MediaStore.Images.Media.RELATIVE_PATH, Environment.DIRECTORY_PICTURES + "/PhotoVault");
                    values.put(MediaStore.Images.Media.IS_PENDING, 1);
                }
                inserted = resolver.insert(MediaStore.Images.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI, values);
                if (inserted == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Không thể tạo mục ảnh trong MediaStore.");
                try (InputStream in = new FileInputStream(encoded);
                     OutputStream out = resolver.openOutputStream(inserted, "w")) {
                    if (out == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Không thể mở file đích để ghi.");
                    copy(in, out);
                    out.flush();
                }
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
                    ContentValues publish = new ContentValues();
                    publish.put(MediaStore.Images.Media.IS_PENDING, 0);
                    int rows = resolver.update(inserted, publish, null, null);
                    if (rows <= 0) throw new IllegalStateException("Không thể hoàn tất công bố ảnh trong thư viện.");
                }
                complete = true;
                Uri saved = inserted;
                post(() -> callback.onSuccess(saved, filename));
            } catch (Exception error) {
                if (inserted != null && !complete) {
                    try { app.getContentResolver().delete(inserted, null, null); } catch (Exception ignored) { }
                }
                post(() -> callback.onError(message(error)));
            } finally {
                deleteQuietly(encoded);
            }
        });
    }

    public static void overwriteOriginalBitmap(Context context, Bitmap bitmap, Uri originalUri, SaveCallback callback) {
        Context app = context.getApplicationContext();
        IO.execute(() -> {
            File encoded = null;
            File backup = null;
            boolean destinationTouched = false;
            try {
                ContentResolver resolver = app.getContentResolver();
                Bitmap.CompressFormat format = formatForMime(resolver.getType(originalUri));
                if (format == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Định dạng ảnh gốc không được hỗ trợ. Hãy lưu bản sao.");
                encoded = encode(app, bitmap, format, 95);

                // Keep the original bytes available for rollback if the provider fails mid-write.
                backup = File.createTempFile("photovault_original_", ".bak", app.getCacheDir());
                try (InputStream in = resolver.openInputStream(originalUri);
                     OutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(backup)) {
                    if (in == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Không thể đọc ảnh gốc để tạo bản dự phòng.");
                    copy(in, out);
                    out.flush();
                }

                try (InputStream in = new FileInputStream(encoded);
                     OutputStream out = resolver.openOutputStream(originalUri, "rwt")) {
                    if (out == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Không thể mở ảnh gốc để ghi.");
                    destinationTouched = true;
                    copy(in, out);
                    out.flush();
                }
                Uri saved = originalUri;
                post(() -> callback.onSuccess(saved, "Original Updated"));
            } catch (Exception error) {
                if (!destinationTouched && isRecoverableWriteError(error)) {
                    android.content.IntentSender sender = recoverableSender(error);
                    if (sender != null) {
                        post(() -> callback.onPermissionRequired(sender));
                        return;
                    }
                }
                String rollbackError = null;
                if (destinationTouched && backup != null && backup.exists()) {
                    try (InputStream in = new FileInputStream(backup);
                         OutputStream out = app.getContentResolver().openOutputStream(originalUri, "rwt")) {
                        if (out == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Không thể khôi phục ảnh gốc.");
                        copy(in, out);
                        out.flush();
                    } catch (Exception restoreFailure) {
                        rollbackError = " Không thể xác nhận khôi phục ảnh gốc: " + message(restoreFailure);
                    }
                }
                String suffix = rollbackError == null ? " Ảnh gốc được giữ nguyên." : rollbackError;
                post(() -> callback.onError(message(error) + suffix));
            } finally {
                deleteQuietly(encoded);
                deleteQuietly(backup);
            }
        });
    }

    private static File encode(Context context, Bitmap bitmap, Bitmap.CompressFormat format, int quality) throws Exception {
        File file = File.createTempFile("photovault_edit_", ".tmp", context.getCacheDir());
        boolean success = false;
        try (OutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(file)) {
            success = bitmap.compress(format, quality, out);
            out.flush();
        } finally {
            if (!success) deleteQuietly(file);
        }
        if (!success || file.length() == 0) throw new IllegalStateException("Không thể mã hóa ảnh đã chỉnh sửa.");
        return file;
    }

    private static Bitmap.CompressFormat formatForMime(String mime) {
        if ("image/png".equalsIgnoreCase(mime)) return Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG;
        if ("image/webp".equalsIgnoreCase(mime)) return Bitmap.CompressFormat.WEBP;
        if ("image/jpeg".equalsIgnoreCase(mime) || "image/jpg".equalsIgnoreCase(mime)) return Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG;
        return null;
    }

    private static boolean isRecoverableWriteError(Exception error) {
        return Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q && error instanceof RecoverableSecurityException;
    }

    private static android.content.IntentSender recoverableSender(Exception error) {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.Q || !(error instanceof RecoverableSecurityException)) return null;
        return ((RecoverableSecurityException) error).getUserAction().getActionIntent().getIntentSender();
    }

    private static void copy(InputStream in, OutputStream out) throws Exception {
        byte[] buffer = new byte[64 * 1024];
        int count;
        while ((count = in.read(buffer)) != -1) out.write(buffer, 0, count);
    }

    private static String message(Exception error) {
        String text = error.getLocalizedMessage();
        return text == null || text.trim().isEmpty() ? error.getClass().getSimpleName() : text;
    }

    private static void deleteQuietly(File file) {
        if (file != null && file.exists()) {
            //noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            file.delete();
        }
    }

    private static void post(Runnable action) { MAIN.post(action); }
}


LocalVideoFavorites.java
package com.example.th6.utils;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;

import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;

/** Account-scoped favorites for videos that have no cloud photo row yet. */
public final class LocalVideoFavorites {
    private static final String PREFS = "local_video_favorites";
    private LocalVideoFavorites() {}

    private static String key(String uid) { return "uid:" + uid; }

    public static boolean contains(Context context, String uid, String uri) {
        return uri != null && preferences(context).getStringSet(key(uid), new HashSet<>()).contains(uri);
    }

    public static void set(Context context, String uid, String uri, boolean favorite) {
        if (uid == null || uid.isEmpty() || uri == null || uri.isEmpty()) return;
        SharedPreferences prefs = preferences(context);
        Set<String> values = new HashSet<>(prefs.getStringSet(key(uid), new HashSet<>()));
        if (favorite) values.add(uri); else values.remove(uri);
        prefs.edit().putStringSet(key(uid), values).apply();
    }

    private static SharedPreferences preferences(Context context) {
        return context.getApplicationContext().getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
    }
}


MediaTimelineUtils.java
package com.example.th6.utils;

import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

import com.example.th6.R;

import java.text.Collator;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Calendar;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.function.Function;
import java.util.function.Predicate;
import java.util.function.ToLongFunction;

/** Shared filtering and ordering rules for Library, Album and Favorites timelines. */
public final class MediaTimelineUtils {
    public static final int FILTER_ALL = 0;
    public static final int FILTER_IMAGES = 1;
    public static final int FILTER_VIDEOS = 2;

    private MediaTimelineUtils() { }

    public static <T> List<T> filterAndSort(@Nullable List<T> source, int mediaFilter,
                                             int viewMode, int sortMode,
                                             ToLongFunction<T> timestamp,
                                             Function<T, String> name,
                                             Predicate<T> isVideo) {
        List<T> result = new ArrayList<>();
        if (source != null) {
            for (T item : source) {
                boolean video = isVideo.test(item);
                if (mediaFilter == FILTER_ALL
                        || (mediaFilter == FILTER_VIDEOS && video)
                        || (mediaFilter == FILTER_IMAGES && !video)) result.add(item);
            }
        }
        Collator collator = Collator.getInstance(new Locale("vi", "VN"));
        collator.setStrength(Collator.SECONDARY);
        collator.setDecomposition(Collator.CANONICAL_DECOMPOSITION);
        Comparator<T> comparator;
        if (sortMode == R.id.sort_date_asc || sortMode == R.id.sort_date_desc) {
            comparator = Comparator.comparingLong(timestamp);
            if (sortMode == R.id.sort_date_desc) comparator = comparator.reversed();
        } else {
            comparator = (left, right) -> {
                if (viewMode != PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_ALL) {
                    int groupOrder = Long.compare(groupSortTimestamp(timestamp.applyAsLong(right), viewMode),
                            groupSortTimestamp(timestamp.applyAsLong(left), viewMode));
                    if (groupOrder != 0) return groupOrder;
                }
                int order = collator.compare(safeName(name.apply(left)), safeName(name.apply(right)));
                return sortMode == R.id.sort_name_desc ? -order : order;
            };
        }
        result.sort(comparator);
        return result;
    }

    public static long groupSortTimestamp(long timestamp, int viewMode) {
        if (timestamp <= 0) return Long.MIN_VALUE;
        Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance();
        calendar.setTimeInMillis(timestamp);
        if (viewMode == PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_YEARS) {
            calendar.set(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR, 1);
            calendar.set(Calendar.MONTH, Calendar.JANUARY);
        }
        if (viewMode == PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_MONTHS || viewMode == PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_YEARS) {
            calendar.set(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);
        }
        calendar.set(Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY, 0);
        calendar.set(Calendar.MINUTE, 0);
        calendar.set(Calendar.SECOND, 0);
        calendar.set(Calendar.MILLISECOND, 0);
        return calendar.getTimeInMillis();
    }

    private static String safeName(@Nullable String name) { return name == null ? "" : name; }
}


MutablePreviewRgbMatrix.java
package com.example.th6.utils;

import android.opengl.Matrix;

import androidx.media3.effect.RgbMatrix;
import androidx.media3.common.util.UnstableApi;

/** Mutable color transform sampled by Media3 for each rendered frame. */
@UnstableApi
public final class MutablePreviewRgbMatrix implements RgbMatrix {
    private volatile float[] matrix = identity();

    public void update(int brightness, int contrast, int saturation, int exposure,
                       int highlights, int shadows, int temperature, int filter) {
        float[] result = identity();
        float b = brightness / 100f;
        if (Math.abs(b) > .005f) {
            float[] m = identity();
            m[12] = b; m[13] = b; m[14] = b;
            result = after(result, m);
        }

        float contrastFactor = clamp(.5f + contrast / 100f, .5f, 2f);
        if (Math.abs(contrastFactor - 1f) > .005f) {
            result = after(result, affine(contrastFactor, (1f - contrastFactor) * .5f));
        }

        int filterSaturation = filter == 1 ? 25 : filter == 5 ? 10 : 0;
        float sat = clamp((saturation / 100f - 1f) * 100f + filterSaturation, -100f, 100f) / 100f;
        if (filter == 4) sat = -1f;
        if (Math.abs(sat) > .0001f) result = after(result, saturation(sat));

        float ev = exposure / 10f;
        float scale = (float) Math.pow(2d, ev);
        float temp = temperature / 100f;
        float red = scale * (1f + Math.max(0f, temp) * .25f);
        float blue = scale * (1f + Math.max(0f, -temp) * .25f);
        if (Math.abs(ev) > .005f || Math.abs(temp) > .005f) {
            result = after(result, scales(red, scale, blue));
        }
        if (filter == 2) result = after(result, scales(1.08f, 1.01f, .94f));
        if (filter == 3) result = after(result, scales(.94f, 1.01f, 1.08f));
        if (filter == 5) result = after(result, contrast(.35f));

        // Highlights/shadows use a nonlinear LUT during export. A tangent approximation around
        // mid-gray keeps preview responsive without rebuilding that LUT for every slider change.
        if (highlights != 0 || shadows != 0) {
            float h = highlights / 100f * .30f;
            float sh = shadows / 100f * .30f;
            float gain = 1f + .3f * h - .3f * sh;
            float offset = -.075f * h + .225f * sh;
            result = after(result, affine(gain, offset));
        }
        matrix = result;
    }

    @Override public float[] getMatrix(long presentationTimeUs, boolean useHdr) {
        return matrix;
    }

    @Override public boolean isNoOp(int inputWidth, int inputHeight) {
        float[] value = matrix;
        float[] identity = identity();
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) if (Math.abs(value[i] - identity[i]) > .00001f) return false;
        return true;
    }

    private static float[] after(float[] current, float[] next) {
        float[] combined = new float[16];
        Matrix.multiplyMM(combined, 0, next, 0, current, 0);
        return combined;
    }

    private static float[] contrast(float value) {
        float factor = (1f + value) / (1.0001f - value);
        return affine(factor, (1f - factor) * .5f);
    }

    private static float[] affine(float scale, float offset) {
        float[] m = identity();
        m[0] = scale; m[5] = scale; m[10] = scale;
        m[12] = offset; m[13] = offset; m[14] = offset;
        return m;
    }

    private static float[] scales(float red, float green, float blue) {
        float[] m = identity();
        m[0] = red; m[5] = green; m[10] = blue;
        return m;
    }

    private static float[] saturation(float adjustment) {
        // The editor stores saturation as an adjustment around zero (-1..1), matching
        // HslAdjustment.adjustSaturation. Convert it to the actual multiplier (0..2):
        // -1 is grayscale, 0 keeps original color, +0.25 is 125% saturation.
        float amount = clamp(1f + adjustment, 0f, 2f);
        float inverse = 1f - amount;
        float lr = .2126f, lg = .7152f, lb = .0722f;
        float[] m = identity();
        m[0] = lr * inverse + amount; m[4] = lg * inverse;          m[8] = lb * inverse;
        m[1] = lr * inverse;          m[5] = lg * inverse + amount; m[9] = lb * inverse;
        m[2] = lr * inverse;          m[6] = lg * inverse;          m[10] = lb * inverse + amount;
        return m;
    }

    private static float[] identity() {
        float[] value = new float[16];
        Matrix.setIdentityM(value, 0);
        return value;
    }

    private static float clamp(float value, float min, float max) {
        return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
    }
}


PhotoTimelineUtils.java
package com.example.th6.utils;

import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.Calendar;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.Locale;

public class PhotoTimelineUtils {
    public static final int VIEW_MODE_ALL = 0;
    public static final int VIEW_MODE_DAYS = 1;
    public static final int VIEW_MODE_MONTHS = 2;
    public static final int VIEW_MODE_YEARS = 3;

    private static final SimpleDateFormat dayFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("dd 'tháng' MM, yyyy", Locale.getDefault());
    private static final SimpleDateFormat monthFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("'Tháng' MM, yyyy", Locale.getDefault());
    private static final SimpleDateFormat yearFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy", Locale.getDefault());

    public static String getDayLabel(long timestamp) {
        return dayFormat.format(new Date(timestamp));
    }

    public static String getMonthLabel(long timestamp) {
        return monthFormat.format(new Date(timestamp));
    }

    public static String getYearLabel(long timestamp) {
        return yearFormat.format(new Date(timestamp));
    }

    public static String getGroupKey(long timestamp, int viewMode) {
        if (timestamp <= 0) return "unknown";
        Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance();
        calendar.setTimeInMillis(timestamp);
        switch (viewMode) {
            case VIEW_MODE_DAYS:
                return calendar.get(Calendar.YEAR) + "-" + calendar.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR);
            case VIEW_MODE_MONTHS:
                return calendar.get(Calendar.YEAR) + "-" + calendar.get(Calendar.MONTH);
            case VIEW_MODE_YEARS:
                return String.valueOf(calendar.get(Calendar.YEAR));
            default:
                return "";
        }
    }

    public static String getGroupLabel(long timestamp, int viewMode) {
        if (timestamp <= 0) {
            if (viewMode == VIEW_MODE_DAYS) return "Ngày không xác định";
            if (viewMode == VIEW_MODE_MONTHS) return "Tháng không xác định";
            return "Năm không xác định";
        }
        Calendar date = Calendar.getInstance();
        date.setTimeInMillis(timestamp);
        if (viewMode == VIEW_MODE_DAYS) {
            Calendar today = Calendar.getInstance();
            if (isSameDay(date, today)) return "Hôm nay";
            today.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR, -1);
            if (isSameDay(date, today)) return "Hôm qua";
            return getDayLabel(timestamp);
        }
        if (viewMode == VIEW_MODE_MONTHS) return getMonthLabel(timestamp);
        return getYearLabel(timestamp);
    }

    private static boolean isSameDay(Calendar first, Calendar second) {
        return first.get(Calendar.YEAR) == second.get(Calendar.YEAR)
                && first.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR) == second.get(Calendar.DAY_OF_YEAR);
    }
}


PhotoTrashManager.java
package com.example.th6.utils;

import android.content.Context;

import com.example.th6.data.PhotoRepository;
import com.example.th6.models.Photo;

/** Shared soft-delete entry point for cloud-backed and device-only library items. */
public final class PhotoTrashManager {
    public interface Callback {
        void onSuccess(Photo photo);
        void onError(String error);
    }

    private PhotoTrashManager() { }

    public static void moveToTrash(Context context, String uid, Photo photo, Callback callback) {
        if (photo == null) {
            callback.onError("Không tìm thấy mục cần chuyển vào thùng rác.");
            return;
        }
        if ("local".equals(photo.getOwnerUid())) {
            PhotoVaultTrashCache.addLocal(context.getApplicationContext(), photo);
            callback.onSuccess(photo);
            return;
        }
        if (uid == null || uid.isBlank() || !uid.equals(photo.getOwnerUid()) || photo.getId() == null || photo.getId().isBlank()) {
            callback.onError("Không xác minh được tài khoản sở hữu mục cloud.");
            return;
        }
        new PhotoRepository().moveToTrashAsync(uid, photo.getId(), true, new PhotoRepository.Callback<Void>() {
            @Override public void onSuccess(Void result) {
                PhotoVaultTrashCache.add(context.getApplicationContext(), uid, photo);
                callback.onSuccess(photo);
            }
            @Override public void onError(String error) { callback.onError(error); }
        });
    }
}


PhotoVaultTrashCache.java
package com.example.th6.utils;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;

import com.example.th6.models.Photo;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.Set;
import com.example.th6.models.LocalMediaPhoto;

/** Local, account-scoped cache of server-confirmed trash identities for offline library scans. */
public final class PhotoVaultTrashCache {
    private static final String PREFS = "photovault_trash_cache";

    private PhotoVaultTrashCache() { }

    public static synchronized List<Photo> get(Context context, String uid) {
        List<Photo> result = new ArrayList<>();
        if (context == null || uid == null || uid.isEmpty()) return result;
        String encoded = prefs(context).getString(uid, "[]");
        try {
            JSONArray entries = new JSONArray(encoded);
            for (int i = 0; i < entries.length(); i++) {
                JSONObject entry = entries.optJSONObject(i);
                if (entry == null) continue;
                Photo photo = new Photo();
                photo.setId(entry.optString("id", ""));
                photo.setOwnerUid(uid);
                photo.setTrashed(true);
                photo.setLocalMediaUri(entry.optString("uri", ""));
                photo.setLocalMediaId(entry.optLong("mediaId", 0L));
                photo.setLocalDateModified(entry.optLong("modified", 0L));
                photo.setContentHash(entry.isNull("hash") ? null : entry.optString("hash", null));
                photo.setName(entry.optString("name", ""));
                photo.setImageUrl(entry.optString("imageUrl", ""));
                photo.setMediaType(entry.optString("mediaType", "image"));
                photo.setCreatedAt(entry.optLong("createdAt", 0L));
                result.add(photo);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        return result;
    }

    /** Replace only after a successful, complete cloud query for this user. */
    public static synchronized void replace(Context context, String uid, List<Photo> trashedPhotos) {
        if (context == null || uid == null || uid.isEmpty()) return;
        JSONArray entries = new JSONArray();
        if (trashedPhotos != null) for (Photo photo : trashedPhotos) {
            if (photo == null || !photo.isTrashed() || !uid.equals(photo.getOwnerUid())) continue;
            entries.put(encode(photo));
        }
        prefs(context).edit().putString(uid, entries.toString()).commit();
    }

    public static synchronized void add(Context context, String uid, Photo photo) {
        if (context == null || uid == null || uid.isEmpty() || photo == null || !uid.equals(photo.getOwnerUid())) return;
        List<Photo> entries = get(context, uid);
        entries.removeIf(existing -> existing.getId().equals(photo.getId()));
        photo.setTrashed(true);
        entries.add(photo);
        write(context, uid, entries);
    }

    /** Store a device-only soft-delete record; the MediaStore file remains untouched. */
    public static synchronized void addLocal(Context context, Photo photo) {
        if (photo == null || !"local".equals(photo.getOwnerUid())) return;
        List<Photo> entries = get(context, "local");
        entries.removeIf(existing -> existing.getId().equals(photo.getId()));
        photo.setTrashed(true);
        entries.add(photo);
        write(context, "local", entries);
    }

    public static synchronized List<Photo> getLocal(Context context) {
        return get(context, "local");
    }

    /** Stable identities used by album/library scans to hide device-only trashed rows. */
    public static synchronized Set<String> getLocalMediaIdentityKeys(Context context) {
        Set<String> keys = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        for (Photo photo : getLocal(context)) {
            if (!photo.isTrashed()) continue;
            if (photo.getLocalMediaUri() != null && !photo.getLocalMediaUri().isEmpty()) keys.add("uri:" + photo.getLocalMediaUri());
            else if (photo.getLocalMediaId() > 0) keys.add("id:" + photo.getLocalMediaId());
        }
        return keys;
    }

    public static boolean isLocalMediaTrashed(Set<String> identities, LocalMediaPhoto media) {
        if (identities == null || media == null) return false;
        String uri = media.getContentUri();
        return (uri != null && identities.contains("uri:" + uri))
                || (media.getMediaId() > 0 && identities.contains("id:" + media.getMediaId()));
    }

    public static synchronized void remove(Context context, String uid, String photoId) {
        if (context == null || uid == null || uid.isEmpty() || photoId == null || photoId.isEmpty()) return;
        List<Photo> entries = get(context, uid);
        entries.removeIf(existing -> photoId.equals(existing.getId()));
        write(context, uid, entries);
    }

    private static JSONObject encode(Photo photo) {
        JSONObject entry = new JSONObject();
        try {
            entry.put("id", photo.getId());
            entry.put("uri", photo.getLocalMediaUri());
            entry.put("mediaId", photo.getLocalMediaId());
            entry.put("modified", photo.getLocalDateModified());
            entry.put("hash", photo.getContentHash());
            entry.put("name", photo.getName());
            entry.put("imageUrl", photo.getImageUrl());
            entry.put("mediaType", photo.getMediaType());
            entry.put("createdAt", photo.getCreatedAt());
        } catch (Exception ignored) { }
        return entry;
    }

    private static void write(Context context, String uid, List<Photo> photos) {
        JSONArray entries = new JSONArray();
        for (Photo photo : photos) entries.put(encode(photo));
        prefs(context).edit().putString(uid, entries.toString()).commit();
    }

    private static SharedPreferences prefs(Context context) {
        return context.getApplicationContext().getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
    }
}

    }

        prefs.edit().putString(KEY_SORT_ORDER, sortOrder).apply();
    }

SmartCleanupImageAnalyzer.java
package com.example.th6.utils;

import android.graphics.Bitmap;

/** Small CPU-only perceptual hash and luminance SSIM helper for downsampled images. */
public final class SmartCleanupImageAnalyzer {
    public static final int DUPLICATE_MAX_DISTANCE = 4;
    public static final double DUPLICATE_MIN_SSIM = 0.93;
    public static final int SIMILAR_MAX_DISTANCE = 10;
    public static final double SIMILAR_MIN_SSIM = 0.82;
    private static final int N = 32;
    private static final int LOW = 8;
    private static final double[][] BASIS = createBasis();

    private SmartCleanupImageAnalyzer() { }

    private static double[][] createBasis() {
        double[][] basis = new double[LOW][N];
        for (int frequency = 0; frequency < LOW; frequency++) for (int coordinate = 0; coordinate < N; coordinate++)
            basis[frequency][coordinate] = Math.cos(((2 * coordinate + 1) * frequency * Math.PI) / (2 * N));
        return basis;
    }

    public static long perceptualHash(Bitmap bitmap) {
        return perceptualHash(graySignature(bitmap));
    }

    public static byte[] graySignature(Bitmap bitmap) {
        Bitmap scaled = Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(bitmap, N, N, true);
        try {
            int[] pixels = new int[N * N];
            scaled.getPixels(pixels, 0, N, 0, 0, N, N);
            byte[] gray = new byte[N * N];
            for (int i = 0; i < pixels.length; i++) gray[i] = (byte) Math.round(luminance(pixels[i]));
            return gray;
        } finally {
            if (scaled != bitmap && !scaled.isRecycled()) scaled.recycle();
        }
    }

    public static long perceptualHash(byte[] grayBytes) {
        if (grayBytes == null || grayBytes.length != N * N) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected 32x32 grayscale data");
        double[][] gray = new double[N][N];
        for (int y = 0; y < N; y++) for (int x = 0; x < N; x++) gray[y][x] = grayBytes[y * N + x] & 255;
        double[][] coeff = new double[LOW][LOW];
        for (int v = 0; v < LOW; v++) for (int u = 0; u < LOW; u++) {
            double sum = 0;
            for (int y = 0; y < N; y++) for (int x = 0; x < N; x++) {
                sum += gray[y][x] * BASIS[u][x] * BASIS[v][y];
            }
            coeff[v][u] = sum;
        }
        double[] values = new double[LOW * LOW - 1];
        int k = 0;
        for (int v = 0; v < LOW; v++) for (int u = 0; u < LOW; u++) if (u != 0 || v != 0) values[k++] = coeff[v][u];
        java.util.Arrays.sort(values);
        double median = values[values.length / 2];
        long hash = 0;
        int bit = 0;
        for (int v = 0; v < LOW; v++) for (int u = 0; u < LOW; u++) {
            if (u == 0 && v == 0) continue;
            if (coeff[v][u] >= median) hash |= (1L << bit);
            bit++;
        }
        return hash;
    }

    public static double luminanceSsim(Bitmap first, Bitmap second) {
        return luminanceSsim(graySignature(first), graySignature(second));
    }

    public static double luminanceSsim(byte[] first, byte[] second) {
        if (first == null || second == null || first.length != N * N || second.length != N * N) return 0;
        double ma = 0, mb = 0;
        double[] ga = new double[first.length], gb = new double[second.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < first.length; i++) {
            ga[i] = first[i] & 255; gb[i] = second[i] & 255;
            ma += ga[i]; mb += gb[i];
        }
        ma /= first.length; mb /= second.length;
        double va = 0, vb = 0, cov = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < first.length; i++) {
            double da = ga[i] - ma, db = gb[i] - mb;
            va += da * da; vb += db * db; cov += da * db;
        }
        va /= first.length - 1; vb /= second.length - 1; cov /= first.length - 1;
        double c1 = 6.5025, c2 = 58.5225;
        return ((2 * ma * mb + c1) * (2 * cov + c2)) / ((ma * ma + mb * mb + c1) * (va + vb + c2));
    }

    private static double luminance(int color) {
        return 0.299 * ((color >> 16) & 255) + 0.587 * ((color >> 8) & 255) + 0.114 * (color & 255);
    }

    public static int hammingDistance(long a, long b) { return Long.bitCount(a ^ b); }

    public static boolean isDuplicate(long hashA, long hashB, double ssim) {
        return hammingDistance(hashA, hashB) <= DUPLICATE_MAX_DISTANCE && ssim >= DUPLICATE_MIN_SSIM;
    }

    public static boolean isSimilar(long hashA, long hashB, double ssim) {
        int distance = hammingDistance(hashA, hashB);
        return distance > DUPLICATE_MAX_DISTANCE && distance <= SIMILAR_MAX_DISTANCE && ssim >= SIMILAR_MIN_SSIM;
    }
}

VideoDurationFormatter.java
package com.example.th6.utils;

import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;

public class VideoDurationFormatter {
    public static String formatDuration(long durationMs) {
        if (durationMs <= 0) return "00:00";
        long hours = TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toHours(durationMs);
        long minutes = TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toMinutes(durationMs) % 60;
        long seconds = TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toSeconds(durationMs) % 60;

        if (hours > 0) {
            return String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%02d:%02d:%02d", hours, minutes, seconds);
        } else {
            return String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%02d:%02d", minutes, seconds);
        }
    }
}
