 /** Maps the editor's displayed contrast multiplier (0.5x..2x) to Media3's contrast range. */
 public static float contrastSliderToValue(int sliderValue){
  float factor=Math.max(.5f,Math.min(2f,.5f+sliderValue/100f));
  return (1.0001f*factor-1f)/(factor+1f);
 }
 public static List<Effect> createEffects(int brightness,int contrast,int saturation,int exposure,int highlights,int shadows,int temperature,int filter){
  List<Effect> effects=new ArrayList<>();
  float b=brightness/100f; if(Math.abs(b)>.005f)effects.add(new Brightness(b));
  float c=contrastSliderToValue(contrast); if(Math.abs(c)>.005f)effects.add(new Contrast(c));
  int filterSaturation=filter==1?25:filter==5?10:0; int sat=(int)Math.max(-100,Math.min(100,(saturation/100f-1f)*100+filterSaturation));
  if(filter==4)effects.add(new HslAdjustment.Builder().adjustSaturation(-100).build());
  else if(sat!=0)effects.add(new HslAdjustment.Builder().adjustSaturation(sat).build());
  float ev=exposure/10f; float scale=(float)Math.pow(2d,ev); float temp=temperature/100f;
  float red=scale*(1f+Math.max(0,temp)*.25f), blue=scale*(1f+Math.max(0,-temp)*.25f);
  if(Math.abs(ev)>.005f||Math.abs(temp)>.005f)effects.add(new RgbAdjustment.Builder().setRedScale(red).setGreenScale(scale).setBlueScale(blue).build());
  if(filter==2)effects.add(new RgbAdjustment.Builder().setRedScale(1.08f).setGreenScale(1.01f).setBlueScale(.94f).build());
  if(filter==3)effects.add(new RgbAdjustment.Builder().setRedScale(.94f).setGreenScale(1.01f).setBlueScale(1.08f).build());
  if(filter==5)effects.add(new Contrast(.35f));
  if(filter==6)effects.add(new androidx.media3.effect.GaussianBlur(3f));
  if(highlights!=0||shadows!=0){
   final int n=17; int[][][] cube=new int[n][n][n]; float h=highlights/100f*.30f, sh=shadows/100f*.30f;
   for(int r=0;r<n;r++)for(int g=0;g<n;g++)for(int bi=0;bi<n;bi++){float rf=r/(float)(n-1),gf=g/(float)(n-1),bf=bi/(float)(n-1);cube[r][g][bi]=0xff000000|(channel(rf,h,sh)<<16)|(channel(gf,h,sh)<<8)|channel(bf,h,sh);}
   effects.add(androidx.media3.effect.SingleColorLut.createFromCube(cube));
  }
  return effects;
 }
 private static int channel(float value,float highlights,float shadows){float v=value+highlights*v2(value)+shadows*v2(1f-value);return Math.round(Math.max(0f,Math.min(1f,v))*255f);}
 private static float v2(float value){return value*value;}
 public static void trimAndExportVideo(Context context,Uri source,long startMs,long endMs,boolean mute,SaveVideoCallback callback){
  trimAndExportVideo(context,source,startMs,endMs,mute,Collections.emptyList(),callback);
 }
 public static void trimAndExportVideo(Context context,Uri source,long startMs,long endMs,boolean mute,List<Effect> effects,SaveVideoCallback callback){
  Context app=context.getApplicationContext(); Handler main=new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
  try {
   String filename="PhotoVault_Video_"+new SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss",Locale.getDefault()).format(new Date())+".mp4";
   File temp=new File(app.getCacheDir(),filename);
   MediaItem input=new MediaItem.Builder().setUri(source).setClippingConfiguration(new MediaItem.ClippingConfiguration.Builder().setStartPositionMs(startMs).setEndPositionMs(endMs).build()).build();
   EditedMediaItem edited=new EditedMediaItem.Builder(input).setRemoveAudio(mute).setEffects(new Effects(Collections.emptyList(),effects)).build();
   Transformer transformer=new Transformer.Builder(app).addListener(new Transformer.Listener(){
    @Override public void onCompleted(androidx.media3.transformer.Composition composition,ExportResult result){
     Uri outUri=null; boolean success=false;
     try {ContentResolver resolver=app.getContentResolver();ContentValues values=new ContentValues();values.put(MediaStore.Video.Media.DISPLAY_NAME,filename);values.put(MediaStore.Video.Media.MIME_TYPE,"video/mp4");if(Build.VERSION.SDK_INT>=29){values.put(MediaStore.Video.Media.RELATIVE_PATH,Environment.DIRECTORY_MOVIES+"/PhotoVault");values.put(MediaStore.Video.Media.IS_PENDING,1);}outUri=resolver.insert(MediaStore.Video.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI,values);if(outUri==null)throw new java.io.IOException("Không thể tạo video trong thư viện.");try(FileInputStream in=new FileInputStream(temp);OutputStream out=resolver.openOutputStream(outUri,"w")){if(out==null)throw new java.io.IOException("Không thể ghi video vào thư viện.");byte[] buf=new byte[65536];int n;while((n=in.read(buf))!=-1)out.write(buf,0,n);out.flush();}if(Build.VERSION.SDK_INT>=29){ContentValues done=new ContentValues();done.put(MediaStore.Video.Media.IS_PENDING,0);resolver.update(outUri,done,null,null);}success=true;}catch(Exception e){if(outUri!=null)try{app.getContentResolver().delete(outUri,null,null);}catch(Exception ignored){} final String error=e.getMessage();main.post(()->callback.onError("Không thể lưu video: "+error));}finally{if(temp.exists())temp.delete();}if(success){Uri resultUri=outUri;main.post(()->callback.onSuccess(resultUri,filename));}
    }
    @Override public void onError(androidx.media3.transformer.Composition composition,ExportResult result,ExportException exception){if(temp.exists())temp.delete();main.post(()->callback.onError("Xuất video thất bại: "+exception.getMessage()));}
   }).build();
   transformer.start(edited,temp.getAbsolutePath());
  }catch(Exception e){main.post(()->callback.onError("Không thể bắt đầu xuất video: "+e.getMessage()));}
 }

 /** Preflights write access without changing the media. On Android 10, opening in append mode
  * produces Android's recoverable-consent exception for items owned by another app. */
 public static IntentSender getWriteConsentRequest(Context context, Uri target) throws Exception {
  if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
   return MediaStore.createWriteRequest(context.getContentResolver(), Collections.singletonList(target))
           .getIntentSender();
  }
  if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT == Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
   try (android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor ignored = context.getContentResolver().openFileDescriptor(target, "wa")) {
    if (ignored == null) throw new java.io.IOException("Không mở được video để ghi.");
    return null;
   } catch (android.app.RecoverableSecurityException recoverable) {
    return recoverable.getUserAction().getActionIntent().getIntentSender();
   }
  }
  return null;
 }

 /** Exports and validates a replacement before touching the original MediaStore item. */
 public static void overwriteVideo(Context context, Uri source, long originalDateModified,
                                   long startMs, long endMs,
                                   boolean mute, List<Effect> effects, SaveVideoCallback callback) {
  Context app = context.getApplicationContext();
  Handler main = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
  String name = "PhotoVault_Overwrite_" + System.currentTimeMillis() + ".mp4";
  File rendered = new File(app.getCacheDir(), name);
  File backup = new File(app.getNoBackupFilesDir(), "video_overwrite_recovery.tmp");
  try {
   MediaItem input = new MediaItem.Builder().setUri(source)
           .setClippingConfiguration(new MediaItem.ClippingConfiguration.Builder()
                   .setStartPositionMs(startMs).setEndPositionMs(endMs).build()).build();
   EditedMediaItem edited = new EditedMediaItem.Builder(input).setRemoveAudio(mute)
           .setEffects(new Effects(Collections.emptyList(), effects)).build();
   Transformer transformer = new Transformer.Builder(app).addListener(new Transformer.Listener() {
    @Override public void onCompleted(androidx.media3.transformer.Composition composition, ExportResult result) {
     STORAGE_EXECUTOR.execute(() -> {
     try {
      if (!isUsableVideo(rendered)) throw new java.io.IOException("Video xuất ra không hợp lệ.");
      copyUriToFile(app, source, backup);
      if (backup.length() == 0L) throw new java.io.IOException("Không tạo được bản khôi phục video gốc.");
      long originalSize = getMediaSize(app, source);
      if (originalSize > 0L && backup.length() != originalSize)
       throw new java.io.IOException("Bản sao khôi phục không khớp kích thước video gốc.");
      writeRecoveryJournal(app, source, originalDateModified);
      try {
       copyFileToUri(app, rendered, source);
       if (!isUsableVideo(app, source)) throw new java.io.IOException("Không xác minh được video sau khi ghi.");
       ContentValues metadata = new ContentValues();
       metadata.put(MediaStore.Video.Media.DATE_MODIFIED,
               Math.max(System.currentTimeMillis() / 1000L, originalDateModified + 1L));
       int updated = app.getContentResolver().update(source, metadata, null, null);
       if (updated <= 0) throw new java.io.IOException("Không cập nhật được metadata MediaStore.");
       long savedSize = getMediaSize(app, source);
       if (savedSize > 0L && savedSize != rendered.length())
        throw new java.io.IOException("Kích thước video sau ghi không khớp file đã xử lý.");
       app.getContentResolver().notifyChange(source, null);
      } catch (Exception writeFailure) {
       try {
        copyFileToUri(app, backup, source);
        if (!isUsableVideo(app, source)) throw new java.io.IOException("Bản gốc khôi phục không hợp lệ.");
        restoreDateModified(app, source, originalDateModified);
        app.getContentResolver().notifyChange(source, null);
        clearRecoveryFiles(app, backup);
        throw new java.io.IOException("Không lưu đè được video; bản gốc đã được khôi phục.", writeFailure);
       } catch (Exception rollbackFailure) {
        if (rollbackFailure.getCause() == writeFailure) throw rollbackFailure;
        throw new java.io.IOException("Lỗi khi lưu đè và không thể xác minh khôi phục. Bản sao cứu hộ được giữ tại "
                + backup.getAbsolutePath(), writeFailure);
       }
      }
      clearRecoveryFiles(app, backup);
      rendered.delete();
      main.post(() -> callback.onSuccess(source, name));
     } catch (Exception error) {
      rendered.delete();
      main.post(() -> callback.onError(error.getMessage() == null ? "Không lưu đè được video." : error.getMessage()));
     }
     });
    }
    @Override public void onError(androidx.media3.transformer.Composition composition, ExportResult result,
                                  ExportException exception) {
     rendered.delete();
     main.post(() -> callback.onError("Xuất video thất bại: " + exception.getMessage()));
    }
   }).build();
   transformer.start(edited, rendered.getAbsolutePath());
  } catch (Exception error) {
   rendered.delete();
   main.post(() -> callback.onError("Không thể bắt đầu lưu đè: " + error.getMessage()));
  }
 }

 private static void copyUriToFile(Context context, Uri source, File target) throws Exception {
  try (InputStream in = context.getContentResolver().openInputStream(source);
       OutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(target, false)) {
   if (in == null) throw new java.io.IOException("Không đọc được video gốc.");
   copy(in, out);
  }
 }

 private static void copyFileToUri(Context context, File source, Uri target) throws Exception {
  try (InputStream in = new FileInputStream(source);
       OutputStream out = context.getContentResolver().openOutputStream(target, "rwt")) {
   if (out == null) throw new java.io.IOException("Không mở được video đích để ghi.");
   copy(in, out);
  }
 }

 private static void copy(InputStream in, OutputStream out) throws Exception {
  byte[] buffer = new byte[64 * 1024];
  int read;
  while ((read = in.read(buffer)) != -1) out.write(buffer, 0, read);
  out.flush();
 }

 /** Restores a staged original before normal navigation if Android killed the app mid-write. */
 public static boolean hasPendingOverwriteRecovery(Context context) {
  return new File(context.getNoBackupFilesDir(), RECOVERY_JOURNAL).isFile();
 }

 public static void recoverInterruptedOverwriteAsync(Context context, RecoveryCallback callback) {
  Context app = context.getApplicationContext();
  Handler main = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
  STORAGE_EXECUTOR.execute(() -> {
   String error = recoverInterruptedOverwrite(app);
   main.post(() -> callback.onComplete(error));
  });
 }

 public static String recoverInterruptedOverwrite(Context context) {
  File backup = new File(context.getNoBackupFilesDir(), RECOVERY_BACKUP);
  File journal = new File(context.getNoBackupFilesDir(), RECOVERY_JOURNAL);
  if (!journal.isFile()) return null;
  try (BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new FileReader(journal))) {
   String uriText = reader.readLine();
   String dateModifiedText = reader.readLine();
   if (uriText == null || uriText.isEmpty() || !backup.isFile() || backup.length() == 0L)
    throw new java.io.IOException("Bản gốc khôi phục không đầy đủ.");
   Uri target = Uri.parse(uriText);
   copyFileToUri(context, backup, target);
   if (!isUsableVideo(context, target)) throw new java.io.IOException("Không xác minh được video đã khôi phục.");
   if (dateModifiedText != null && !dateModifiedText.isEmpty()) {
    try { restoreDateModified(context, target, Long.parseLong(dateModifiedText)); }
    catch (NumberFormatException ignored) { }
   }
   context.getContentResolver().notifyChange(target, null);
   clearRecoveryFiles(context, backup);
   return null;
  } catch (Exception error) {
   return "Không khôi phục tự động được video sau khi ứng dụng bị dừng: " + error.getMessage()
           + ". Bản sao cứu hộ vẫn được giữ trong dữ liệu riêng của PhotoVault tại " + backup.getAbsolutePath();
  }
 }

 private static void writeRecoveryJournal(Context context, Uri source, long originalDateModified) throws Exception {
  File journal = new File(context.getNoBackupFilesDir(), RECOVERY_JOURNAL);
  try (FileOutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(journal, false)) {
   out.write((source.toString() + "\n" + originalDateModified)
           .getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
   out.getFD().sync();
  }
 }

 private static void restoreDateModified(Context context, Uri source, long dateModified) {
  if (dateModified <= 0L) return;
  ContentValues values = new ContentValues();
  values.put(MediaStore.Video.Media.DATE_MODIFIED, dateModified);
  context.getContentResolver().update(source, values, null, null);
 }

 private static long getMediaSize(Context context, Uri uri) {
  try (android.database.Cursor cursor = context.getContentResolver().query(uri,
          new String[]{MediaStore.Video.Media.SIZE}, null, null, null)) {
   return cursor != null && cursor.moveToFirst() ? cursor.getLong(0) : -1L;
  } catch (Exception ignored) { return -1L; }
 }

 private static void clearRecoveryFiles(Context context, File backup) {
  new File(context.getNoBackupFilesDir(), RECOVERY_JOURNAL).delete();
  backup.delete();
 }

 private static boolean isUsableVideo(File file) {
  if (!file.isFile() || file.length() <= 0L) return false;
  MediaMetadataRetriever retriever = new MediaMetadataRetriever();
  try {
   retriever.setDataSource(file.getAbsolutePath());
   String duration = retriever.extractMetadata(MediaMetadataRetriever.METADATA_KEY_DURATION);
   return duration != null && Long.parseLong(duration) > 0L;
  } catch (Exception error) { return false; }
  finally { try { retriever.release(); } catch (Exception ignored) { } }
 }

 private static boolean isUsableVideo(Context context, Uri uri) {
  MediaMetadataRetriever retriever = new MediaMetadataRetriever();
  try {
   retriever.setDataSource(context, uri);
   String duration = retriever.extractMetadata(MediaMetadataRetriever.METADATA_KEY_DURATION);
   return duration != null && Long.parseLong(duration) > 0L;
  } catch (Exception error) { return false; }
  finally { try { retriever.release(); } catch (Exception ignored) { } }
 }
}


LoginViewModel.kt
package com.example.th6.viewmodels

import androidx.lifecycle.LiveData
import androidx.lifecycle.MutableLiveData
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.th6.data.AuthRepository
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

class LoginViewModel(
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository = AuthRepository()
) : ViewModel() {

    sealed class State {
        object Idle : State()
        object Loading : State()
        data class Success(val userId: String) : State()
        data class Error(val message: String) : State()
    }

    private val _state = MutableLiveData<State>(State.Idle)
    val state: LiveData<State> get() = _state

    fun login(email: String, password: String) {
        if (_state.value is State.Loading) return
        _state.value = State.Loading
        viewModelScope.launch {
            when (val result = authRepository.signIn(email, password)) {
                is AuthRepository.AuthResult.Success -> {
                    val userId = result.userId
                    _state.value = if (userId.isNullOrBlank()) {
                        State.Error("Không thể xác nhận phiên đăng nhập. Vui lòng thử lại.")
                    } else {
                        State.Success(userId)
                    }
                }
                is AuthRepository.AuthResult.Failure -> _state.value = State.Error(result.message)
            }
        }
    }

    fun consumeResult() {
        if (_state.value is State.Success || _state.value is State.Error) {
            _state.value = State.Idle
        }
    }
}


PasswordRecoveryViewModel.kt
package com.example.th6.viewmodels

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.th6.data.AuthRepository
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext

class PasswordRecoveryViewModel : ViewModel() {
    private val repository = AuthRepository()

    @Volatile var requestInFlight = false
        private set
    @Volatile var recoveryInFlight = false
        private set

    interface Callback { fun onResult(success: Boolean, message: String) }

    fun send(email: String, callback: Callback) {
        if (requestInFlight) return
        requestInFlight = true
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val result = repository.resetPassword(email)
            requestInFlight = false
            withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                when (result) {
                    is AuthRepository.AuthResult.Success -> callback.onResult(true, result.message)
                    is AuthRepository.AuthResult.Failure -> callback.onResult(false, result.message)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun accept(fragment: String, callback: Callback) {
        if (recoveryInFlight) return
        recoveryInFlight = true
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val result = repository.acceptRecoveryFragment(fragment)
            recoveryInFlight = false
            withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                when (result) {
                    is AuthRepository.AuthResult.Success -> callback.onResult(true, result.message)
                    is AuthRepository.AuthResult.Failure -> callback.onResult(false, result.message)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun update(password: String, callback: Callback) {
        if (recoveryInFlight) return
        recoveryInFlight = true
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val result = repository.updateRecoveredPassword(password)
            recoveryInFlight = false
            withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                when (result) {
                    is AuthRepository.AuthResult.Success -> callback.onResult(true, result.message)
                    is AuthRepository.AuthResult.Failure -> callback.onResult(false, result.message)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}


PhotoDeleteViewModel.kt
package com.example.th6.viewmodels

import androidx.lifecycle.LiveData
import androidx.lifecycle.MutableLiveData
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.th6.data.PhotoRepository
import com.example.th6.data.StorageRepository
import com.example.th6.models.Photo
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext

class PhotoDeleteViewModel(
    private val storageRepository: StorageRepository = StorageRepository(),
    private val photoRepository: PhotoRepository = PhotoRepository()
) : ViewModel() {

    sealed class DeleteState {
        object Idle : DeleteState()
        data class Progress(val message: String = "Đang xóa ảnh khỏi Supabase...") : DeleteState()
        data class Success(val photoId: String, val message: String = "Xóa ảnh thành công!") : DeleteState()
        data class Error(val error: String) : DeleteState()
    }

    private val _deleteState = MutableLiveData<DeleteState>(DeleteState.Idle)
    val deleteState: LiveData<DeleteState> get() = _deleteState

    interface DeleteCallback {
        fun onSuccess(photoId: String)
        fun onError(error: String)
    }

    /**
     * Executes photo deletion flow on Supabase:
     * (1) Calls StorageRepository.deleteImage to delete the physical file on Supabase Storage ('photos_bucket').
     * (2) Calls PhotoRepository.deletePhoto to delete the metadata record in Supabase 'photos' table.
     * Completely removes all legacy Firebase logic.
     */
    fun deletePhoto(photo: Photo) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _deleteState.value = DeleteState.Progress("Đang xóa tệp và dữ liệu khỏi Supabase...")

            val photoId = photo.id
            if (photoId.isBlank()) {
                _deleteState.value = DeleteState.Error("ID ảnh không hợp lệ.")
                return@launch
            }

            val fileName = photo.storagePath.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
                ?: storageRepository.objectPathFromPublicUrl(photo.imageUrl)

            var storageError: String? = null
            var databaseError: String? = null

            // 1. Delete physical file from Supabase Storage ('photos_bucket')
            if (fileName.isNotBlank()) {
                val storageResult = storageRepository.deleteImage(fileName)
                if (storageResult is StorageRepository.Result.Failure) {
                    storageError = storageResult.message
                }
            }

            // 2. Delete metadata record from Supabase 'photos' database table
            try {
                photoRepository.deletePhoto(photoId)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                databaseError = e.localizedMessage ?: "Lỗi xóa dữ liệu trên Database"
            }

            // Report result to UI
            if (databaseError != null) {
                _deleteState.value = DeleteState.Error("Lỗi xóa cơ sở dữ liệu: $databaseError")
            } else if (storageError != null) {
                _deleteState.value = DeleteState.Success(photoId, "Đã xóa bản ghi dữ liệu (Lưu ý Storage: $storageError)")
            } else {
                _deleteState.value = DeleteState.Success(photoId, "Đã xóa hoàn toàn tệp và dữ liệu ảnh khỏi Supabase!")
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Overload accepting photoId and fileName directly.
     */
    fun deletePhoto(photoId: String, fileName: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _deleteState.value = DeleteState.Progress("Đang xóa ảnh khỏi Supabase...")

            // 1. Delete physical file on Supabase Storage
            val storageResult = storageRepository.deleteImage(fileName)

            // 2. Delete record from Supabase 'photos' database table
            try {
                photoRepository.deletePhoto(photoId)
                if (storageResult is StorageRepository.Result.Failure) {
                    _deleteState.value = DeleteState.Success(photoId, "Đã xóa bản ghi cơ sở dữ liệu.")
                } else {
                    _deleteState.value = DeleteState.Success(photoId, "Xóa ảnh khỏi Supabase thành công!")
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _deleteState.value = DeleteState.Error("Lỗi xóa bản ghi Database: ${e.localizedMessage}")
            }
        }
    }

    // --- Java Async Callback Helpers ---

    fun deletePhotoAsync(photo: Photo, callback: DeleteCallback) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            deletePhoto(photo)
            when (val state = _deleteState.value) {
                is DeleteState.Success -> {
                    withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                        callback.onSuccess(state.photoId)
                    }
                }
                is DeleteState.Error -> {
                    withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                        callback.onError(state.error)
                    }
                }
                else -> {}
            }
        }
    }
}


PhotoUploadViewModel.kt
package com.example.th6.viewmodels

import android.content.Context
import android.net.Uri
import androidx.lifecycle.LiveData
import androidx.lifecycle.MutableLiveData
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.th6.data.AuthRepository
import com.example.th6.data.PhotoRepository
import com.example.th6.data.StorageRepository
import com.example.th6.models.Photo
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.util.UUID

class PhotoUploadViewModel(
    private val storageRepository: StorageRepository = StorageRepository(),
    private val photoRepository: PhotoRepository = PhotoRepository(),
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository = AuthRepository()
) : ViewModel() {

    sealed class UploadState {
        object Idle : UploadState()
        data class Progress(val message: String) : UploadState()
        data class Success(val photo: Photo, val message: String) : UploadState()
        data class Error(val error: String) : UploadState()
    }

    private val _uploadState = MutableLiveData<UploadState>(UploadState.Idle)
    val uploadState: LiveData<UploadState> get() = _uploadState

    interface UploadCallback {
        fun onSuccess(photo: Photo)
        fun onError(error: String)
    }

    /**
     * Uploads selected image Uri to Supabase Storage, retrieves public URL,
     * creates Photo metadata object and inserts record into Supabase 'photos' table.
     * Completely removes legacy ImgBB / Firestore calls.
     */
    fun uploadSelectedImage(context: Context, uri: Uri, customName: String? = null) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uploadState.value = UploadState.Progress("Đang tải ảnh lên Supabase Storage...")

            val currentUserId = authRepository.getCurrentUserUid()
            if (currentUserId.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                _uploadState.value = UploadState.Error("Người dùng chưa đăng nhập. Vui lòng đăng nhập lại.")
                return@launch
            }

            val fileName = customName?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
                ?: "photo_${System.currentTimeMillis()}_${UUID.randomUUID().toString().take(6)}.jpg"

            // 1. Upload image to Supabase Storage ('photos_bucket')
            val storageResult = storageRepository.uploadImage(context, uri, fileName)
            if (storageResult is StorageRepository.Result.Failure) {
                _uploadState.value = UploadState.Error("Lỗi upload Supabase Storage: ${storageResult.message}")
                return@launch
            }

            // 3. Create Photo metadata object
            val photo = Photo(
                id = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
                ownerUid = currentUserId,
                name = fileName,
                imageUrl = storageRepository.getImageUrl(fileName),
                displayUrl = storageRepository.getImageUrl(fileName),
                createdAt = System.currentTimeMillis(),
                localMediaUri = uri.toString(),
                storageProvider = "supabase",
                storagePath = fileName
            )

            // 4. Insert photo record into Supabase 'photos' database table
            try {
                photoRepository.insertPhoto(photo)
                _uploadState.value = UploadState.Success(photo, "Tải ảnh và lưu metadata thành công!")
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _uploadState.value = UploadState.Error("Lỗi lưu metadata vào Supabase Database: ${e.localizedMessage}")
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Overload for uploading raw byte array to Supabase.
     */
    fun uploadSelectedImageBytes(byteArray: ByteArray, fileName: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uploadState.value = UploadState.Progress("Đang tải tệp ảnh lên Supabase Storage...")

            val currentUserId = authRepository.getCurrentUserUid()
            if (currentUserId.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                _uploadState.value = UploadState.Error("Người dùng chưa đăng nhập.")
                return@launch
            }

            // 1. Upload byte array to Supabase Storage
            val storageResult = storageRepository.uploadImage(byteArray, fileName)
            if (storageResult is StorageRepository.Result.Failure) {
                _uploadState.value = UploadState.Error("Lỗi upload Supabase Storage: ${storageResult.message}")
                return@launch
            }

            // 3. Create Photo metadata object
            val photo = Photo(
                id = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
                ownerUid = currentUserId,
                name = fileName,
                imageUrl = storageRepository.getImageUrl(fileName),
                displayUrl = storageRepository.getImageUrl(fileName),
                createdAt = System.currentTimeMillis(),
                storageProvider = "supabase",
                storagePath = fileName
            )

            // 4. Insert photo record into Supabase 'photos' database table
            try {
                photoRepository.insertPhoto(photo)
                _uploadState.value = UploadState.Success(photo, "Tải ảnh thành công!")
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _uploadState.value = UploadState.Error("Lỗi lưu metadata vào Database: ${e.localizedMessage}")
            }
        }
    }

    // --- Java Async Callback Helpers ---

    fun uploadSelectedImageAsync(context: Context, uri: Uri, customName: String?, callback: UploadCallback) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            uploadSelectedImage(context, uri, customName)
            when (val state = _uploadState.value) {
                is UploadState.Success -> {
                    withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                        callback.onSuccess(state.photo)
                    }
                }
                is UploadState.Error -> {
                    withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                        callback.onError(state.error)
                    }
                }
                else -> {}
            }
        }
    }
}


CropOverlayView.java
package com.example.th6.views;

import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.Path;
import android.graphics.Rect;
import android.graphics.RectF;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.ImageView;

import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

public class CropOverlayView extends View {

    private static final int HANDLE_NONE = 0;
    private static final int HANDLE_TOP_LEFT = 1;
    private static final int HANDLE_TOP_RIGHT = 2;
    private static final int HANDLE_BOTTOM_LEFT = 3;
    private static final int HANDLE_BOTTOM_RIGHT = 4;
    private static final int HANDLE_TOP = 5;
    private static final int HANDLE_BOTTOM = 6;
    private static final int HANDLE_LEFT = 7;
    private static final int HANDLE_RIGHT = 8;
    private static final int HANDLE_CENTER = 9;

    private static final float HANDLE_RADIUS = 28f;
    private static final float TOUCH_TOLERANCE = 48f;
    private static final float MIN_CROP_SIZE = 100f;

    private final RectF cropRect = new RectF();
    private final RectF imageBounds = new RectF();

    private final Paint dimPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint borderPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint gridPaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final Paint handlePaint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);

    private int activeHandle = HANDLE_NONE;
    private float lastTouchX;
    private float lastTouchY;

    public CropOverlayView(Context context) {
        super(context);
        init();
    }

    public CropOverlayView(Context context, @Nullable AttributeSet attrs) {
        super(context, attrs);
        init();
    }

    private void init() {
        dimPaint.setColor(Color.parseColor("#B3000000"));
        dimPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);

        borderPaint.setColor(Color.WHITE);
        borderPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE);
        borderPaint.setStrokeWidth(4f);

        gridPaint.setColor(Color.parseColor("#80FFFFFF"));
        gridPaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE);
        gridPaint.setStrokeWidth(2f);

        handlePaint.setColor(Color.WHITE);
        handlePaint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);
    }

    public void setImageBounds(RectF bounds) {
        if (bounds == null || bounds.isEmpty()) return;
        RectF oldBounds = new RectF(imageBounds);
        RectF oldCrop = new RectF(cropRect);
        this.imageBounds.set(bounds);
        if (oldBounds.isEmpty() || oldCrop.isEmpty()) {
            setDefaultCropRect(bounds);
        } else {
            // Keep the selection attached to the image when its preview is zoomed or panned.
            float left = (oldCrop.left - oldBounds.left) / oldBounds.width();
            float top = (oldCrop.top - oldBounds.top) / oldBounds.height();
            float right = (oldCrop.right - oldBounds.left) / oldBounds.width();
            float bottom = (oldCrop.bottom - oldBounds.top) / oldBounds.height();
            cropRect.set(bounds.left + left * bounds.width(), bounds.top + top * bounds.height(),
                    bounds.left + right * bounds.width(), bounds.top + bottom * bounds.height());
            cropRect.intersect(bounds);
            if (cropRect.width() < MIN_CROP_SIZE || cropRect.height() < MIN_CROP_SIZE) setDefaultCropRect(bounds);
        }
        invalidate();
    }

    private void setDefaultCropRect(RectF bounds) {
        float insetX = bounds.width() * 0.05f;
        float insetY = bounds.height() * 0.05f;
        cropRect.set(bounds.left + insetX, bounds.top + insetY, bounds.right - insetX, bounds.bottom - insetY);
    }

    public void resetCropRect() {
        if (!imageBounds.isEmpty()) {
            setDefaultCropRect(imageBounds);
            invalidate();
        }
    }

    public RectF getCropRect() {
        return cropRect;
    }

    public Rect getCroppedBitmapArea(Bitmap bitmap, ImageView imageView) {
        if (bitmap == null || imageView == null || imageBounds.isEmpty() || cropRect.isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }

        android.graphics.drawable.Drawable drawable = imageView.getDrawable();
        if (drawable == null || drawable.getIntrinsicWidth() <= 0 || drawable.getIntrinsicHeight() <= 0) return null;
        android.graphics.Matrix inverse = new android.graphics.Matrix();
        if (!imageView.getImageMatrix().invert(inverse)) return null;
        float[] points = { cropRect.left, cropRect.top, cropRect.right, cropRect.top,
                cropRect.left, cropRect.bottom, cropRect.right, cropRect.bottom };
        inverse.mapPoints(points);
        float minX = Math.min(Math.min(points[0], points[2]), Math.min(points[4], points[6]));
        float maxX = Math.max(Math.max(points[0], points[2]), Math.max(points[4], points[6]));
        float minY = Math.min(Math.min(points[1], points[3]), Math.min(points[5], points[7]));
        float maxY = Math.max(Math.max(points[1], points[3]), Math.max(points[5], points[7]));
        float toBitmapX = (float) bitmap.getWidth() / drawable.getIntrinsicWidth();
        float toBitmapY = (float) bitmap.getHeight() / drawable.getIntrinsicHeight();
        int left = Math.max(0, (int) Math.floor(minX * toBitmapX));
        int top = Math.max(0, (int) Math.floor(minY * toBitmapY));
        int right = Math.min(bitmap.getWidth(), (int) Math.ceil(maxX * toBitmapX));
        int bottom = Math.min(bitmap.getHeight(), (int) Math.ceil(maxY * toBitmapY));
        if (right <= left || bottom <= top) return null;
        return new Rect(left, top, right, bottom);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDraw(Canvas canvas) {
        super.onDraw(canvas);
        if (cropRect.isEmpty()) return;

        // 1. Draw Dim Overlay outside cropRect
        canvas.drawRect(imageBounds.left, imageBounds.top, imageBounds.right, cropRect.top, dimPaint);
        canvas.drawRect(imageBounds.left, cropRect.top, cropRect.left, cropRect.bottom, dimPaint);
        canvas.drawRect(cropRect.right, cropRect.top, imageBounds.right, cropRect.bottom, dimPaint);
        canvas.drawRect(imageBounds.left, cropRect.bottom, imageBounds.right, imageBounds.bottom, dimPaint);

        // 2. Draw Crop Border
        canvas.drawRect(cropRect, borderPaint);

        // 3. Draw 3x3 Grid
        float colWidth = cropRect.width() / 3f;
        float rowHeight = cropRect.height() / 3f;

        canvas.drawLine(cropRect.left + colWidth, cropRect.top, cropRect.left + colWidth, cropRect.bottom, gridPaint);
        canvas.drawLine(cropRect.left + 2 * colWidth, cropRect.top, cropRect.left + 2 * colWidth, cropRect.bottom, gridPaint);
        canvas.drawLine(cropRect.left, cropRect.top + rowHeight, cropRect.right, cropRect.top + rowHeight, gridPaint);
        canvas.drawLine(cropRect.left, cropRect.top + 2 * rowHeight, cropRect.right, cropRect.top + 2 * rowHeight, gridPaint);

        // 4. Draw Handles (4 Corners)
        canvas.drawCircle(cropRect.left, cropRect.top, HANDLE_RADIUS, handlePaint);
        canvas.drawCircle(cropRect.right, cropRect.top, HANDLE_RADIUS, handlePaint);
        canvas.drawCircle(cropRect.left, cropRect.bottom, HANDLE_RADIUS, handlePaint);
        canvas.drawCircle(cropRect.right, cropRect.bottom, HANDLE_RADIUS, handlePaint);

        // 4 Mid-edges
        canvas.drawCircle(cropRect.centerX(), cropRect.top, HANDLE_RADIUS * 0.8f, handlePaint);
        canvas.drawCircle(cropRect.centerX(), cropRect.bottom, HANDLE_RADIUS * 0.8f, handlePaint);
        canvas.drawCircle(cropRect.left, cropRect.centerY(), HANDLE_RADIUS * 0.8f, handlePaint);
        canvas.drawCircle(cropRect.right, cropRect.centerY(), HANDLE_RADIUS * 0.8f, handlePaint);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onTouchEvent(MotionEvent event) {
        if (event.getPointerCount() > 1) {
            activeHandle = HANDLE_NONE;
            return true;
        }
        float x = event.getX();
        float y = event.getY();

        switch (event.getAction()) {
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                activeHandle = getTouchedHandle(x, y);
                lastTouchX = x;
                lastTouchY = y;
                return activeHandle != HANDLE_NONE;

            case MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE:
                if (activeHandle != HANDLE_NONE) {
                    float dx = x - lastTouchX;
                    float dy = y - lastTouchY;
                    moveHandle(activeHandle, dx, dy);
                    lastTouchX = x;
                    lastTouchY = y;
                    invalidate();
                    return true;
                }
                break;

            case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                activeHandle = HANDLE_NONE;
                break;
        }

        return super.onTouchEvent(event);
    }

    private int getTouchedHandle(float x, float y) {
        if (isNear(x, y, cropRect.left, cropRect.top)) return HANDLE_TOP_LEFT;
        if (isNear(x, y, cropRect.right, cropRect.top)) return HANDLE_TOP_RIGHT;
        if (isNear(x, y, cropRect.left, cropRect.bottom)) return HANDLE_BOTTOM_LEFT;
        if (isNear(x, y, cropRect.right, cropRect.bottom)) return HANDLE_BOTTOM_RIGHT;

        if (isNear(x, y, cropRect.centerX(), cropRect.top)) return HANDLE_TOP;
        if (isNear(x, y, cropRect.centerX(), cropRect.bottom)) return HANDLE_BOTTOM;
        if (isNear(x, y, cropRect.left, cropRect.centerY())) return HANDLE_LEFT;
        if (isNear(x, y, cropRect.right, cropRect.centerY())) return HANDLE_RIGHT;

        if (cropRect.contains(x, y)) return HANDLE_CENTER;

        return HANDLE_NONE;
    }

    private boolean isNear(float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2) {
        return Math.hypot(x1 - x2, y1 - y2) <= TOUCH_TOLERANCE;
    }

    private void moveHandle(int handle, float dx, float dy) {
        switch (handle) {
            case HANDLE_TOP_LEFT:
                cropRect.left = Math.min(cropRect.right - MIN_CROP_SIZE, Math.max(imageBounds.left, cropRect.left + dx));
                cropRect.top = Math.min(cropRect.bottom - MIN_CROP_SIZE, Math.max(imageBounds.top, cropRect.top + dy));
                break;

            case HANDLE_TOP_RIGHT:
                cropRect.right = Math.max(cropRect.left + MIN_CROP_SIZE, Math.min(imageBounds.right, cropRect.right + dx));
                cropRect.top = Math.min(cropRect.bottom - MIN_CROP_SIZE, Math.max(imageBounds.top, cropRect.top + dy));
                break;

            case HANDLE_BOTTOM_LEFT:
                cropRect.left = Math.min(cropRect.right - MIN_CROP_SIZE, Math.max(imageBounds.left, cropRect.left + dx));
                cropRect.bottom = Math.max(cropRect.top + MIN_CROP_SIZE, Math.min(imageBounds.bottom, cropRect.bottom + dy));
                break;

            case HANDLE_BOTTOM_RIGHT:
                cropRect.right = Math.max(cropRect.left + MIN_CROP_SIZE, Math.min(imageBounds.right, cropRect.right + dx));
                cropRect.bottom = Math.max(cropRect.top + MIN_CROP_SIZE, Math.min(imageBounds.bottom, cropRect.bottom + dy));
                break;

            case HANDLE_TOP:
                cropRect.top = Math.min(cropRect.bottom - MIN_CROP_SIZE, Math.max(imageBounds.top, cropRect.top + dy));
                break;

            case HANDLE_BOTTOM:
                cropRect.bottom = Math.max(cropRect.top + MIN_CROP_SIZE, Math.min(imageBounds.bottom, cropRect.bottom + dy));
                break;

            case HANDLE_LEFT:
                cropRect.left = Math.min(cropRect.right - MIN_CROP_SIZE, Math.max(imageBounds.left, cropRect.left + dx));
                break;

            case HANDLE_RIGHT:
                cropRect.right = Math.max(cropRect.left + MIN_CROP_SIZE, Math.min(imageBounds.right, cropRect.right + dx));
                break;

            case HANDLE_CENTER:
                if (cropRect.left + dx >= imageBounds.left && cropRect.right + dx <= imageBounds.right) {
                    cropRect.left += dx;
                    cropRect.right += dx;
                }
                if (cropRect.top + dy >= imageBounds.top && cropRect.bottom + dy <= imageBounds.bottom) {
                    cropRect.top += dy;
                    cropRect.bottom += dy;
                }
                break;
        }
    }
}


DrawingOverlayView.java
package com.example.th6.views;

import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.Path;
import android.graphics.RectF;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;

import androidx.annotation.Nullable;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class DrawingOverlayView extends View {
    public interface StrokeListener {
        void onStrokeStarted();
        void onStrokeFinished();
    }

    public static class StrokeData {
        public final float[] points;
        public final int color;
        public final float normalizedWidth;
        public final boolean erase;
        public StrokeData(float[] points, int color, float normalizedWidth, boolean erase) {
            this.points = points.clone(); this.color = color; this.normalizedWidth = normalizedWidth;
            this.erase = erase;
        }
        public StrokeData copy() { return new StrokeData(points, color, normalizedWidth, erase); }
    }

    private static class PathItem {
        final Path path; final int color; final float width; final boolean erase;
        PathItem(Path path, int color, float width, boolean erase) { this.path = path; this.color = color; this.width = width; this.erase = erase; }
    }

    private final List<PathItem> visiblePaths = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<StrokeData> strokes = new ArrayList<>();
    private final RectF imageBounds = new RectF();
    private final List<Float> currentPoints = new ArrayList<>();
    private Path currentPath;
    private int currentColor = Color.RED;
    private boolean eraser;
    private float currentWidth = 10f;
    private StrokeListener strokeListener;

    public DrawingOverlayView(Context context) { super(context); }
    public DrawingOverlayView(Context context, @Nullable AttributeSet attrs) { super(context, attrs); }

    public void setStrokeListener(@Nullable StrokeListener listener) { strokeListener = listener; }

    public void setImageBounds(RectF bounds) {
        if (bounds != null && !imageBounds.equals(bounds)) {
            imageBounds.set(bounds);
            rebuildVisiblePaths();
        }
    }

    public void setPenColor(int color) { currentColor = color; }
    public void setEraser(boolean enabled) { eraser = enabled; invalidate(); }
    public void setPenWidth(float width) { currentWidth = Math.max(1f, width); }
    public boolean hasPaths() { return !strokes.isEmpty() || currentPath != null; }

    public List<StrokeData> getStrokes() {
        List<StrokeData> result = new ArrayList<>();
        for (StrokeData stroke : strokes) result.add(stroke.copy());
        return result;
    }

    public void setStrokes(List<StrokeData> values) {
        strokes.clear();
        if (values != null) for (StrokeData stroke : values) strokes.add(stroke.copy());
        rebuildVisiblePaths();
    }

    public void undo() {
        if (!strokes.isEmpty()) { strokes.remove(strokes.size() - 1); rebuildVisiblePaths(); }
    }

    public void clear() {
        strokes.clear(); visiblePaths.clear(); currentPath = null; currentPoints.clear(); invalidate();
    }

    public void renderOntoBitmap(Bitmap target) {
        if (target == null || strokes.isEmpty()) return;
        Canvas canvas = new Canvas(target);
        for (StrokeData stroke : strokes) {
            Path path = createPath(stroke.points, target.getWidth(), target.getHeight());
            Paint paint = createPaint(stroke.color, stroke.normalizedWidth * target.getWidth());
            if (stroke.erase) paint.setXfermode(new android.graphics.PorterDuffXfermode(android.graphics.PorterDuff.Mode.CLEAR));
            canvas.drawPath(path, paint);
        }
    }

    private void rebuildVisiblePaths() {
        visiblePaths.clear();
        if (imageBounds.isEmpty()) { invalidate(); return; }
        for (StrokeData stroke : strokes) {
            Path path = createPath(stroke.points, imageBounds.width(), imageBounds.height());
            android.graphics.Matrix matrix = new android.graphics.Matrix();
            matrix.setScale(imageBounds.width(), imageBounds.height());
            matrix.postTranslate(imageBounds.left, imageBounds.top);
            path.transform(matrix);
            visiblePaths.add(new PathItem(path, stroke.color, stroke.normalizedWidth * imageBounds.width(), stroke.erase));
        }
        invalidate();
    }

    private Path createPath(float[] points, float width, float height) {
        Path path = new Path();
        if (points.length < 2) return path;
        path.moveTo(points[0] * width, points[1] * height);
        for (int i = 2; i + 1 < points.length; i += 2) path.lineTo(points[i] * width, points[i + 1] * height);
        return path;
    }

    private Paint createPaint(int color, float width) {
        Paint paint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
        paint.setColor(color); paint.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE); paint.setStrokeWidth(width);
        paint.setStrokeCap(Paint.Cap.ROUND); paint.setStrokeJoin(Paint.Join.ROUND);
        return paint;
    }

    @Override protected void onDraw(Canvas canvas) {
        super.onDraw(canvas);
        for (PathItem item : visiblePaths) {
            Paint paint = createPaint(item.color, item.width);
            if (item.erase) paint.setXfermode(new android.graphics.PorterDuffXfermode(android.graphics.PorterDuff.Mode.CLEAR));
            canvas.drawPath(item.path, paint);
        }
        if (currentPath != null) {
            Paint paint = createPaint(currentColor, currentWidth);
            if (eraser) paint.setColor(Color.GRAY);
            canvas.drawPath(currentPath, paint);
        }
    }

    @Override public boolean onTouchEvent(MotionEvent event) {
        if (event.getPointerCount() > 1) {
            currentPath = null;
            currentPoints.clear();
            invalidate();
            return true;
        }
        float x = event.getX(), y = event.getY();
        switch (event.getActionMasked()) {
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN:
                if (!imageBounds.isEmpty() && !imageBounds.contains(x, y)) return false;
                if (strokeListener != null) strokeListener.onStrokeStarted();
                currentPath = new Path(); currentPath.moveTo(x, y); currentPoints.clear(); addNormalizedPoint(x, y);
                invalidate(); return true;
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE:
                if (currentPath != null) {
                    currentPath.lineTo(x, y); addNormalizedPoint(x, y); invalidate(); return true;
                }
                return false;
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_UP:
                if (currentPath != null) {
                    currentPath.lineTo(x, y); addNormalizedPoint(x, y);
                    float[] points = new float[currentPoints.size()];
                    for (int i = 0; i < currentPoints.size(); i++) points[i] = currentPoints.get(i);
                    float normalizedWidth = imageBounds.isEmpty() ? 0.005f : currentWidth / imageBounds.width();
                    strokes.add(new StrokeData(points, currentColor, normalizedWidth, eraser));
                    currentPath = null; currentPoints.clear(); rebuildVisiblePaths();
                    if (strokeListener != null) strokeListener.onStrokeFinished();
                    return true;
                }
                return false;
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL:
                currentPath = null; currentPoints.clear(); invalidate(); return true;
            default: return true;
        }
    }

    private void addNormalizedPoint(float x, float y) {
        if (imageBounds.isEmpty()) return;
        currentPoints.add(Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, (x - imageBounds.left) / imageBounds.width())));
        currentPoints.add(Math.max(0f, Math.min(1f, (y - imageBounds.top) / imageBounds.height())));
    }
}


VideoTrimTimelineView.java
package com.example.th6.views;

import android.content.Context;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.graphics.Paint;
import android.graphics.RectF;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.util.AttributeSet;
import android.util.TypedValue;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/** Thumbnail-backed trim timeline with start/end handles and a draggable playhead. */
public class VideoTrimTimelineView extends View {
    public interface Listener { void onRangeChanged(long startMs, long endMs); void onPlayheadChanged(long positionMs); }
    private final Paint paint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final List<Drawable> frames = new ArrayList<>();
    private long durationMs = 1, startMs, endMs = 1, playheadMs;
    private float left, right, top, bottom;
    private int active;
    private Listener listener;
    private final float density;
    private int surfaceColor, primaryColor, onSurfaceColor, shadeColor;
    public VideoTrimTimelineView(Context c, AttributeSet a) { super(c,a); density=getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density; setMinimumHeight((int)(76*density)); }
    public void setListener(Listener l) { listener=l; }
    public void setDuration(long d) { durationMs=Math.max(1,d); startMs=0; endMs=durationMs; invalidate(); }
    public void setRange(long s,long e) { startMs=Math.max(0,Math.min(s,durationMs)); endMs=Math.max(startMs,Math.min(e,durationMs)); invalidate(); }
    public void setPlayhead(long p) { playheadMs=Math.max(0,Math.min(p,durationMs)); invalidate(); }
    public void setFrames(List<Drawable> values) { frames.clear(); if(values!=null)frames.addAll(values); invalidate(); }
    private int resolveColor(int attr, int fallback) { TypedValue value=new TypedValue(); return getContext().getTheme().resolveAttribute(attr,value,true) ? (value.resourceId!=0 ? getResources().getColor(value.resourceId,getContext().getTheme()) : value.data) : fallback; }
    @Override protected void onDraw(Canvas c) { super.onDraw(c); surfaceColor=resolveColor(com.google.android.material.R.attr.colorSurface,Color.rgb(48,38,42)); primaryColor=resolveColor(androidx.appcompat.R.attr.colorPrimary,Color.rgb(221,157,119)); onSurfaceColor=resolveColor(com.google.android.material.R.attr.colorOnSurface,Color.WHITE); shadeColor=resolveColor(com.google.android.material.R.attr.colorOnSurface,Color.BLACK); float pad=14*density; left=pad; right=getWidth()-pad; top=10*density; bottom=getHeight()-10*density; float w=right-left;
      paint.setColor(surfaceColor); c.drawRoundRect(left,top,right,bottom,8*density,8*density,paint);
      if(!frames.isEmpty()){ float fw=w/frames.size(); for(int i=0;i<frames.size();i++){ Drawable d=frames.get(i); if(d!=null){int x=(int)(left+i*fw); d.setBounds(x,(int)top,(int)Math.ceil(x+fw+1),(int)bottom); d.draw(c);} } }
      float sx=x(startMs), ex=x(endMs), px=x(playheadMs);
      paint.setColor((shadeColor & 0x00ffffff) | 0x99000000); c.drawRect(left,top,sx,bottom,paint); c.drawRect(ex,top,right,bottom,paint);
      paint.setColor(primaryColor); paint.setStyle(Paint.Style.STROKE); paint.setStrokeWidth(3*density); c.drawRoundRect(new RectF(sx,top,ex,bottom),6*density,6*density,paint); paint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);
      paint.setColor(onSurfaceColor); c.drawRoundRect(sx-5*density,top-3*density,sx+7*density,bottom+3*density,4*density,4*density,paint); c.drawRoundRect(ex-7*density,top-3*density,ex+5*density,bottom+3*density,4*density,4*density,paint);
      paint.setColor(primaryColor); paint.setStrokeWidth(2*density); c.drawLine(px,top-5*density,px,bottom+5*density,paint);
    }
    private float x(long ms){return left+(right-left)*Math.max(0,Math.min(1,ms/(float)durationMs));}
    private long time(float x){return Math.round(Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(x-left)/(right-left)))*durationMs);}
    @Override public boolean onTouchEvent(MotionEvent e){float x=e.getX(); if(e.getAction()==MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN){float sx=x(startMs),ex=x(endMs),px=x(playheadMs); if(Math.abs(x-sx)<28*density)active=1; else if(Math.abs(x-ex)<28*density)active=2; else if(Math.abs(x-px)<24*density)active=3; else active=3; getParent().requestDisallowInterceptTouchEvent(true); move(x); return true;} if(e.getAction()==MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE){move(x);return true;} if(e.getAction()==MotionEvent.ACTION_UP||e.getAction()==MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL){active=0; performClick();return true;} return true; }
    private void move(float x){long p=time(x); if(active==1)startMs=Math.min(p,Math.max(0,endMs-500)); else if(active==2)endMs=Math.max(p,Math.min(durationMs,startMs+500)); else playheadMs=p; invalidate(); if(listener!=null){if(active==3)listener.onPlayheadChanged(playheadMs);else listener.onRangeChanged(startMs,endMs);} }
    @Override public boolean performClick(){super.performClick();return true;}
}

CloudStorageUsageTest.java
package com.example.th6.utils;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertThrows;

import org.junit.Test;

import java.util.Locale;

public class CloudStorageUsageTest {
    private static final long BYTES_PER_MB = 1024L * 1024L;

    @Test public void zeroUsageShowsZeroPercentAndFullRemaining() {
        CloudStorageUsage usage = CloudStorageUsage.fromBytes(0L);

        assertEquals(0.0d, usage.usedPercent, 0.0d);
        assertEquals("0%", usage.percentText);
        assertEquals("1024 MB", usage.remainingAmount);
        assertEquals(0, usage.progress);
    }

    @Test public void formatsNinePointFourFourMb() {
        Locale previous = Locale.getDefault();
        Locale.setDefault(Locale.US);
        try {
            CloudStorageUsage usage = CloudStorageUsage.fromBytes(Math.round(9.44d * BYTES_PER_MB));
            assertEquals("9.44 MB", usage.usedAmount);
            assertEquals("0.92%", usage.percentText);
            assertEquals("1014.56 MB", usage.remainingAmount);
            assertEquals(92, usage.progress);
        } finally {
            Locale.setDefault(previous);
        }
    }

    @Test public void halfQuotaShowsFiftyPercent() {
        CloudStorageUsage usage = CloudStorageUsage.fromBytes(512L * BYTES_PER_MB);

        assertEquals("512 MB", usage.usedAmount);
        assertEquals("50%", usage.percentText);
        assertEquals("512 MB", usage.remainingAmount);
        assertEquals(5000, usage.progress);
    }

    @Test public void fullQuotaShowsOneHundredPercent() {
        CloudStorageUsage usage = CloudStorageUsage.fromBytes(1024L * BYTES_PER_MB);

        assertEquals(100.0d, usage.usedPercent, 0.0d);
        assertEquals("100%", usage.percentText);
        assertEquals("0 MB", usage.remainingAmount);
        assertEquals(10000, usage.progress);
    }

    @Test public void overQuotaKeepsPercentageButCapsProgressAndRemaining() {
        CloudStorageUsage usage = CloudStorageUsage.fromBytes(2L * 1024L * BYTES_PER_MB);

        assertEquals(200.0d, usage.usedPercent, 0.0d);
        assertEquals("200%", usage.percentText);
        assertEquals("0 MB", usage.remainingAmount);
        assertEquals(10000, usage.progress);
    }

    @Test public void negativeByteCountIsRejected() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> CloudStorageUsage.fromBytes(-1L));
    }

}


MediaTimelineUtilsTest.java
package com.example.th6.utils;

import com.example.th6.R;
import org.junit.Test;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;

public class MediaTimelineUtilsTest {
    private static final class Item {
        final String name; final long time; final boolean video;
        Item(String name,long time,boolean video){this.name=name;this.time=time;this.video=video;}
    }

    private final List<Item> source=Arrays.asList(
            new Item("z-video",timestamp(2026,1,1),true),
            new Item("b-photo",timestamp(2025,2,1),false),
            new Item("a-photo",timestamp(2025,1,1),false));

    private List<Item> query(int filter,int mode,int sort) {
        return MediaTimelineUtils.filterAndSort(source,filter,mode,sort,item->item.time,item->item.name,item->item.video);
    }

    @Test public void mediaTypeFilterKeepsOnlyRequestedType() {
        assertEquals(Arrays.asList("b-photo","a-photo"),names(query(MediaTimelineUtils.FILTER_IMAGES,PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_ALL,R.id.sort_date_desc)));
        assertEquals(Arrays.asList("z-video"),names(query(MediaTimelineUtils.FILTER_VIDEOS,PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_ALL,R.id.sort_date_desc)));
        assertEquals(3,query(MediaTimelineUtils.FILTER_ALL,PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_ALL,R.id.sort_date_desc).size());
    }

    @Test public void dateAndNameSortAreAppliedAfterFiltering() {
        assertEquals(Arrays.asList("a-photo","b-photo","z-video"),names(query(MediaTimelineUtils.FILTER_ALL,PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_ALL,R.id.sort_date_asc)));
        assertEquals(Arrays.asList("a-photo","b-photo"),names(query(MediaTimelineUtils.FILTER_IMAGES,PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_ALL,R.id.sort_name_asc)));
        assertEquals(Arrays.asList("b-photo","a-photo"),names(query(MediaTimelineUtils.FILTER_IMAGES,PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_ALL,R.id.sort_name_desc)));
    }

    @Test public void groupedNameSortKeepsTimeGroupsNewestFirst() {
        List<Item> sorted=query(MediaTimelineUtils.FILTER_ALL,PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_YEARS,R.id.sort_name_asc);
        assertEquals("z-video",sorted.get(0).name);
        assertEquals("a-photo",sorted.get(1).name);
        assertEquals("b-photo",sorted.get(2).name);
    }

    private List<String> names(List<Item> items) {
        java.util.ArrayList<String> names=new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        for(Item item:items) names.add(item.name);
        return names;
    }

    private static long timestamp(int year,int month,int day) {
        java.util.Calendar calendar=java.util.Calendar.getInstance();
        calendar.clear(); calendar.set(year,month-1,day,12,0,0);
        return calendar.getTimeInMillis();
    }
}


PhotoTimelineUtilsTest.java
package com.example.th6.utils;

import org.junit.Test;

import java.util.Calendar;

import static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals;

public class PhotoTimelineUtilsTest {
    private long timestamp(int year, int month, int day) {
        Calendar calendar = Calendar.getInstance();
        calendar.clear();
        calendar.set(year, month - 1, day, 12, 0, 0);
        return calendar.getTimeInMillis();
    }

    @Test
    public void dayGroupsUseCalendarDate() {
        long morning = timestamp(2026, 10, 15);
        long sameDay = timestamp(2026, 10, 15) + 60 * 60 * 1000L;
        long nextDay = timestamp(2026, 10, 16);

        assertEquals(PhotoTimelineUtils.getGroupKey(morning, PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_DAYS),
                PhotoTimelineUtils.getGroupKey(sameDay, PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_DAYS));
        assertNotEquals(PhotoTimelineUtils.getGroupKey(morning, PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_DAYS),
                PhotoTimelineUtils.getGroupKey(nextDay, PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_DAYS));
    }

    @Test
    public void monthGroupsKeepYearInTheKey() {
        long october2025 = timestamp(2025, 10, 1);
        long october2026 = timestamp(2026, 10, 1);

        assertNotEquals(PhotoTimelineUtils.getGroupKey(october2025, PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_MONTHS),
                PhotoTimelineUtils.getGroupKey(october2026, PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_MONTHS));
        assertEquals(PhotoTimelineUtils.getGroupKey(timestamp(2026, 10, 1), PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_MONTHS),
                PhotoTimelineUtils.getGroupKey(timestamp(2026, 10, 31), PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_MONTHS));
    }

    @Test
    public void yearGroupsSeparateYearsAndCombineMonths() {
        assertEquals(PhotoTimelineUtils.getGroupKey(timestamp(2026, 1, 2), PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_YEARS),
                PhotoTimelineUtils.getGroupKey(timestamp(2026, 12, 31), PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_YEARS));
        assertNotEquals(PhotoTimelineUtils.getGroupKey(timestamp(2025, 12, 31), PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_YEARS),
                PhotoTimelineUtils.getGroupKey(timestamp(2026, 1, 1), PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_YEARS));
    }

    @Test
    public void missingTimestampHasStableUnknownGroup() {
        assertEquals("unknown", PhotoTimelineUtils.getGroupKey(0, PhotoTimelineUtils.VIEW_MODE_DAYS));
    }
}


SmartCleanupImageAnalyzerTest.java
package com.example.th6.utils;

import org.junit.Test;

import static org.junit.Assert.*;

public class SmartCleanupImageAnalyzerTest {
    @Test public void exactPerceptualMatchRequiresStrongStructureAgreement() {
        assertTrue(SmartCleanupImageAnalyzer.isDuplicate(0L, 0L, 0.99));
        assertFalse(SmartCleanupImageAnalyzer.isDuplicate(0L, 0L, 0.80));
    }

    @Test public void similarClassificationIsSeparateFromDuplicateClassification() {
        long base = 0L;
        long near = (1L << 5) | (1L << 8) | (1L << 13) | (1L << 24) | (1L << 40);
        assertTrue(SmartCleanupImageAnalyzer.isSimilar(base, near, 0.90));
        assertFalse(SmartCleanupImageAnalyzer.isDuplicate(base, near, 0.99));
        assertFalse(SmartCleanupImageAnalyzer.isSimilar(base, near, 0.70));
    }

    @Test public void identicalByteHashRemainsZeroDistance() {
        assertEquals(0, SmartCleanupImageAnalyzer.hammingDistance(0x12345678L, 0x12345678L));
        assertEquals(3, SmartCleanupImageAnalyzer.hammingDistance(0L, 0b1011L));
    }

    @Test public void perceptualHashAndStructureAgreeForIdenticalDownsampledInput() {
        byte[] pixels = new byte[32 * 32];
        for (int y = 0; y < 32; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 32; x++) pixels[y * 32 + x] = (byte) ((x * 3 + y * 5) & 255);
        long first = SmartCleanupImageAnalyzer.perceptualHash(pixels);
        assertEquals(first, SmartCleanupImageAnalyzer.perceptualHash(pixels.clone()));
        assertEquals(1.0, SmartCleanupImageAnalyzer.luminanceSsim(pixels, pixels.clone()), 0.0001);
    }

    @Test public void similarFrequencyPatternWithOppositeStructureIsRejectedBySsim() {
        byte[] firstPixels = new byte[32 * 32];
        byte[] inversePixels = new byte[32 * 32];
        for (int y = 0; y < 32; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 32; x++) {
            int value = ((x / 4 + y / 4) % 2) * 255;
            firstPixels[y * 32 + x] = (byte) value;
            inversePixels[y * 32 + x] = (byte) (255 - value);
        }
        double ssim = SmartCleanupImageAnalyzer.luminanceSsim(firstPixels, inversePixels);
        assertTrue(ssim < SmartCleanupImageAnalyzer.SIMILAR_MIN_SSIM);
        assertFalse(SmartCleanupImageAnalyzer.isDuplicate(
                SmartCleanupImageAnalyzer.perceptualHash(firstPixels),
                SmartCleanupImageAnalyzer.perceptualHash(inversePixels), ssim));
    }
}
